I work closely with my clients to understand their lives, tastes and aspirations, then translate these into thoughtful, cohesive and highly individual interiors. I’m not interested in imposing a signature style or following trends. Instead, I draw on my experience and design judgement to create spaces that feel authentic to the people who live in them, while bringing a level of refinement, creativity and detail that can be difficult to achieve alone. She has experienced a variety of different cultures, having lived in Paris, Hong Kong and LA, to then kick-starting her career in London where she completed her Diploma in Interior Design at KLC following a degree in Investment & Finance in Real Estate from the University of Reading. Being the founder and creative director of an interior design studio was an inevitable choice having been surrounded by a family of entrepreneurs. Her grandfather was a property developer, her mother a designer, who previously owned a boutique of objets de curiosities and a successful entrepreneur father, who was awarded an OBE (Officer of the Most Excellent Order of the British Empire in the Queen’s Birthday Honours) for his contribution to the automotive industry and economy. Prior to setting up Maison Arabella, Arabella dived into the creative industry honing her skills in the renowned practices of Katharine Pooley and Candy&Candy. Despite her young age, Arabella’s experience in leading high-end projects in prime Central London and abroad set her apart from her contemporaries. There is a flexibility in Arabella’s approach to design that makes her studio stand out. Uniting the classic with the modern, she pushe

name: Armainteriors
description: Armaghan Okohvan is a highly talented interior designer with a team of dedicated builders with over 18 years’ experience. Arma’s unconventional journey into the field of design & build has been fuelled by her passion for creating beautiful spaces that everyone can enjoy. Due to her distinctive design flair and her commitment to her clients, she has earned a great reputation in a short period of time. Arma continued to expand her wealth of knowledge and attained her Diploma from KLC School of Design in London in order to carry on creating uniquely, luxurious spaces specialising in London location Mayfair | Knightsbridge

name: ASJ Design Services Ltd
description: ASJ Design is an award-winning interior architecture and design practice, specialising in residential renovation and refurbishment in London and across the South of England. Together, we create spaces that both stand the test of time and stand out from the crowd, whilst always feeling like home. We have built a strong reputation for impeccable client service with most of our work being driven by recommendations and referrals.

name: AUdesign.It Interiors Ltd
description: Anna Usti grew up spending summers in the Jiguli mountains — a zapovednik, a protected wilderness kept forever wild. That sense of space, of nature left intentional and untouched, never left her. At six, she invented her own game: drawing floor plans of imaginary houses in the dirt of her yard. The obsession with interiors has continued ever since. AU Design was founded in 2023, bringing together seventeen years of experience across complex, considered projects. The practice offers interior architecture, design and curated art services — each shaped by a single belief: "We design homes that align with you — your rhythm, your shapes, your life. True luxury is functional. It lives in how sound travels through a room, how light hits a painting, how colour shifts from morning to evening. No detail is too small. This is healing through the interior." — Anna Usti, Founder, BIID Registered Interior Designer Member

name: Carden Cunietti
description: Eleanora Cunietti and Audrey Carden formed their partnership in 1996 when they opened their eponymous Notting Hill shop and design office, Carden Cunietti on Westbourne Park Road. The shop represented their style of mixing the old and new and different origins for furniture and furnishings from around the world and their interior design carried this eclectic theme on. They moved in 2006 to a large loftspace in W2 and now have a team of 10 designers working in the UK, Europe and the USA on residential projects. Their belief is to work with the client on creating the best enviroment for their needs, but love using luxurious fabrics, furnishings and finishes from around the globe.

name: Ideas by Lunas
description: 20 years design&build experience with a multi-disciplinary background. Completed various projects such as; five-star hotel, restaurant, office and residential projects. Skilled in Project management, project planning, contracts, bidding, supply chain and procurement expertise with advanced soft skills like good communication, problem-solving and team coordination. 10 years of multinational and multi-disciplinary work experience including; hotel operation, design, execution, management and tendering. Advanced user of AutoCAD, Adobe Photoshop, 3D Studio Max and Vray.

name: Studio Osborn
description: Multi award winning, internationally acclaimed designer, Bee Osborn is renowned for creating beautiful spaces in which to live and relax. She brings a personal approach to each client and over the past two decades has designed a vast array of residential and commercial properties, both in the UK and overseas.​ Inchbald trained, Bee and her professional team provide expertise, attention to detail and exceptional creativity to every project they undertake, whether it is a home or a boutique hotel.​ Bee draws inspiration from classical design and proportion, but always likes to infuse her work with a modern, up-to-date energy. Together, with her talented team, they produce balanced harmonious interiors that are both practical and visionary.

name: Jen Bernard Interiors Ltd & Bernard London
description: Jen Bernard Interiors (JBI) is a multi-award-winning interior design studio specialising in luxury commercial, later living, hospitality and high-end residential projects globally. Since 2008, we have been redefining interiors with a visionary, strategic approach , crafting spaces that are timeless, elegant, and soulful. Our in-house team of qualified interior designers, architectural designers, and procurement specialists collaborate seamlessly with trusted external professionals, planning consultants, engineers, and contractors to deliver bespoke, end-to-end solutions that maximise both space and value, underpinned by exceptional craftsmanship . Our expertise spans concept-to-completion design, including space planning, bespoke joinery, furnishings, lighting, and curated accessories from artwork to vintage and salvaged pieces. Every project is tailored to the client’s vision, executed with impeccable attention to detail , exceptional craftsmanship , and a commitment to exceptional service and measurable results . Flagship ventures are delivered through Jen Bernard Interiors, with high-end residential under Bernard London, and Care Home developments through sister company Zest Living reinforcing our reputation for creating interiors that are as strategic as they are inspiring .

name: Be Studio Interiors and Architecture
description: Be Studio Interiors & Architecture is a Southwark based design studio specializing in bespoke residential, commercial, and workspace interiors, as well as architectural solutions. We believe every space tells a story, and our mission is to craft environments that reflect our clients' unique identities. From functional layouts to carefully selected materials, colors, and lighting, we create cohesive designs that inspire and engage. With over 20 years of global experience, our founders Bilal and Elif combine creativity, precision, and technical expertise to deliver exceptional results. Our comprehensive services cover concept development, planning permissions, project management, and construction administration, ensuring a seamless journey from vision to reality. Whether you’re transforming a home or designing a workspace, we are committed to delivering timeless, practical, and inspiring designs tailored to your needs.

name: Bolthole Design
description: Bolthole Design is an interior architecture and design studio, working with private clients who are building or remodelling their home. The studio is run by Caroline Bolt, who has over 12 years experience working on build and renovation projects across the East Midlands. Caroline specialises in using 3D design as an integral part of the design process, enabling clients to imagine their new home and make confident decisions before they build.

name: Bowman Riley Architects
description: Tom combines a flair for design with a personable manner and the technical expertise to be able to deliver an interior design scheme from concept to completion. Tom has built a reputation for transforming office spaces into desirable environments designed to meet the evolving needs of the commercial market. Our interiors team is at the forefront of interior design; creating inspiring, efficient and innovative interior spaces that enhance the users' experience. We work on a wide range of projects from commercial design, bars and restaurants, hotel and leisure to bespoke private homes. We provide a full interior design service from initial concept creation through to final styling and accessories of interiors, surpassing our clients' aspirations. Working closely with our in house architects and building consultants, we can offer a full in-house design service from all our UK offices. Office locations: Skipton - Wellington, Otley Street, Skipton, North Yorkshire, BD23 1EL Leeds - Toronto Square, Toronto Street, West Yorkshire, LS1 2HJ London - The Button Factory, 35-39 Old Street, London, EC1V 9HX

name: Designed by Woulfe LTD
description: "Brian and his team are superb at planning and executing repairs and building work. Designed by Woulfe carried out a substantial amount of work for me at a very high standard, all the while maintaining absolute quality of finish. Brian’s commitment to his client, as well as his courtesy, is unrivalled." Jeremy Vine, BBC Presenter Award-Winning Interior Design, Personally Led Brian Woulfe is the Irish-born, London-based interior designer and Founder Director of Designed by Woulfe, a multi-award-winning studio established in 2009. His portfolio encompasses over 100 projects across five continents, delivering high-end interiors for private individuals and property developers. Renowned for creating luxurious yet liveable interiors, Brian combines meticulous attention to detail with a highly personal, hands-on approach. His work balances sophistication with comfort and practicality, with each project thoughtfully tailored to the client’s lifestyle, aspirations and daily routines. From Concept to Completion Brian is involved throughout each project stage, supported by an experienced team of designers, architects and project managers. The comprehensive service encompasses concept development, space planning, technical design, bespoke joinery, procurement, installation and final styling. Every project begins with understanding the client: their preferences, collections and aspirations. This informs a considered design process, with clear communication and careful management of budget

name: The Mint List
description: From an early age in London, Camilla developed a lifelong passion for furniture and interiors, inspired by her parents, both decorative antiques professionals. Growing up surrounded by the character and craftsmanship of antiques shops, she gained a deep appreciation for design history and a discerning eye for distinctive pieces that seamlessly bridge different periods and styles. After several years working in film production, Camilla returned to her roots in furniture and interiors, turning her attention towards establishing The Mint List interior design studio. Her knowledge and passion for reclaimed and repurposed materials is evident in her work which embraces organic and traditional form and texture. She has an implicit understanding of how function and form should coexist within the unique language of each design project. She has a skill for defining how contemporary design should sit within a traditional backdrop and a respect and passion for heritage projects. Camilla is a BIID accredited interior designer, responsible for multiple commercial and residential projects, working across multiple disciplines. Camilla oversees every interior design project at the company, ensuring the successful delivery of uniquely honed, distinctive interior spaces for The Mint List’s discerning clientele.

name: CS Design Studio
description: At CS Design Studio, we believe a home is more than a refined address—it is a living canvas where your family thrives and an envelope for the memories that define a lifetime. While our projects are informed by a global perspective and a passion for European artisanal excellence, the CS Design Studio signature is rooted in the unique spirit of London living: a thoughtful blend of historic soul and contemporary comfort. We stand for bespoke residences that bridge the gap between tradition and tomorrow. Our work honors the architectural integrity of the past while embracing the innovation of the future, creating spaces that speak to modern lifestyles with a sense of dignity and timeless beauty. Cansel, the founder of CS Design Studio, draws from her invaluable experience working in renowned design studios like David Collins, Finchatton and Harrods. She brings a instinctive eye for detail and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of luxury design.

name: Lili Oli Ltd
description: Lili Oli is a tailored and contemporary boutique interior design consultancy based in Hertfordshire, run by Carly Ferguson. Get in touch to schedule your Discovery Call to find out how I might be able to help you https://lilioli.com .

name: Caroline Cobbold Design Ltd
description: Caroline Cobbold Design Ltd is an Interior Design and Interior Architecture studio based in North London, set up in 2007. With a wealth of experience from over 30 years in styling and set decorating for film and TV advertising, Caroline Cobbold has developed an undeniable style that has led her to work on beautiful interior projects and collate a client list that covers an impressive array of private residences and commercial properties across the UK and overseas. Caroline lives and breathes design. With impeccable taste and attention to detail that has evolved organically over the years, Caroline translates her vision into chic and eclectic interiors. Highly adept at combining different genres of styles, with a talent for borrowing cultural influences from her experiences with work and travel and her use of antique furniture alongside contemporary pieces to create beautiful surroundings that are completely unique. Caroline's design process from start to finish is highly personal and collaborative. Her skills lie in her versatility as she adapts her instinctive style to bring the clients vision to life with her striking aesthetic and dedicated professionalism. She aims to create a finished interior that reflects the true personality of its owner while working within an agreed budget and programme to provide the client with an outcome that exceeds their original expectations. Every room tells a story. She brings rooms to life with her bold use of colour and her discerning eye

name: Zulufish Interiors
description: Caroline Milns is a talented and distinctive interior designer with studios based in West London. Having worked as a textile and interior designer for over 20 years, Caroline launched award-winning Zulufish Interiors in 2013. "Caroline is exceptionally talented at creating warm and welcoming homes that combine simplicity and clean lines, with unexpected twists and inspiring ideas. She is brilliant at coming up with original ways to bring in the light so that homes feel calm and well proportioned, even where space may be tight. Her attention to detail is awe inspiring, yet her homes feel as if they have come together organically but never contrived.” Mary Weaver, Houses Editor, Living Etc. A deep love of colour and textiles informs Caroline's design; she creates architectural, textured schemes that breathe life into an interior. Her textile background and industry knowledge allows her to smart source the finest materials at the most competitive prices, and she prides herself on being able to listen to her clients' needs and translate their vision into beautifully thought-out spaces, unique to them. After starting her design career designing fabrics for Monkwell fabrics, she rose to the top of the John Lewis Home Design Studio, managing a team of designers and creating innovative product and textile design. In 2007 Caroline retrained in interior design at Helen Green and moved on to work for high-end residential specialists Mcvitty Interior Consultants. From here it was a natur

name: Ashton House Design
description: Following formal training and experience in London, Caroline moved back to her home county of Devon from where she, together with her husband, Simon Bantock, have built up their interior design practice. With the majority of projects now centred in the South West they have a reliable network of outstanding colleagues with whom they work to implement their designs. They have a stylish Design Studio in Ashburton, on the edge of Dartmoor and centrally located between Exeter and Plymouth. Their own website illustrates many examples of their project work and clearly demonstrates their attention to detail.

name: Cat Dal Interiors
description: Rooted in the Scandinavian design ethos, Cat Dal Interiors strive to create interior spaces that maximise happiness and improve the daily lifestyle of their inhabitants. Beauty and functionality underpin our work, providing the framework upon which to carefully layer colour, pattern, texture and a curated mix of old and new for a unique & playful spirit. With a focus on natural materials, authenticity, and craftsmanship we seek to deliver warm, intimate spaces that cultivate a sense of solace and restoration. We are inspired by the natural world, and aim to enhance this connection in every interior, not only in the selection of materials, but with a focus on maximising light & space wherever possible. Utilising a considered & collaborative approach, we develop and communicate the narrative of the client and blend it with cues from the surrounding landscape, culture, and architectural vernacular to create timeless, honest designs. We are not trend seekers, nor do we own a ‘house style’, but prefer to start each project fresh, with the client brief defining the overall direction. That said, we do not take ourselves too seriously, and enjoy adding a dash of whimsy and surprise where and when we can. Characterised by creative & bespoke solutions, we believe design should reflect how you live and thus, your home should work hard for you. The end result is interior spaces that inspire and delight.

name: Angel + Blume
description: Angel + Blume is an interior design practice based in central Cambridge. We specialise in all types of domestic projects as well as bespoke corporate work, and we believe very strongly that good interior design is about understanding and interpreting a client's style and requirements In addition to our interior design work, we offer a complete project management service, and work alongside handpicked, trusted and qualified tradesmen and contractors. Cate Burren founded Angel + Blume in 2002 and is an interior designer, colour specialist, stylist and writer on interior design. Her most recent book 'Secrets of a Stylish Home' was published by Merrell Publishers in 2013.

name: Catherine Olasky Ltd
description: CATHERINE CASTEEL OLASKY is the co-founder and Director of Olasky & Sinsteden. Catherine began her design career working in New York City for Bunny Williams, where she spent five years. In 2006, seeking to enrich her knowledge in the European antique trade and to work in historic houses, she moved to London to work at Sibyl Colefax & John Fowler, where she spent four years. In late 2009, Catherine and Max began Olasky & Sinsteden. Catherine has a B.A. from Auburn University and a certificate in interior decoration from Parson School of Design.

name: Ribton Turner Ltd
description: Ribton Turner Interior Design is a Cambridgeshire based interior design studio whose work considers both classic and contemporary interiors. We design and oversee calm, functional and beautiful interiors that truly reflect the personalities and needs of our clients and the way we live now. Founder Catherine Ribton Turner established the company in 2010 and has been creating inspiring homes for both commercial and residential clients ever since, from listed buildings, mid-century villas to contemporary additions. A period of living and studying in Japan in her twenties cemented an admiration and love for a minimal aesthetic of serene beauty, material richness and timeless appeal; a theme which runs through all of Catherine's creative work. Catherine has worked for over twenty five years in design; she started her career in the field of fashion with Aquascutum, then spent ten years as a brand design strategist working for top British and international brand design consultancies. ​ With a holistic approach to architecture and design, Catherine creates a coherent style and setting, working from the architectural framework into the interiors and objects within the space, designing for specific needs and structures, rather than merely considering the aesthetic experience. Creating confidently neutral interiors with an emphasis on calm colours and organic materials, her projects are designed to enhance the lives of her clients.

name: Letter Studio Ltd
description: Letter Studio, founded in 2024, is an Interior Architecture and Design Studio based between London & Hove delivering projects across the Residential, Hospitality and Commercial sectors. Offering experience of over 13 years within the industry, Catherine Godon, Founder and Creative Director, is a BIID Registered Designer, previously featured as a designer to watch in Mix Interiors '30 Designers under 30'. Previously, Catherine grew her career and held senior roles within the world renowned and award winning Foster + Partners, 1508 London and Tatjana Von Stein (formerly Sella Concept). Letter is an ambitious and artistic studio with an innate passion for crafting authentic, harmonious, and functional interiors. Merging historical and cultural references with a timeless elegance to deliver a curated and contemporary approach to Interior Design. The studio is founded on a tried and tested structured framework and six core values, followed 'to the letter' to execute distinctive projects. Longevity • Experience • Timelessness • Teamwork • Environment • Respect

name: Cecilia Halling Howells Interiors
description: Grounded in a passion for classic British interiors, my design aesthetic equally reflects my Swedish roots, with simplicity, functionality and a connection to nature at the forefront. I have spent close to 15 years working in luxury design firms in London, the last nine of those as the Creative Director of an award-winning studio, listed in House & Garden's Top 100 Interior Designers, and Country & Townhouse's Top 50 Interior Designers. I believe that a successful interior is deeply personal and rooted in what you love –– reflecting your unique style and personality. The magic happens when your home appears evolved over time, like a treasured collection, with a combination of items that are made bespoke for your space, those that are crafted by hand and some with history and patina. My philosophy is to listen, take in the details of your everyday life, and build a scheme around what matters most. I will help you find your design language and express your narrative through your home.

name: Dean Interior Design
description: Charlotte Dean, of Dean Interior Design, is a residential interior designer who is based in East Sussex and works across the South East of England. After building her own house in 2008, she then went on to work in the business of design and established her own company in 2018. More recently, she has started collaborating on projects with her husband Ptolemy Dean, the renowned historic buildings architect. With a real love of colour and appreciation of antiques and art, her style leans towards the elegant and the classic, whilst retaining attuned to the needs of a modern household. Charlotte often works alongside other specialists including lighting and bathroom designers, picture hangers and furniture restorers. She is happy to design schemes from single rooms to entire homes with each project being entirely bespoke. Charlotte was proudly made a member of the BIID In 2023.

name: Charlotte Stuart Interiors
description: Charlotte Stuart Interiors is a turn-key interior design studio based near Stockbridge, Hampshire, that seamlessly balances refined luxury with everyday comfort. Shaped by the belief that interior design is an intimate and expressive process, she creates spaces that feel both personal and enduring. Her clients are private homeowners and property developers in the South West, London and across the UK. Working closely with clients, Charlotte takes on a selected number of design projects, ensuring each client gets her full and dedicated attention. She partners with skilled craftspeople and carefully curates finishing details, ensuring each design is layered with originality, character, and a sense of comfortable English charm. In Spring 2020, she introduced the Interior Consultancy Service, a one-on-one experience, designed for those seeking expert guidance on smaller projects. Consultations are available in person or online, anywhere. Her intuitive design process, combined with a keen eye for detail and a natural flair for creativity, results in interiors that effortlessly blend elegance with practicality. A recognised authority on colour and pattern, concept development, and storytelling, Charlotte is a sought-after speaker who has collaborated with leading brands such as House & Garden, Colefax & Fowler, Julian Chichester, and Farrow & Ball.

name: Materialise Interiors Limited
description: Materialise Interiors is an award-winning, B Corp Certified, Brighton-based interior design company run by Chloe Bullock, working for clients in Brighton, London and the South East, offering sustainable, healthy and vegan interior design for commercial and residential clients. We are growing more and more aware of where things come from, the people & processes involved and the impact on the planet. So to support this, Chloe helps clients by creating spaces and specifications that have a lower impact on the planet and people - whilst also looking luxurious! We are reported to be spending 90% of our time indoors and our spaces are increasingly made more and more air tight. So it's important we are mindful of what we put in those spaces with us as inside air quality can often be many times worse than outside. Chloe is a director on BIID Council and was awarded the BIID Merit Award 2025. She was named as PETA’s Compassionate Designer in their Vegan Homeware Awards . Her book Sustainable Interior Design , commissioned by the Royal Institute of British Architects ( RIBA ) launched in the Spring of 2024. The book covers the various approaches to a sustainable interior design, with the goal of inspiring the interior design industry to work in a more conscious way, with a lessened impact. Working for clients in South East England and further away - online, Chloe supports project teams with advice on sustainable and regenerative design solutions - sourcing or materials. She has gone on

name: Fraser & Fraser Design
description: Fraser & Fraser is a leading, London-based architecture and interior design studio offering an exceptional, entirely bespoke design service for your home. We are a small, approachable residential design studio led by Chloe Cooke and Clare Diggins with expertise gained from more than 20 years in luxury interior design. We believe that truly listening to our clients and clearly understanding their needs allows us to deliver the most outstanding, timeless interiors for their homes. Working alongside some of the most talented and trusted suppliers in London and beyond, Chloe and Clare have an encyclapaedic knowledge of precisely what is required to deliver unique, impeccable design in every project we undertake. We lead each project with expert guidance and a rigorous professionalism which has led to many years of repeat business. We are very proud to have worked on second and even third homes for several clients. Our services range from eDesign to full turn-key refurbishments

name: Christina Fallah Designs Limited
description: Design is an interpretation there is no wrong or right, as an intuitive person, I thrive on the ability to understand my clients without them saying a word. Ever since I was a child I have had a keen eye for looking beyond the surface and try to appreciate the context and story of what is presented. Whether it a person, building or project, I use the knowledge gained through exposure, experience and expression to construe and reflect the client brief and pride myself on anticipating but more importantly achieving client need- their project means as to them as it does to me, it's this personal approach. It is this ethos that has developed my design portfolio to include places like the Middle East, Asia, America, and nearer shores in Europe. Some specific projects include: HM Treasury - Claridges Hotel - Renishaw Hall - The Shelbourne Hotel, Dublin - Au Bar, New York - Penthouse, Manhattan, New York - Private Villa, Amanpuri, Phuket- Private House, Chester Square, London - Private House, Knightsbridge, London - Private Villa, Cap Ferrat, France -Selected Private Yachts - 35 metres up to 72 metres. References are always available on request.

name: Honky Design Ltd
description: Founded by Christopher Dezille in April 2001, the London-based multi-disciplinary architectural and interior design practice works with property developers and private clients in the UK and beyond. Dezille who is known throughout the industry for his astute visual awareness and attention to detail has earned a reputation for creating strong, sustainable and timeless interiors, delivered on time and on budget, by engaging closely with clients from concept to completion. To Dezille, interior design is storytelling in 3D. The role of Honky is not to impose a house style but to encapsulate the client’s narrative and deliver it Honky style. Honky has worked on many prestigious projects for private clients in some of London’s most exclusive postcodes, including Wycombe Square, Trafalgar Square, and Hampstead, while overseas projects have stretched from the Channel Islands and Cannes to Montenegro and the Bahamas. Developer Clients include the Berkeley Group, Eco World, London Square, Dandara and LBS Properties. Over the last two decades Honky has helped to tell some amazing stories. Key to their success is the sheer diversity of their client base and the projects they work on and, of course, the wealth of talent and experience within the team. Honky look forward to telling your story through their bespoke and timeless interiors.

name: CVP Designs Ltd
description: Christopher Vane Percy is the head of his design team at CVP Designs, established in 1971, and oversees every project. Renowned for his attention to detail, retaining the utmost regard for his clients' tastes, and observing total discretion, Christopher Vane Percy has worked on many prestigious commissions for a number of V.I.P. clients, both at home and abroad. Most of the initial contact is via personal recommendation and, over the years, the company has retained many loyal clients as their lifestyles evolve. One example of this is a recent assignment to design the interior of a large apartment in a new development in Kensington for clients who were moving from a late 18th century house in Westminster, itself refurbished by CVP in the late eighties. The company is now based in its North Kensington office/design studio, part of a large Victorian dairy acquired by Christopher Vane Percy and converted into studio accommodation and working spaces. CVP Designs managed this exciting development. Christopher Vane Percy is a Past President of the International Interior Design Association (UK Chapter) and Past Chairman of the BIDA. Both CVP' s residential and commercial projects have been featured in Architectural Digest, House & Gardens, Homes & Gardens, Country Life, Period Living, The English Home and various other publications.

name: Cigal Kaplan Interiors
description: Cigal Kaplan Interiors is a London-based interior design studio with an award-winning reputation. Combining form and function, we’ll create the space you’ve always wished for. Our approach to each interior design project is unique, our style is tailored to your taste and aesthetic, and our commitment to excellence in execution is unwavering. At Cigal Kaplan Interiors the focus is on you – and how you want your home to look and feel. We don’t work to a preconceived formula or follow particular trends. Instead, we’re guided by what we call our Three Cs —Creativity, Care and Collaboration. Using these principles, we’ll turn your dream home into a reality. And if that’s not enough, we’ll even add a fourth C: Cigal. She’ll be at your side whenever you need her, equipped with decades worth of design expertise and her handy team of craftspeople.

name: Sid & Betty Ltd
description: Cindy de Vos is an interior designer and founder of Sid & Betty Ltd, based in Southwell, Nottinghamshire. A graduate of the Inchbald School of Design with an MA in Architectural Interior Design, she specialises in the sensitive restoration and reimagining of historic English country houses, alongside carefully considered residential interiors. Her work is grounded in close observation and in “listening to buildings”—respecting their architecture, material history and patterns of use while creating interiors that feel layered, personal and entirely liveable. Cindy works collaboratively with clients, craftspeople, makers and specialist suppliers, directing projects from early concept and spatial planning through bespoke joinery, decoration, lighting, furniture and final installation. Her recent practice includes the long-term transformation of a significant Cotswold manor house, bringing together historic fabric, contemporary comfort and exceptional British craftsmanship.

name: Claire Beaubien Interiors
description: Trained in fashion, textiles and art, Claire Beaubien has worked as an interior designer for almost two decades. Her strongest belief is that our homes should be our happiest place; a source of pride and a true reflection of ourselves. In our homes we should be surrounded by a sense of wellbeing, vitality and total comfort. Claire works with her clients to achieve this through open dialogue and in listening to what the client needs to feel comfortable and what they wish to convey through their homes. She offer fresh and modern perspectives on a range of interior projects, whether the job is a complete refurb or simply bringing in new and unexpected insights onto existing schemes. Whatever the scope or the scale, Claire's work is entirely bespoke, sustainable and anchored by experience. Born in Montreal, Claire has lived in the United Kingdom for 25 years and is currently based in Wiltshire with her husband, son and cats. Home is a recently converted barn and her neighbours are horses and alpacas. Claire works on residential commissions across the UK and Internationally, creating homes that are stunningly beautiful, comfortable and practical. ​ ​ ​ ​

name: Studio 12 Designs
description: Specialising in the design, decoration, extension and renovation of private homes Studio 12 Designs tailors its service to meet your unique needs working closely and collaboratively with you to achieve the perfect result. At our studio and showroom in Theale, Berkshire clients can safely and comfortably meet for project consultation meetings, source furnishings and accessories. As well as creativity and practicality, Studio 12 Designs' founder Claire Tull is passionate about the health and well-being benefits that carefully considered, well-designed interior spaces can bring. Claire's philosophy and client focus have gained Studio 12 Designs its enviable reputation for creating unique, timeless, elegant, and supremely comfortable interiors, coupled with exceptional customer service. Our designs are inspired by you to reflect your personality, lifestyle, and aspirations. Our job is to listen, interpret, and deliver your unique requirements.

name: Claire Totman Designs Ltd
description: Claire Totman Designs is a BIID and SBID accredited studio with RIBA and ARB accredited architects offering all RIBA stages from concept to completion. At Claire Totman Designs, we believe that exceptional design stems from a deep understanding of our clients' lifestyles and aspirations. Our goal is to create spaces that are not only aesthetically pleasing but also functional and reflective of the individuals who inhabit them. We focus on maximising natural light, ensuring intuitive layouts, and selecting materials that enhance both the form and function of each space.

name: Livingfunky Ltd
description: I've always believed a home should tell you about the person who lives in it. That belief started long before interiors. I trained in fashion, earning my BA in Fashion Design and spent eight years as a fashion stylist. Fabric, colour, pattern and materials were my first language and they still are. Nearly 24 years and many projects later as the co-founder of LivingFunky, a Premium Design and Build company in Crystal Palace, London. I lead the architectural and interior design on every project, from architectural concept and space planning through to construction, materials, colour and final styling. What I care about most for my clients, is how a home feels and flows to live in, not just how it looks. The clients I work with, private clients and property developers alike, don't want a 'show' home. They want vibrant spaces with personality and a feeling of home; where you can cook and still be part of the conversation; where the garden feels like part of the room; where you walk through the door and you feel at home. Design is how I live, not just what I do. Many client projects and six personal homes of my own so far, including a Passivhaus-inspired new build and a mid century modern house we doubled in size and tripled in value, featured in House Beautiful.

name: Pascoe Interiors Ltd

She manages every element under one roof for a seamless client experience. Elle’s hands-on approach ensures she remains involved in every phase, from the initial free consultation and concept development through to project management, fabrication and final styling. Working alongside master joiner Lee Purdom in their Eynsford workshop, she oversees every detail to guarantee exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail. Committed to excellence and as a BIID Registered Interior Designer, Elle undertakes a minimum of 20 hours of Continuing Professional Development each year, keeping her at the forefront of the latest materials, sustainable practices and technical innovations. Her clients value her clear communication, problem-solving attitude and the way she tailors each project to reflect their lifestyle and aspirations. name: Coryn Dickman Interiors
description: Interior design and well thought-out spaces are my passion! Working closely with my clients to create interiors that perfectly meet their individual needs and interests is key, and at the same time designing super-functional and stunningly stylish interiors ...that are never boring! Once the interiors flow, the design is in the details; throw in my unique use of richness of texture, patterns and colour to create dramatic and individual interiors. My one-of-a-kind design brings together my eclectic inspiration and mixed with a interest to renovate and upcyle materials and buildings wherever possible, creates a seamless combination of old and new. During my design career I have worked on some of the world's biggest brands which has been amazing! It has also instilled in me the importance in every project of staying close to the budget and careful management of process. But what really makes me happy is to guide a client through every step their project and see their huge satifaction and joy when the job is done. Many clients speak of my "strong ideas and concepts", "attention to detail", "decisiveness" and their "satisfaction with their home project results".

name: cform design research
description: As a BIID Certified Interior Designer and a graduate of the Royal College of Art (MA Interior Design) , my practice is rooted in conceptual clarity, spatial storytelling, and a refined material sensibility. With a background spanning residential, retail, and cultural spaces, I approach each project as an opportunity to shape meaningful experiences — blending architecture, art, and human behaviour into quietly powerful environments. My design language is minimalist yet expressive, driven by emotional resonance and contextual intelligence. I believe in creating interiors that not only serve function but also reflect the values, rhythms, and aspirations of those who inhabit them.

name: Archidite ltd
description: Archidite is an award winning, international Architecture & Interior Design firm based in Norwich, United Kingdom. We provide exceptional and innovative design services focusing on all aspects of Architecture. Our design approach is defined by the exploration of new ideas and technologies, and our commitment to sustainability. We strive to add value to your projects through our careful and creative design process.

name: Birch House
description: Birch house is a London based interior design studio offering comprehensive design services to private clients and property developers throughout the UK and internationally. We collaborate closely with our clients to realise their aesthetic ideas and practical needs whilst adhering to their budgets. We strive to create liveable, elegant and uniquely tailored interiors. Through our personal and professional approach, we ensure each and every project is seamlessly designed and managed from concept to completion. Our ultimate goal is to provide exceptional service to each client and deliver inspired, creative and functional homes. We are here to realise your vision, whatever it may be, and our complete architectural interior design service enables us to deliver on every crucial detail.

name: Krikla Ltd
description: Having launched a showroom of a curated collection of antique and vintage pieces, design furniture, decorative and fine arts in 2014, Dasha Slavinskaya gave a go to her true passion after spending 10 years in accounting and in over 5 years in property development. “I grew up in a family, where the entire region of Latin America was a big passion as well as a professional occupation of my dad. Our apartment was a display for decorative art pieces he kept bringing home from his trips. I developed a taste for crafts and ethnic motives, which I started to incorporate in my designs later. It is sad to admit that craftsmanship across the world is struggling to survive and fully disappearing in some regions. Inherited skills from grandparents and parents is a big advantage but also is a hard choice for the younger generation in the world of opportunities. As a studio, we believe in supporting craftsmanship, preserving the traditions and giving pieces a second life.” Combining skills obtained throughout her career in accounting and property development together with a key eye for style and design, Dasha has been offering her services in interiors since 2016, combining a distinctive decorative approach with effective management, making this combination a trademark of her studio.

name: De Beauvoir Design Ltd
description: Kim provides a personal and bespoke service to her clients. Key to the service is one on one attention, Kim will look after your project every step of the way, from being on site with trades through to sourcing soft furnishings. Kim is passionate about design, innovation and sustainability. Kim's aim is to take the stress out of your project, helping you make a home that is unique to you.

name: Base interior
description: Base Interior, founded in 2010, is an interior design studio working in a multi-disciplinary fashion to offer a full design and coordination service to their varied Clients. The studio, an airy ground floor double reception room in a converted 18th Century townhouse, is located around the corner from the Wallace Collection and adjacent to Selfridges in the heart of London’s Marylebone. The day to day running of the studio and Client liaison are managed by Deborah Bass who is the founder and Creative Director; it is this personal approach that has resulted in the long-standing relationships and repeat Clients that feature in the repertoire of jobs. The design team at Base offer an experienced and realistic approach to design and construction and their skills include space planning and permissions, concept design, detail design, bespoke furniture and finishes, dressing and styling alongside the day to day project coordination and contract administration role. There is a real sense of teamwork in the studio where technicians, project coordinators and designers all come together to deliver a well-rounded project. Working with a practice that has experience across all aspects of interior architecture gives the Client the opportunity to have a single point-of-contact over the course of a project, this makes the design and construction process much less daunting, especially for those living overseas. name: dk Interiors
description: dk INTERIORS creates glamorous, elegant, stylish and timeless interiors with attention to detail from inception through to delivery. Understanding and interpreting a client' s dream is of utmost importance, the end result reflecting a client' s personality and lifestyle whilst remaining conscious of the company' s design ethos. Debra' s previous business and management experience in a blue chip fashion company and working for a highly recognized and respected interior design company for several years has enabled her to establish a professional design practice that organizes and efficiently runs complex and diverse projects with confidence and ease. Combining practicality seamlessly with style, Debra has an innate creative flair which is paramount to inspiring her clients with confidence and most of all satisfaction. dk INTERIORS has the ability to carry out every aspect of a project from the inception of interior planning through to final installation, communicating personably and effectively with clients, architects, suppliers and all trades. Each project is unique and the bespoke service is tailored to meet the individual client' s brief.

name: Velvet Orange Ltd
description: Dee Gibson is a London based, interior designer with over 20 years of experience. In 2018, Dee designed and built Kalukanda House, a boutique hotel in Sri Lanka, recently listed in Conde Naste Best Places to go in 2024. The hotel is part of the Hip Hotel collection, and Dee is a regular speaker with the BIID participating in panel debates and giving talks on her work. Past clients all speak of beautiful, individual, functional designs and a collaborative and approachable working style. Dee has built a reputation as a creative, committed and innovative designer who puts all clients at the very centre of her designs. Regularly working with architects, specialist craftspeople and main contractors, taking time to get to know her clients and understand their needs is a key part of her process and collaboration with them is an important ingredient. A 10 year career in finance and a personal successful track record in property development brings a business acumen and common sense approach to bringing beautiful designs to life.

name: DOVE Interior Design LTD
description: DOVE interior design Ltd is a small studio nestled in the heart of the Cheshire countryside. The founders, Derry and Carly, have over twenty years of combined experience in interior design. They work seemlessly together to create beautiful interiors that are not only visually appealing but also practical and functional. Derry is a RIBA chartered architect, which means that DOVE has an added benefit as they can draw on their architectural expertise to provide clients with a holistic design solution. Offering a variety of services from turnkey solutions, guiding you from the initial design scheme for a planning application to the final touches of a beautifully styled interior to individual room designs. Whether you're envisioning a comprehensive redesign or contemplating a subtle transformation, DOVE would love to assist.

name: Bal Bahia Interiors
description: Luxury Residential Interior Design · Surrey & London Bal Bahia Interiors is a private luxury interior design practice based in Walton-on-Thames, Surrey. Founded by Bal Bahia — BIID Registered Interior Designer®, WELL AP™ Accredited Professional, and Science in Design® certified — the practice works with discerning homeowners across Surrey and London on residential projects where considered design, quality of material, and long-term livability matter equally. Before establishing her Surrey practice, Bal spent five years designing luxury residences in Florida, with work featured in House & Garden (US) and Forbes. That international experience informs a design approach that is quietly confident, deeply personal, and always grounded in how a home actually feels to live in — not just how it photographs. The practice takes a limited number of projects each year to ensure every client receives full personal attention.

name: Studio Brisa
description: Studio Brisa is a London-based interior architecture and design studio founded by Débora Foresti and Carla Dutra, specialising in soulful, bespoke residential interiors. With a shared background in architecture and a deep respect for how spaces shape daily life, we blend Brazilian heritage with British craftsmanship to craft spaces that feel authentic, enduring and culturally rich. Our mission is to design contemporary spaces that help you reconnect with your home, transforming it into a sanctuary for relaxation, inspiration and self-expression. At Studio Brisa, our work is shaped by your lifestyle, values and the way you want to feel in your space. With a commitment to simplicity and intention, we design with purpose: creating timeless, understated spaces that inspire and elevate the way you live. From the early vision to the final touches, our design process is seamless, collaborative and designed around you. Wether refining layouts, curating materials or sourcing lasting pieces, eache decision is made with care to ensure your home feels personal, effortless and built o last.

name: The Drawing Room Interiors Ltd
description: Diana Celella is an international award-winning designer, Director of The Drawing Room Interiors, Associate Consultant Hammond Care, Dementia Choice, as well as being Ex-President of SBID and Ex-Chairman of the Healthcare Design Panel (HDAC). She works in the commercial sector, specialising in healthcare projects, from care homes and dental practices to assisted living and retirement villages, she is recognised throughout the industry as an expert in implementing evidence-based design. Diana has working in this sector of interior design since graduating, with Interior Design Degree, in 1987. As such has gained a reputation as a well-recognised and extremely Knowledgeable Healthcare Designer. Her approach to each project is tailored to the needs of the operator. Throughout her Career in Interior Design Diana has worked in different Sectors of Design including High End Residential, Hospitality, Workplace and Education design as well as spending four years as an Associate Lecturer in Interior Design. Diana regularly gives talks on Healthcare Design and was awarded West Midland Woman of the Year 2016 for her contributions to Design Education.

name: Di Henshall Interior Design
description: Di Henshall Interior Design has been operating in Queensland, Australia, for 24 years. Di, trained in Liverpool, UK, migrated to Australia and initially worked for a group of architects in Melbourne before settling in Noosa Heads. She heads a team of 10 in her design studio and has a further 20 staff members in her two separate factories, under the name of Resident Hero, which manufacture high-end bespoke furniture and kitchens. Di is also a qualified builder, who undertook further training to become a Greensmart builder, a discipline which embraces environmentally sustainable and responsible building practices. Di travels abroad at least three times a year, including to Europe to attend industry functions. In 2009, Di was awarded the Women in Building Award from the Master Builders' Association and also a Fellowship of the Design Institute of Australia for services to the design industry. Di constantly writes articles for various trade and design publications, she lectures on interior design and building and mentors female apprentices in the building industry. Di Henshall Interior Design works all over Australia and the UK.

name: Dio Davies Ltd
description: The Dio Davies Interior Design Studio offers a fully integrated luxury design service working with private clients and property developers. From heritage properties to contemporary new builds, recent projects include a sub-penthouse at The Bryanstan, a Georgian townhouse, an Edwardian family home, four apartments at Park Hyatt Residences, six apartments at The OWO Residences by Raffles, and 10,000sq ft of luxury amenities at River Park Tower. name: Welham Architects
description: Eddie Welham BA (Hons), MA (DIST), is a Director of Welham Architects and a dedicated lecturer in Interior Architecture and Design at Nottingham Trent University, where he teaches both undergraduate and postgraduate students. With a focus on people-centric architecture, Eddie believes that interiors are the tangible connection between our functional and emotional requirements of space. Memories of the past, rituals of everyday life, and aspirations of our futures are thoughtfully combined in narrative to create bespoke spaces tailored to client budgets. In addition to his role at Welham Architects, Eddie is passionate about enhancing learning environments and founded the Education Design Partnership. The initiative seeks to improve educational and working spaces through thoughtful design and traditional procurement processes. Eddie’s design work has earned recognition from leading construction institutions. Alongside his talented team, he has received multiple accolades, including 'Best Extension,' 'Best New Housing Development,' and 'Best Educational Building.' Contact Eddie at Welham Architects and discover why the firm is regarded as one of Nottingham's premier architecture and design practices.

The team is renowned for creating bespoke spaces that are creative, cutting edge and as beautiful as they are functional. Element Studios was founded by Camilla Leech, an architect who studied in Oxford and Washington DC, before working for a number of practices in Oxford. She specialised in restoration (gaining a post-graduate diploma in Built Resource Studies and one in Interior Design) and successfully delivered numerous schemes for colleges, schools and houses that can be seen throughout Oxford. Having taken time out to have children Camilla decided to refresh her skills and focus on her real passion for interiors by undertaking a diploma at the KLC School of Design in London, where she is now a visiting lecturer. The team is based in Oxford and London, but services can be offered at a national and international level. name: Romano Interior Architecture
description: Romano Interior Architecture is a boutique design practice based in London and working internationally, specialized in luxury interior architecture. Eleonora has had the privilege of working in several fields of architecture and design before setting up the studio. With degrees in architecture, interiors, art and restauration, her knowledge and experience provide her with a global and comprehensive vision, integrating all aspects of design to conceive a space complementing every architectural style. Drawing inspiration from the location, building characteristics and the client’s requirements, interests and lifestyle RIA creates timeless interiors with the finest quality. For the last 15 years Eleonora has worked in the luxury market, heading a great variety of projects, from hospitality, residential and retail to landscape and furniture design. Designing a home is a very personal process, and it requires creating a specific solution tailored to the client's mood and aspirations. Designed with their lifestyle in mind, through visual research and conceptual thinking, RIA create spaces with a refined aesthetic, strong sense of place and a unique concept.
