name: Eliska Design Associates Ltd
description: Eliska has enjoyed over 25 years experience in the field of design, and is Design Director of Eliska Design Associates. The design practice is diverse, offering a comprehensive consultancy service from a single bespoke piece to a complete build. Working with architects, contractors and landscape gardeners. Eliská can provide design from initial concept to final installation. Antiques and furnishings are sourced world-wide to blend furniture, lighting and textiles. Each project is unique and an individual look is created for each client. A key element to Eliska; is the ability to mix old and new, contemporary with traditional design, creating a timeless look. Eliska is a past Exhibition Director of BIDA, she is a Member of IDDA and an Affiliate Member of RIBA.

name: Elixir Interior Design Ltd
description: Melanie Barnes founded Elixir Interior Design in Brighton in 2013. The studio specialises in high-end residential and boutique hospitality interiors, with particular expertise in period and listed properties. Working across Brighton & Hove and central London, Elixir offers a comprehensive interior design service, creating characterful, considered interiors that respect the architecture and history of a property while bringing a fresh, contemporary perspective. The studio also offers a turnkey interior design service for clients seeking a fully managed home, including overseas owners who require their property to be designed, furnished and ready to enjoy. Recent projects include Regency Square Suites, a Grade II* listed Regency townhouse in Brighton transformed into ten individually designed luxury suites, alongside residential projects in Brighton, Hove and London. Melanie’s work has appeared in The Times and 25 Beautiful Homes. From initial concept through to installation and finishing, Elixir combines creative design with careful attention to detail to deliver distinctive, highly personal interiors.

name: Elizabeth Keenan Studio
description: Elizabeth Keenan Studio is an interior architecture and design practice specialising in residential, commercial and wellness spaces. Elizabeth Keenan established her studio in 2018, founding it on over a decade of experience working with world-renowned interior designers and award-winning design practices. The insight Elizabeth gained over these years in the industry informs the studio's guiding philosophy - Just Enough. With a core team of designers, architects and project coordinators, Elizabeth Keenan Studio designs, manages and delivers large-scale, high-end projects from start to finish. The studio's unique overview and involvement in the entire process stand them apart, affording clients a seamless and enjoyable journey from concept to completion. At Elizabeth Keenan Studio, we come to each project with an instinctive understanding of - and deep appreciation for - how people inhabit space. Our Just Enough philosophy underpins this approach, ensuring that we achieve the ultimate balance between aesthetic and utility for every project. Collaborating with clients, we combine craft, quality, precision and pragmatism to realise unique, elegant interiors to the highest standard, no less. We seek not to simply execute a client brief, but to elevate it with fresh thinking and innovative ideas.

name: Lima Kitchens Limited
description: Most people think they're commissioning a kitchen. What they're actually doing is making a decision about how they'll live for the next twenty years. That's the conversation I want to have. I'm Elizabeth Pantling-Jones, a BIID Registered Interior Designer and co-founder of Lima Kitchens, an independent studio I've run since 2006. We specialise in kitchens, ground-floor renovations, and bedroom and dressing room investments. Projects where interior design, interior architecture, and full build management work together as one joined-up process. My particular focus is on designing for how life actually changes: accessibility, multigenerational living, ageing populations, and longevity. Not as a niche, as good design practice. A space should work as well in twenty years as it does today. That thinking runs through every project we take on, from the first conversation to the final photograph. We take on complex work; listed buildings, structural reconfigurations, multi-room schemes and manage every element of it. Our clients are busy people making a significant investment in their home. Their time is valuable, the process is stressful enough, and the decisions are too important to leave to chance. We coordinate everything, so they don't have to. Outside the studio, I judge for the KBSA Awards and am a regular panellist on the KBB Review podcast. I am the founder and host The Home Improvement Podcast because I believe the industry has a responsibility to help homeowners make better

name: Salthouse Design
description: Founded by Ellen Leedham, Salthouse Design provides a full Interior Design, Furnishings and Project Management service and offers a wealth of Interior Design expertise to your project. Ellen has eighteen years experience working in the creative industry as a professional Interior Designer. Studying Interior Design at UCA in Farnham she went on to work for top interior design practices such as Conran & Partners and Richmond International before finding her role as Lead Designer at Suna Interior Design where she spent over a decade working with with some of London’s premier developers. Originally from Christchurch, Dorset, Ellen’s connection to the coastline is visible in her work. Subtle use of coastal texture and colour notes often feature in her projects and the choice of natural materials also reflects Ellen’s sustainable approach to projects. She currently lives with her family in Kent whilst delivering projects across the country.

name: Cuturi Cameto
description: Led by its Founder and Creative Director Eloisa Cuturi Kabariti, Cuturi Cameto is a multidisciplinary interior and architecture studio with a focus on quality, creativity and collaboration. As a boutique practice, we take on a select number of projects that align with our values and vision. Our team is made up of designers and architects based in London and across Europe. Working with people in different places and with different perspectives brings a richness and variety to our work that we really value. Our services include space planning, interior architecture, interior design, and turnkey solutions. We also take on larger architectural work in collaboration with established architecture firms. We work closely with art advisors, and Eloisa brings a long-standing connection to the UK’s emerging art scene. We mainly work with property developers and private clients, delivering private homes, as well as full interior architectural schemes for buildings and show flats.

name: EY DESIGN
description: We are an interior design studio based in Tokyo, Japan. We specialise in residential interior design for private homes, holiday residences, and high-end luxury properties.

name: Emily Burnett
description: Emily originally trained as an architect and studied at the Royal College of Art. Working as an architect in parallel to a detailed interest in interiors her projects focus on a wholistic approach from exterior through to interior architecture and design giving projects a continuity from inside to out. Emily has experience in working on both commercial, public and in particular private residential schemes. She works closely with each client to establish a precise brief and aesthetic to give individuality to every scheme.

name: Emma Green Design
description: Emma Green Design is a leading London interior design studio with an intelligent approach and flair for distinctive style. Our studio is renowned for creating timeless residential designs, from a Mayfair apartment to a Surrey family home. Award-winning interior designer and BIID-registered member Emma has established a reputation for original ideas coupled with extensive colour knowledge. Our London interior design studio also creates a sense of authenticity in every project. Commercial work includes the Saatchi Gallery in Chelsea and a private polo club in the Royal County of Berkshire. With more than 20 years’ experience, Emma delivers truly bespoke interiors along with highly personalised levels of service. I specialise in creating transitional interiors for busy homeowners with families who may have upsized and don’t have the time to and aren’t quite sure how to transform their new spacious property into a stylish, functional home. I use my wealth of experience and skills to deliver a bespoke, curated design service via an established, trusted process. This leaves you free to spend more time doing the things you love in the beautiful surroundings of your family home.

name: Studio Hooton
description: Studio Hooton is an interior design practice with studios in London, Hampshire and the Cotswolds, established for over 15 years with projects based across the south of England and abroad.

name: Emma Wood Interiors Ltd
description: Emma's 25 years within the design industry brings value to any project big or small. Considering herself a creative, technician and professional project manager in equal measure striving for a seamless journey for her clients. Starting out as a buyer in the fashion industry then establishing a successful faux plant and flower company, Emma has worked across many areas of the design and interiors industry. "I see alot of commonality across the various area of design I have worked in over the years. Fashion and interiors have many parralllels...whether you are adorning yourself or you home, you still want to express indivuduality and style in a home that speaks truly of your tastes and aspirations." Emma’s design philosophy is to create liveable yet dramatic spaces that are individual to each client and setting. "I like a project to smile, to have charm and not take itself too seriously. Comfort, function, and finish always take priority". Creating a beautiful space is a bit like creating a painting. Working with a canvas and building up the layers of colour, textures, space, form, mood, atmosphere all framed by the architecture of the building and setting. "I like to blend old and new – be it antiques or paintings. This is what creates the atmosphere. One of the great joys of my work is trawling through fairs, markets, and sale rooms trying to spot items that are unique, quirky, or beautiful." Emma believes that interior design is the artful balance between creativity and prac

name: Emma Prest
description: Emma Prest is an architectural interior designer whose work moves fluidly between the architectural and decorative. With more than twelve years of experience in the world of interior design, Emma brings creative vision and and a sensitivity to how people live, creating interiors that are both functional and deeply atmospheric. Trained at the Inchbald School of Design, she spent over five years at Rose Uniacke before becoming Head of Studio at Hollie Bowden, leading a wide range of projects, from listed country homes to large private estates in Ibiza and the Bahamas. This breadth of experience shaped a versatile design approach: one that bridges architecture and decoration, balancing technical rigour with an intuitive understanding of composition and space. Emma works with clients across a range of interiors projects, with a focus on high-end residential design. Each commission draws on her trusted network of artisans and specialists across the UK and Europe, creating interiors distinguished by quality, craftsmanship and individuality.

name: Emmanuelle Sirven Ltd
description: Precision, Elegance, Praticality & Uniqueness . A Modern & Refined approach to Luxury With 26 years of experience world wide and a double degree in Interior & Spatial Design from France and London, Emmanuelle Sirven started her career in Paris and after 16 years, came back to London more than 11 years ago now. She ran one of the most famous practice in Paris, dealing with superb projects such as 5* hotels, beautiful homes, high end offices head quarters. She now develops her design from London with the same precision & expertise in Private & Publics spaces. From an international family & background, she lived between Paris and London and spend her summers in Spain since she was a child. This allows her to speak & work in the 3 languages with a lot of ease and it developed her curiosity, eagerness to discovery and ability to understand the others. Emmanuelle works with extreme care & professionalism, she is a very good listener and always making sure that she achieves the best result for her clients. Their satisfaction is her ultimate goal. If we had to describe her work, we would put forward: her recognised talent for details & the use of space and light her wild field of expertise her great ability to listen and understand her clients her ability to adapt to very different projects in style & size her ethos to works as sustainably as possible by keeping items that are not damaged or sourcing locally

name: Accouter Design (AGofC)
description: Since opening the studio doors in 2012, international award-winning residential Interior Design & Interior Architectural studio Accouter has produced unparalleled interiors for the most discerning clients in the world's most exclusive residences. Design Director Esra Kumbasar has an extensive track record in luxury high end interior architecture projects. Having completed multi-million pound schemes all over the world for high profile developers and private clients, Esra has diverse experience in some of the worlds finest residences. SERVICES CONCEPT CREATION Every project starts with a conversation. To understand your vision, we need to get to know you: your lifestyle, your hobbies and the passions that drive and inspire you. Only when we start to understand you can we present the ideas, designs, textures and materials that will form the cornerstone of our project. INTERIOR ARCHITECTURE Our clients won’t be held back by the limitations of space and form. Through creative exploration, we can adapt an existing residence or manipulate a new space to ensure a seamless living experience, where every corner is considered and life flows unhindered. INTERIOR DESIGN Our clients usually seek to capture something of themselves in a space: a sense of belonging, aspiration or historical narrative. Working with our network of artisans and global curators, we create environments that capture the threads of that narrative, perfectly balancing form and function and pulling them together to f

name: Falchi Interiors Limited
description: Falchi Interiors has spent the last 20 years building up a reputation for creating interiors that are unique and go beyond a client's expectations. Based in Berkshire and covering London and the Home Counties, our team consists of four interior designers including our founder Marion Falchi, and administrative support. Our ability to assess spatial awareness to best suit a client's lifestyle and the creation of cohesive interiors, co-ordinated from one room to the next and enhancing the illusion of light and space is our strength. We are a collaborative rather than dictatorial practice and every member of the approachable and enthusiastic team is involved in each project. This enables us to share ideas and keep our inspirations fresh and up to date. We offer a full and flexible service from original concept - whether ours or the clients - to project completion. Clients can choose to work with our tried and tested contractors or introduce us to their own teams, they can also benefit from our extensive address book of artisans and trade contacts. Recent projects have included a full interior/exterior design service for a multi-generational family home in Greater London; a refurbishment maximising light and space in a gated Victorian apartment in Knightsbridge; the total refurbishment of an iconic 1960s house with distinctive features overlooking Richmond Park and the refurbishment and modernisation of an 1820s stable in Albourne, West Sussex. To see more of our projects and disc

name: Filiz Capur Interiors
description: Filiz Capur is an award winning international architect and interior designer who creates elegant and refined spaces. With experience in both residential and commercial projects, she designs environments that are timeless and tailored to each client. Beginning her career in architecture, Filiz moved into interior design, offering a full range of services from planning to project completion. With over 20 years of experience, she has led teams in designing luxury hotels and homes, known for their attentive and personalised approach. Filiz’s design approach focuses on combining practicality with style, ensuring each space reflects her clients’ lifestyles. She brings together her architectural skills and creativity, making every project feel balanced and effortlessly inviting. Filiz Capur Interiors has worked on various projects, including Grade II listed homes, restaurants and boutique hotels, often using natural materials and warm tones to create comfortable, lasting spaces. Currently, Filiz Capur Interiors partners with homeowners on high-end residential projects. She also collaborates with property developers to elevate their projects with her thoughtful and detail-oriented design approach.

name: Fiona Andrews Interiors Limited
description: After initially studying History of Art at University, Fiona worked as an Events Organiser before retraining to follow her first love at the KLC School of Design. She launched her own company in 2003 and is the sole designer with a wonderful team of architects, builders, curtain makers, upholsterers and carpenters in her address book. "I enjoy collaborating with my clients to interpret their aspirations and establish what will work best for them. Each project is different and it is important to me not to impose a look. The plans and schemes I produce tend to combine classical and contemporary elements to create a comfortable, timeless, elegant and stylish home that reflects the people who live there". The business offers a complete Interior Design Service from planning to final installation including picture hanging and staging. We liaise with architects and builders, create plans, colour schemes; furniture and electrical layouts, supply curtains, source furniture, antiques and lighting and purchase every detailed item if needed. Attention to detail is key!

name: Sable Interiors Ltd.
description: Sable Interiors has been established design consultancy for 28 years and specialises in exceptional innovative design concepts for distinctive private residences. Our energetic and dedicated team of creative designers have a high level of professionalism and passion for their trade, together with many years' experience in innovative, individual and inventive design for both new build and refurbishment projects. We have an impressive collective knowledge of market requirements and current trends, ensuring impeccable product selection from concept through procurement to installation. Precise interior and exterior architectural features and decorative detail finishes are specified from vast experience, including contemporary integrated technology, such as home automation, domotics and lighting. Completely conversant with FF&E packages, we provide a full, comprehensive decorative specification, including space planning an storage solutions. Supply, delivery and installation is scheduled with seamless project coordination and close collaborations with architects and developers. By remaining highly aware of all aspects of the industry we have acquired a large portfolio of unique and very successfully completed projects.

name: Fiona Brass Interiors
description: Fiona Brass Interiors is an Interior Design Studio with an emphasis on residential homes and how they function on a practical level to create harmony every day. Our business and personal ethos is very simple; love how you live. By understanding our clients and listening to their needs, we look to create bespoke and timeless homes, that allow them to realise a lifestyle choice as well as being beautifully functional.

name: Drennan & Sturrock
description: Based near Ediburgh, Alistair and Fiona Drennan met at Christies nearly thirty years ago. Today, as Drennan & Sturrock, they offer a unique depth and breadth of experience to their clients. Over the years they have worked together or independently for Major Auction Houses, Fine Art Dealers, Private Clients, Commercial Orgnisations including Heritage Charities and an Award Winning Interior Desicn Practice. Fiona, a graduate of the Inchbald School, delights in breathing new life into period properties, often working with skilled makers and craftsmen and incorporating client's collections to produce sensitively elegant interiors for contemporary life. ​For the last twenty years Alistair has traded independently in fine and decorative antiques, specialising in the Country House Style and since 2009 regularly exhibiting at the Battersea Decorative Fairs in London,

name: Fiona Terry Designs Ltd
description: Fiona graduated from the KLC School of Design with an Honours certificate. She has worked in Interiors since 1986 when she set up and ran D T Interiors, the first design practice to be linked to an Estate Agency. Since then, she has worked on numerous residential projects, both with individual clients and high end Property Developers. Her style is simple, calm, sophisticated and timeless and she has a keen eye for detail. Her early years in Scandinavia inspired her love of space, subtle use of colour, light and understatement. A perfectionist and workaholic, Fiona is passionate about design. No project is too big or too small. Her services include every thing from straightforward design consultancy to full project co ordination and turnkey services. With many years of experience, she is expert at optimizing all available space, as well as advising on furniture, fabrics, floor coverings, soft furnishings, lighting, AV, and even gardens.

name: Fiona Watkins Design Limited
description: Fiona Watkins Design offers a friendly professional approach and a wide range of services for both private clients and developers including; space planning, project co-ordination, procurement and installation. Fiona brings extensive knowledge and a creative style to help you achieve your ideal living environment with schemes that are appropriate, functional and aesthetic. Emphasis is placed on individual requirements, lifestyle and budget to create homes that reflect and enhance the lives of those who live and work in them. Our commissions cover a variety of styles, from country houses to city apartments, barn conversions to contemporary new builds. Each project is different and unique and we believe that the ability to listen and interpret our client' s needs is the key to great results. Fiona works with a variety of skilled craftsmen and women, including cabinet makers, glass manufacturers and stone masons and has established successful partnerships with kitchen and bathroom companies in order to offer a complete project package. At Fiona Watkins Design we are as enthusiastic about your project as you are and our dedication, and attention to detail will ensure every success.

name: Interior105
description: Interior105 is a South London-based interior architecture and design studio working on design projects from family houses to modern city apartments. Francesca has studied and trained in Milan (Italy), working on a variety of design projects across art, interior, and architecture. After gaining experience working with award-winning design studios, together with Laura, a highly skilled creative director, and designer, she founded interior105. We offer interior design services to private clients, developers, and architects throughout the UK. Our full turnkey solution allows us to consult, manage, and deliver at every stage of a project, from concept through to completion, we provide a safe pair of hands with whom to collaborate and establish your perfect vision. Interior105 is known for creating clever design solutions that are both practical and beautiful, ensuring that your home celebrates your story and improves the way that you live, every day. Our projects cover: - Private home renovations - New Build Homes and apartments - Show homes - Marketing suites and communal areas - Creative direction

name: Garry Meakins Studio
description: Garry Meakins Studio is an Interior Design Practice based in the Cotswolds. We work with individual clients and businesses throughout the UK & Europe to create original interiors, furniture, lighting and products. HOW WE WORK First and foremost, we listen. In fact we have a discussion. At the core of every project is a brief that is the touch paper. During the briefing stage understanding the clients history, ethos and goals is critical. Enhancing this brief is our role. Communicating our design is important. Very important. As a project develops, we must accurately and clearly communicate our thoughts to the client. Running side by side, our methods of communication are verbal, written, visual and numeric. Choosing the best method allows clients to commit with ease, not become overwhelmed and ultimately be excited to see the outcome. In equal measure we believe in: CREATIVITY Each brief is unique, so should be the outcome. DILIGENCE Without diligence creativity is an un-tameable beast. EXPERIENCE Without experience we cannot be diligent nor can we implement creativity.

name: Studio Arden Ltd
description: Creating calm, restful and elegant design in both contemporary and more classic forms I love to create beautiful spaces that reflect my clients individuality and to do this using beautiful materials and exceptional finishing - its a collaboration between myself and them.​ ​

name: Fuse Studios Ltd
description: I’m Gemma Evers, a commercial interior designer with over 30 years experience. I create bespoke interior environments that are human-centred, enhance wellbeing and improve the effectiveness of the space and therefore your business. I focus on delivering long-lasting, high-quality solutions that have a low environmental impact. I collaborate with architects, interior designers, property agents, project managers, building contractors or directly with property owners, immersing myself into your business to become an extension of your team, delivering projects from concept to handover. I value above all else, sustainability, collaboration and creative solutions.

name: Humble + Humble
description: Welcome to Humble + Humble, a RIBA chartered architectural and interior design practice. We’re a family business run by two sisters, creating extraordinary homes with built-in happiness. You are in good hands with Humble + Humble; we’ve earned a reputation for handling projects with professionalism, expertise, innovation and great care. We offer a full architectural and interior design service, and through close collaboration with you, we’ll bring out the very best in your property. With the highest quality service as our baseline, we can then work with you on an enjoyable creative process that will transform your home and the way you live.

name: G & Co Interiors Ltd
description: Our founder Georgie Magpie, vintage obsessive, colour lover, Georgie founded G&Co after a decade crafting luxury interiors in the Cotswolds. Her projects have been showcased in prestigious publications such as Homes & Gardens and The Times. Trained at Falmouth University, Georgie is known for her warm, confident schemes, playful combinations, and a carefully curated mix of contemporary and vintage pieces, art, books and other treasures that bring her designs to life. Our approach We like to get to know our clients really well, but after that it’s up to you. If you want to be involved from start to finish, let’s do it. We’ll bounce ideas off you, whether it’s during office hours or not. We’ll take you to vintage fairs, art shows, auctions and markets. Or we can be briefed by you, go off and start work, and present you with design concepts. That suits us too. Whichever way, you always get our hands-on involvement and enthusiasm – and guidance. We can manage projects in their entirety for you, from planning, through construction, to completion. However you like to work with us, we will make it effortless (and enjoyable). Wherever possible, we partner with local and family-owned businesses, working alongside talented tradespeople to provide a superior experience for our clients.

name: Georgina Gibson Interior Design
description: Based in Lewes, East Sussex and working across London and the South East of England, Georgina employs her artistic skills to produce exciting and innovative designs exploring the full potential of every building. It is vital to Georgina and her team that, in addition to their designs looking beautiful, the schemes really work for clients, so they place great importance on listening carefully to establish the reasons for doing the work and what the clients hope to achieve, and build around this. Georgina Gibson Interior Design also offers a full Project Coordination Service and the team enjoys collaborating with clients, contractors and other consultants. With many years of experience, they have a wealth of knowledge to share and an amazing network of very talented creatives and suppliers, who supply bespoke kitchens, cabinetry, soft furnishings and furniture. Georgina and her team create beautiful, comfortable, joyful places, in which their clients love to live and work.

name: Studio Clementine Limited
description: ALCHEMY OF DESIGN Our Philosophy Interiors should not be the product of ephemeral style trends, but of a client’s own personality and preference. Studio Clementine takes a collaborative approach, both between client and studio, and in terms of the many specialist skills and suppliers our designers bring to a project. We pride ourselves on listening to what people want and then surpassing expectations both creatively and in delivering a seamless, personal service. GEORGINA WOOD Founder & Creative Director Friendly, discreet and accessible, Georgina Wood engenders a feeling of mutual trust and respect that defines the DNA of Studio Clementine. Over twenty-five years, she has honed her talents working for award-winning, interior design studios where she has been involved with every type of project imaginable, from international private residences, ski chalets and elite residential developments to multi-starred hotels and flagship retail. Having trained originally in Interior Architecture, she brings together both a mastery of physical space and an undiluted passion for fabrics, finishes and furniture. She is well versed in taking a blank canvas and transforming it into a unique and beautiful interior, while paying meticulous regard to budget and deadline.

name: Gill Wilkinson Interiors
description: Established in 2010 Gill Wilkinson Interiors provides a full Interior Design service for both residential and commercial clients across North Yorkshire, County Durham and Teesside, bringing a unique blend of creativity precision and a personal touch to each project. 'Whether you're looking to transform your home or enhance your commercial space, we're committed to delivering results that will exceed your expectations. For us it's about creating spaces that re both beautiful and functional, tailored to the unique needs and tastes of each of our clients.'

name: Gillian Rogerson Design
description: GILLIAN ROGERSON DESIGN was established in London in 2000. Since its inception, many beautiful interiors have been created for our private and corporate clients within the United Kingdom, South Africa and Australia. Our established network of trusted specialists ensures the highest quality of workmanship and an eye for detail which is apparent in all of our projects.

name: Koubou Interiors
description: Gilly graduated in 2002 from the Regent Academy with a Diploma in Interior Design with Distinction. She initially tutored at the Bracknell and Wokingham College in the Adult Education Department teaching Fashion and Interior Design to Diploma level. Gilly started Koubou Interiors in 2004, opening the studio in Crowthorne after a complete refurbishment of the building. Gilly joined the British Institute of Interior Design as a student working through the Professional Pathway to become a fully Registered Interior Designer. The practice gained Registered Practice status in 2016. She works with residential and commercial clients in London and the home counties to help them curate spaces that work for them. Gilly has sat on various committees and working parties for the BIID: Working party for the writing of the CID 14 BID contract Panel overseeing Industry Partner CPD CPD Committee CPD Director on Governing Council President of the Institute 2018-2019 Gilly was the Director of the BIID for four years (2016-2020) helping to develop and oversee both the long- and short-term strategic direction of the Institute. She is currently heading up the awards working party. Gilly also speaks at various industry events on the subject of designing for an ageing population, especially focusing on design constraints imposed by Dementia and other disabilities. Gilly understands the need to work with Koubou Interior’s clients in realising their vision from initial idea to completion.

name: Giulia Adams Interiors
description: Giulia Adams provides a bespoke interior design service in London and the Cotswolds. She works closely with her clients to produce individual interior design schemes that complement the building and fulfil the client's brief and budget. Her artistic eye and professionalism bring to life the spaces she works on. Giulia has worked as a designer for over 25 years and has a wide range of experience of residential and commercial interiors, including listed buildings and new build schemes. She studied at University College London and the Royal College of Art and worked for well respected architects and designers before setting up her own practice. Her combination of art history education, architectural training, experience of interior design and knowledge of artists and suppliers, allows her to create unique and inspiring environments for her clients. She believes that interior design affects us all in profound ways, as the interface between architecture and people; it is what you see, feel and touch, and skillful orchestration of its' elements will create beauty, harmony and pleasure.

name: Godrich Interiors
description: The studio was founded in 2003 by lifelong friends, Creative Director Ed Godrich and Finance Director, Rupert Hunt. Over almost two decades, the company has completed hundreds of projects around the world. Rupert is assisted by Directors and Senior Designers Megan Oliver and Sarah Coetzee, our two design teams run all interiors projects. While Ed’s new career as an artist blossoms, he has left an indelible mark on the company after 20 years of design direction. Megan, an Associate Director, has been an integral part of Godrich since 2009, leading numerous local and international projects. Her clients return to Godrich time and time again for her bold aesthetic style and creative design solutions. Her exceptional eye for detail and strong relationships with trades and suppliers ensures a smooth and enjoyable process for all involved. Megan’s respect for architecture, coupled with her instinctive flair for pattern and colour means that every project is individually tailored to each client. Sarah, also an Associate Director, joined Godrich in 2013, bolstering the team with experience across all aspects of the design process. Her highly bespoke and memorable projects have been achieved by a skillful balance of creative design aesthetics and exceptional project management. Each project is undertaken with strong design integrity and a passion to deliver something unique and distinctive that consistently exceeds client expectations. Godrich Interiors has broken the mould for high-en

name: G Method Limited
description: After graduating with distinction from the Interior Design Department of Mimar Sinan University in 2001, Gokdje completed her master's studies at the Department of Industrial Design in the same university in 2005. Having worked in different fields of design for over 20 years in various design practices, Gokdje decided to explore the opportunities available in London. After moving to London, she started to utilise her professional expertise to provide her design services as G Method Ltd to individuals and companies for residential and commercial projects.

name: GLSTUDIO
description: Founding Partner of GLSTUDIO, Gordon Leney is an architect and interior designer with twenty-five years experience in both fields. He applies a design approach that blurs the boundaries between the disciplines, and has worked in a number of sectors including private residential, cultural, workplace and hospitality. Gordon Studied at the University of London, Chelsea College of Art and Design and The Royal College of Art and was visiting lecturer in the department of Interior Design at Chelsea College of Art and design for ten years. Gordon established GLSTUDIO in order concentrate particularly on the private residential market. The studio adopts a holistic approach to architecture and interiors, celebrating the re-use and re-invention of existing buildings. By exposing the layers of a site’s historical use, we apply a sensitivity to issues of heritage, whilst overlaying a rigorous contemporary aesthetic. Our approach is collaborative and analytical, delivering non-formulaic solutions which underpin our clients’ aspirations and restore a sense of authenticity and meaning to the buildings they inhabit.

name: SPELK.
description: SPELK. is a North East studio that designs interiors, homewares, soft furnishings and lifestyle goods. Our work begins with context - how things are used, lived with, worn in, passed on. We design for real rooms and real lives, not for trends or quick impact. Our specialisms are kitchens, fitted furniture and bespoke pieces. Everything we make is shaped by place, memory and material: Northern industry, coastal weather, domestic rituals, the beauty of things that last. Utility matters. So does pleasure. We believe objects should work hard and feel good doing it. SPELK. has been featured in Living North, KBB Review, Design Week, and many other publications. Recent awards include Best Startup in County Durham, Sunderland and South Tyneside at the North East Business Awards 2025, and Best Industry Newcomer at the BKU Awards 2026. SPELK. also founded Mixer, a networking event for interior designers and suppliers in the North East. SPELK. founder Graeme Smith has been an interior design professional since 2007 and is the BIID ambassador for the North and North West region. For more about Graeme, see https://www.graeme-smith.co.uk

name: Studio G Interior Design Ltd
description: Gulcin White is the founder and creative director of Studio G Interior Design Ltd. Her style is timeless, elegant, and eclectic covering both modern and traditional interiors with ease by drawing inspiration from her much travelled past, her love of nature, art and architecture. Gulcin completed her degree with honours in Interior Architecture in Prestigious the Art Institute of Fort Lauderdale in USA. Across the USA and UK, her extensive 23 years of experience, covers work of high-end residential and commercial projects, completing designs for both architectural and interior design firms internationally before launching her own Studio in 2013. ​Gulcin, as creative director, also serves as the mentor to all employees encouraging a collaborative studio environment. She makes sure the studio has a hands-on approach in the creative process from concept to completion. Studio G believes your home is very personal; you spend a majority of your life there, si it should reflect who you as a person. We would like to learn as much as possible to help curate a home that is completely in harmony and tailored to them. Therefore our interiors are never repetitive and evolving creations. She is fascinated with new innovative technologies and trends, and she will adapt this into the design seamlessly.

name: GA Interiors
description: Gwendoline will create your dream home that looks stylish and feels fantastic. Her designs emphasise health and wellness, so that your home is organised and nurturing, helping you to feel calm and relaxed after a busy day, whilst also being practical and invigorating to entertain with family and friends. Whether you’re looking for neutral balance or a pop of colour, Gwendoline will add a flourish of style to personalise your home. Her elegant designs have been showcased in UK interior design magazines, including House Beautiful, Real Homes and The Sunday Times Home. Gwendoline’s creative vision and expertise enables her to design and fashion your sumptuous, stylish, organised and attractive home. She’ll ensure your home is balanced and cohesive so that it’s an elegant space, with modern gadgets, to enjoy in comfort. With her heart in every project, attention to detail and exacting standards, Gwendoline is dedicated to creating your dream home. As a Colour Expert, Kitchen Designer, Bathroom Designer, Space Planner, Interior Stylist and Project Manager, you’ll feel confident in her breadth of knowledge and expertise. As a professional Interior Designer and Author, Gwendoline is frequently sought after to be the expert speaker at interior conferences and design events. This includes Grand Design Live, the Affordable Art Fair and the Country Living Magazine fair. Areas of Work: Gwendoline covers London (Kensington, Chelsea and Victoria), as well as Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire, an

name: Horton & Co Ltd
description: Horton & Co. is a family business run by creative directors Gillian Handley and Hannah Burton. We work on projects throughout the UK and internationally, offering a complete design service. During our 30 years in business we have built close relationships with a select group of exceptional artisans, specialist trades and product suppliers, preferred architects and landscape designers.

name: Barclay Briggs Interior Design
description: “We are passionate about creating beautiful, comfortable spaces which enhance our client’s life and style” Barclay Briggs Interior Design studio are passionate about creating timeless, liveable interiors tailored to each client’s unique lifestyle. Our approach to interiors always starts with our client and how we can help improve your space. Working together, we guide you through the creative process. We listen, offer solutions and push boundaries. Our love of great design and beautiful objects, together with our decades of technical expertise, enables us to create carefully balanced interiors, crafted specifically to you. We draw on our in-depth knowledge of interior architecture, flow and function, lighting design, finishes and colour schemes to enhance our client’s space and your quality of day to day life. Our little black book of industry contacts allows us to save our clients both time and money when it comes to creating the perfect interior. We work across both Residential and Commercial sectors, to a variety of budgets, delivering all stages of Interior and Architectural Design from first concept to completion. “We believe the spaces we occupy must create joy – both in making day to day tasks easier and making us feel happy through light, colour and beauty”

name: Harriet Anstruther Studio Ltd
description: Harriet's multi-disciplinary Architectural Interior Design Studio is flexible and eclectic. The studio is just as comfortable and capable of designing a country home as a contemporary commercial space, a book as an exhibition. Traditional and modern styles regularly co-exist harmoniously within the studio' s work. Harriet is a member of the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID), whose Best Practice contracts and systems run hand in hand with the RIBA. She is a member of the Development Advisory Board at the Victoria & Albert Museum, a Committee Member and Ambassador for the Royal Academy and consults for among others, the Design Museum and Yohji Yamamoto. She is actively involved in the Brompton Design District, which runs in conjunction with the annual London Design Festival. Harriet is a visiting lecturer on the Interior Design MA at the Royal College of Art, and has been commissioned to write a book about her design process for publication in October 2013. In 2012, Harriet was a Finalist in the SBID International Interior Design Awards.

name: Jam By Hedayat Ltd
description: Biography Principal Designer & Founder- Jam By Hedayat Founding Partner – Eklego Design After spending twenty years as a founding partner at Eklego Design in Cairo, where she specialized in both residential and commercial interior design, Hedayat founded her UK based interior design business: Jam By Hedayat. It quickly became a comprehensive design destination thanks to her two decades of experience and her passion for handcrafted furniture and original designs. Together with her team, she works on projects in both the UK and Egypt. www.jambyhedayat.com

name: Hill House Interiors Ltd
description: Helen Bygraves and Jenny Weiss, co-founders of the multi-award winning international design consultancy Hill House Interiors, have established a flourishing award winning design practice, which is one of the most recognised in the UK today. Impeccable attention to detail and their love for luxurious and innovative materials, combined with their own collection of couture furniture, has become the signature at Hill House Interiors. Helen and Jenny are supported by a highly skilled team of designers and craftsman, who share their passion for perfection, glamour and timeless elegance. Recent award wins include The Andrew Martin International Designer of the Year Award, and project awards at The Design and Architecture Awards and The British Homes Awards. Hill House Interiors are finalists in The SBID International Design Awards 2014.

name: Nested Living
description: Nested Living is a design-and-make studio led by Helen and Bruce Gordon. Our team of designers and makers work collaboratively to create homes, interiors, and crafted pieces that nurture wellbeing and bring natural materials to life. From finely made one-off furniture to whole-home refurbishments, we design and make with care so that your space feels grounded, harmonious, and connected to place. With over sixty years of shared experience, we bring together creative vision, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of materials. Specialists in timber, we continually explore regenerative and low-toxicity materials, reuse our own offcuts, and follow circular making processes that allow materials to have renewed life through thoughtful design and craft. Guided by regenerative principles and a commitment to ecological responsibility, honesty, and care we bring design and making together under one roof. This integrated approach ensures quality, integrity, and transparency from the first conversation to the final installation. Our work has been recognised through awards and publications, including the BIID Awards, The Guardian , and Sanctuary by Design .

name: At Home by Design
description: Helen's design story begins by looking at the world we live in. She has a keen interest in the world, culture and how we connect with our environment, having lived, studied and worked in the UK, Singapore, the US and UAE. With additional exploration of more than 65 countries, she has gathered inspiration and ideas from travel. She believes that exciting designs are created when you juxtapose interesting elements together: old and new, cultural cues, colours and texture. She has a passion for history and heritage, and believes we can respect our past, connecting with it, while developing something new and exciting, creating harmony between form and function. Helen holds degrees and professional qualifications in interior design, journalism and history, and has been in the industry for around 17 years. At Home by Design is based in Surrey.

name: Design by Five Ltd
description: Design by Five is an interior design consultancy for businesses specialising in private client services. Creating authentic, enjoyable and timeless spaces shaped by location, character and purpose rather than passing trends. Thoughtfully considered environments enrich everyday experience and quietly reflect the quality, care and confidence behind every client service.

name: Balance Interior Design
description: Gemma Tucker is the founder and creative director of Balance Interior Design, an award-winning interior design studio set on the Wiltshire-Somerset border. With a decade of experience, Gemma and her team create spaces that are grounded, quietly atmospheric, and designed in harmony with their context and the people who live within them. Her core belief is that truly beautiful, liveable homes lie in balance, between form and function, fragility and strength, symmetry and asymmetry, old and new. Through restraint, Gemma creates spaces that feel calm, generous, and effortless, where architecture, art, craftsmanship, and everyday life each have room to be enjoyed. The Balance team enjoy collaborating with architects, trades and trusted craftspeople to bring her designs to life, resolving every detail to create enduring, beautiful, and functional homes for her clients.

name: Mabel Fox Ltd
description: Mabel Fox is a full-service interior design practice based in Cambridge, specialising in thoughtfully designed family homes that are both beautiful and highly functional. From period renovations to contemporary new builds, the studio delivers tailored interiors that reflect each client’s story while guiding projects seamlessly from concept to completion.

name: Speaking of Interiors Ltd
description: Speaking of Interiors is a South West London-based interior design studio known for creating beautifully balanced, functional spaces with a strong sense of personality and purpose. Founded by Johanna Endres-Castillo in 2020, the studio offers a full range of residential and commercial interior design services - from space planning and scheme development to full project management - with a focus on bespoke, client-led solutions. With a passion for both aesthetics and practicality, Johanna brings clarity, structure and creativity to every project. Whether redesigning a family home in Clapham, styling a contemporary apartment in Fulham, or rebranding a café in Streatham, Speaking of Interiors works closely with clients to craft interiors that feel authentic, cohesive and elevated. The studio’s design approach is collaborative and considered, placing equal value on how a space looks and how it supports everyday life. With a warm, contemporary aesthetic and a strong eye for colour, texture and proportion, projects are characterised by their calm, layered feel - often blending existing pieces with new design elements to create a natural evolution of the client’s style. Speaking of Interiors is proud to serve a diverse client base across South West, West and Central London, delivering interiors that are as practical as they are beautiful, and as personal as they are timeless.

name: Studio Yarner
description: Led by co-founders Laura Graham & Hianta Cassam Chenai, Studio Yarner is an interior architecture & design practice based in the South Hams, Devon. With over 20 years combined experience in residential and commercial design, including leading projects at internationally acclaimed Martin Brudnizki Design Studio and Nicola Harding & Co, Studio Yarner offers a comprehensive interior & architectural design service from concept to completion, underpinned by a meticulous attention to detail. The studio specialises in producing authentic and timeless designs, creating spaces that are inviting and joyful. We draw inspiration from a diverse array of elements - from our passion for antiques and a love of colour, to an appreciation of architectural history, art and our local surroundings. Collaborating closely with our clients, we deliver spaces which reflect their character, passions and stories, and that of their unique properties.

name: Spencer-Churchill Design Ltd (t/a Woodstock Designs)
description: Founded in 1981 by Henrietta Spencer-Churchill, Woodstock Designs is a well established interior design company specialising in the renovation and restoration of classical and listed buildings as well as new build homes. We operate from two outlets, the main shop and office based in Woodstock, Oxfordshire and a studio/office in Fulham, London. Many of our projects involve a complete structural refurbishment and we work closely with our clients and other professional advisers researching the historical background and designing a cross section of architectural features in order to restore houses to their former glory, whilst incorporating modern facilities. The service includes a complete package from space planning and all aspects of building work to furnishings, including antiques, pictures and accessories. Woodstock Designs have carried out many projects in the USA and more recent projects include new build houses in the UK, USA, Russia and worldwide; each room and architectural feature is carefully planned to optimise the use of space, whilst adding character and authenticity to a chosen style. For more information, please contact one of our team of designers: Tel: 01993 811887 Email: oxford@woodstockdesigns.com

name: Henry Prideaux Interior Design
description: BIOGRAPHY Founded by Henry Prideaux in 2014 and recently relocated to a refurbished studio by the River Thames in the heart of Twickenham, Henry Prideaux Interior Design is an independent practice offering professional design services for private residential and boutique commercial clients. Our aim is to create genuine homes that are both beautiful and practical, designed with a deep understanding of our clients’ lifestyle needs. Every project is an opportunity to craft something unique, whether that’s preserving original features in traditional schemes or embracing a more characterful approach for contemporary spaces. With an impressive portfolio filled with innovative design ideas and creative solutions, the team works with an enviable network of trusted suppliers, craftsmen, and specialist decorators. This ‘little black book’ of experts ensures that every project is executed to the highest standards, always offering clients the unexpected and extraordinary. Henry is known for creating elegant and authentic spaces that blend different design styles. His approach combines timeless classics with a modern twist, resulting in interiors that feel fresh and enduring. SERVICES INTERIOR DESIGN: Furniture, fabrics and finishes, bespoke furniture, art and antiques sourcing, styling and procurement. INTERIOR ARCHITECTURE: Spatial planning, bespoke joinery, architectural detailing, and kitchen and bathroom design. ADDITIONAL SERVICES Lighting and audio-visual design, project management

name: Hestia Smart Living
description: Hestia Smart Living is a multidisciplinary studio specialising in interior design, lighting design, home automation and project management. Our philosophy is simple - to design beautiful, functional environments, that enhance the way people live. Hestia brings together designers, engineers, and project specialists who share one vision, to create homes that are both beautifully designed and intelligently built. Our collective experience allows us to translate ideas into spaces that feel grounded, elegant, and quietly innovative. Every project begins with understanding and ends with detail. We design homes that feel natural, connected, and entirely personal. Spaces that quietly elevate everyday living.

name: Nomura Co.,Ltd.
description: After graduating from the Department of Spatial Design at Musashino Art University, worked at an architectural and design firm specializing in ryokan and hotels, where I was involved in everything from hospitality concept planning to interior design. I joined Nomura Co., Ltd. in 2023 and has been a Professional Member of the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID) since 2016.

name: Studio Asterix Interior Design Ltd
description: Based in our London Studio, our award-winning team work with a global client base from private clients to luxury property developers, specialising in Private Residences and Residential Developments. Our aesthetic is clean and bright, we create tailored interiors with an understated style that enables us to make luxury design feel personal, considered and packed with energy.

name: House of Bennet Interior Design
description: House of Bennet is an international interior design studio, based in Zurich/Zug – Switzerland. After many years of design experience, HoB was founded, where a strong sense of architecture and design is a hallmark of the work, which has developed through the passion for art & history, and how they can be reflected into an interior. The design philosophy is shaped also by travelling and learning from the richness of different cultures. The portfolio comprises mainly residential projects in Sweden, Switzerland & UK, and some commercial. Partnership with excellent craftsmen and artists, as well as thorough preparation, is the successful formula for attaining high quality, and timely completion within budget. We offer turnkey interior design, interior architecture, project leading, art selection & creation, bespoke built-in solutions, textile design and furniture design for private individuals, businesses, architects and developers. Every space and client differ. We approach each project with an open mind and recognize each client’s unique requirements. We steer away from convention or fads, to create truly interesting and unique spaces with a meaningful, functional and timeless style that stands out from the crowd, but always feel like home. We tell the story of your home by creating your interior by paying tribute to and reflect the owner’s experiences through an expression of art, furniture, textiles, materials or collected objects that creates meaning. Additionally, to conside

name: House of Red
description: Welcome to award winning House of Red Interior Design studio. Specialising in residential design we offer services from design consultancy, FF&E Interior Design, through to Luxury home staging and show homes. We create unique and original interior design for your property whilst also providing practical design solutions. Our team has built great relationships within the industry from supply chain, contractors and agents. Our valued knowledge and experience mean with approach each job with a unique and personal service to you, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience with us.

name: Kelly Hoppen Interiors
description: With over 40 years’ experience at the forefront of the design industry, Kelly Hoppen is one of the most celebrated and sought after interior designers in the world. It was her relentless passion for design at sixteen years old that kick-started her iconic career. Kelly’s globally renowned and ever-evolving style is defined by a subtle fusion of East meets West; clean lines and neutral tones, intuitively balanced with an opulent warmth. Kelly’s portfolio boasts a diverse selection of projects spanning the last four decades. Kelly's team have put their stamp on the homes, yachts, hotels and jets of private clients all over the world, including the highly sought after and exclusive addresses in China on Shenzhen Bay to the most impressive cruise ship to date with Celebrity Cruises Edge Class; redefining sea travel. Kelly is honoured to be the recipient of copious design awards and in 2009 was made an MBE for her services to interior design.

name: Inclume
description: Inclume is a creative architectural studio that delivers bespoke, crafted design projects. Our designs embody an interest in natural light, material quality and crafted finishes, a perspective that we believe produces architecture that is contemporary yet contextually sympathetic towards its surroundings.

name: LUXURIOUS INTERIOR DESIGN
description: PHILOSOPHY our design philosophy is simple: interiors matter. they matter because they influence how we feel, how we act and how we live, often without us realising it. INTERIORS MATTER Our behaviors are constantly evolving and, these days, we spend around 90% of our lives indoors: in homes, where families evolve; in restaurants, where grand romances begin; in schools, where growing minds are nurtured; and in offices, where we work towards our dreams. These, and many more, are the backdrops to life’s most memorable moments and each one has a significant impact on us, some without us even realising. And, so, we create interiors that matter—the kind of interiors that are worthy of life’s memorable moments. WE TRANSFORM THE ORDINARY INTO LUXURY We understand two things very well. We understand interiors and we understand luxury. Interiors because our training and experience have taught us what it takes to create a successful one; and luxury because it’s the very DNA of our brand. By combining the two, we fulfil our ultimate commitment to our clients: to transform the ordinary into luxury. Whether that’s faultless finishes and exquisite exotic materials or the absence of excess and a focus on raw craftsmanship, capturing the luxury for our clients is what drives us. DESIGNING WITH CARE We believe the best designers are those who design with empathy; the ones who work hard to understand their client and the project. Designing with empathy requires a careful understanding of each o

name: Ida Wadhams Ltd
description: Interior design has been my world for my whole life, and there is nothing I love more than bringing a home to life. While I have spent the last 15 years professionally transforming spaces across the heart of London, my focus is always on the person behind the door. Growing up in Sweden taught me that a home should feel like a warm hug — I bring that same cozy, lived-in feel to every project.

name: Ava Rose Interiors
description: At the heart of my work is a deep belief that our spaces should nurture us, mind, body, and spirit. As a Biophilic Interior Designer, I bring together a love of nature, a passion for beautiful, thoughtful design and a genuine connection with people. With a warm, collaborative approach and a keen eye for detail, I help clients create interiors that feel as good as they look. Spaces that breathe, grow and bring the outside in. From vision to execution, I guide each project with care, creativity and calm, ensuring every step feels seamless and inspired.

name: Henri Fitzwilliam-Lay ltd.
description: Seeing the true potential of a property is the key to all of HFL Ltd’s projects. We enjoy transforming spaces and using our client’s possessions to make a cohesive story. “It is all about a careful edit, looking for inspiration everywhere and never dismissing things out of hand.” The studio advises from concept through to completion, on all aspects of the design process. Designing layouts as well as working with architects, choosing finishes, specifying lighting and ironmongery is just the beginning. Known for her discerning eye when it comes to sourcing new as well as vintage and antique furniture the studio designs and commissions many bespoke pieces all of which makes HFL’s interiors unique and a joy to live in. Collaborating with a group of trusted craftsmen the studio oversees the entire process. Known for referencing from the past and adding modern twists so that the finished project can never be dated to a specific time. “I want a client's house to relate back to who they are, to be recognizable as their own, and pull this together in such a way that it shows the very best of their collections in a fresh and beautiful home.”

name: Holla Design Ltd
description: Our homes are much more than a base... They’re spaces to create, to entertain, to be together, to relax, to work and to love. At Holla Design, we work with busy couples, individuals and families who want to invest in their home, but don’t have the time or headspace to manage every decision themselves.​ Our considered design process delivers personal, joyful, design-led interiors, while removing much of the overwhelm and stress often associated with home renovations. We guide our clients through every stage with clarity and confidence, creating homes that are not only beautiful, but genuinely work for modern, busy lives. ​ Holla Design was founded in 2021 by Holly Lamont, following her relocation to Cheshire from London, where she worked for two of the capital’s leading interior design studios, Goddard Littlefair and Tara Bernerd & Partners. During this time, Holly developed a strong technical understanding of the design process, a professional and collaborative approach to client management, and a refined eye for timeless, high-quality design.​ Known for her personable approach, Holly takes time to truly understand her clients, exploring how they live and the emotions they want their home to evoke. Her work is characterised by a confident mix of colour, pattern, texture and thoughtful layering, alongside a considered approach to furniture sourcing. At the heart of every project is a belief that homes should promote well-being and respond sensitively to their surroundings - pr

name: Kate Lovejoy Interiors
description: At Kate Lovejoy Interiors, we believe great design isn't just about how a space looks - it's about how it feels to live in. It shapes your day, supports your routines and helps you feel at home. With a background in film, where story is told through light, colour, mood and detail, we bring that same depth to interior design. Since 2009, we’ve helped over 200 clients at life’s crossroads create homes that feel personal, confident and truly lived in.

name: Miriam Frowein Interiors Ltd
description: Established in 2018, Miriam Frowein Interiors is a London-based boutique interior design studio creating highly personal, characterful interiors in the UK and internationally. Formerly a corporate lawyer specialising in real estate and finance, Miriam brings a considered and individual approach to each project. Rather than adhering to a signature house style, the studio creates bespoke interiors shaped by the client, architecture and setting. Contemporary art and collectible design are central to the studio’s work. Miriam’s knowledge of the art world and relationships with galleries and artists enable the studio to offer art advisory alongside interior design, sourcing and commissioning works from emerging and established artists. Vintage, mid-century and contemporary pieces are layered with bespoke craftsmanship to create distinctive, timeless interiors. The studio works on a select number of projects each year, allowing Miriam to remain personally involved from concept through to completion. Projects span London, the English countryside, Switzerland and the South of France, with many commissions coming from repeat clients.

name: Rossi Studio Ltd
description: At Rossi Studio, we blend modern elegance with timeless sophistication to create personalised spaces that truly reflect your identity. Our client-centric approach ensures meticulous attention to detail, delivering high-end designs without excess. Trust us to transform your house into a home that inspires beauty, functionality, and a profound sense of belonging.

name: Strive For Design
description: Leigh Hall and Strive For Design was established in 2016 and has built a strong reputation in the interior design industry. The company operates from a stylish showroom in Newmarket, UK, and offers services to clients throughout the UK, including Cambridge, Newmarket, London, Poole and Dubai. Leigh emphasizes a personalised approach to each project, ensuring that the unique needs and preferences of clients are met while considering the existing space and budget. Leigh prides herself on its client-focused approach, ensuring that each project is tailored to the individual client's needs. Leigh and her team provide detailed design proposals, including samples and CGI visuals, to help clients envision their spaces. The company aims to alleviate the stress often associated with renovation projects by offering professional guidance and support throughout the design process. The showroom at Strive For Design features a variety of products, including lighting, furniture, wallpapers, and home accessories. It serves as a "living showroom," allowing customers to visualise potential designs and products in a real-life setting. The company collaborates with over 450 suppliers to provide unique and high-quality items for their clients. Leigh demonstrates a strong ability to adapt to a wide range of interior environments and design aesthetics, confidently styling and curating spaces across diverse briefs. Capable of interpreting and delivering any interior style, ensuring each scheme is coh

name: Studio JKL
description: Most homes are stitched together one decision at a time. I'm brought in before that happens — working alongside your architect, builder and specialist consultants from the earliest stages, so every decision serves one complete vision. You're used to being the one people rely on — the calls, the problems, the decisions that keep everything moving. A renovation shouldn't be one more thing added to that list. With twelve years delivering multi-million-pound interiors for some of London's leading studios — including Taylor Howes, Kathryn Levitt Design and Hubert Zandberg Interiors — I founded Studio JKL on one belief: a home isn't shaped by hundreds of good decisions. It's shaped by whether they all serve the same one. We take on a small number of projects each year — full house renovations and smaller projects alike, across London, Surrey and the Cotswolds — so every client has my full attention, start to finish. Because the greatest luxury isn't excess. It's certainty — a home ready for every version of you and your family, never led by trends.

name: Tania Azadian Interiors
description: Tania, a London based interior designer established Tania Azadian Interiors Ltd in 2016 and runs the business from her studio in Wimbledon Village. Prior to setting up her own company she worked for globally renowned interior designer Kelly Hoppen as a Senior Designer and Account Director for 12 years. She has a wealth of experience in the luxury high-end, residential and commercial market worldwide, being involved in various high profile projects including hotels, yachts and working with property developers as well as with numerous UK and international private clients. Tania Azadian Interiors is passionate about providing their clients with a professional and personal tailor-made design service, working closely with the client as well as architects and contractors to create the perfect space that is individual to each of their needs, requirements and expectations. Tania designs and oversees each project from concept right through to completion, ensuring the utmost attention to detail and personally delivering a high end, high quality bespoke turnkey interior. With Tania’s strong values of honesty and integrity that shapes every aspect of her work, she believes in building transparent relationships with clients, ensuring they are fully informed and involved throughout the design process. By communicating openly about budgets, timelines and design choices, she cultivates trust and teamwork, striving to ensure the process is smooth and enjoyable from beginning to end.

name: Urban Interiors
description: With over a decade of experience in both commercial and residential interior design, I bring a finely tuned eye for detail and a creative spark to every project. My work blends finesse with personality—always polished, never predictable. I’m drawn to rich, earthy tones and timeless materials that evoke a sense of understated luxury. From bold urban statements to classically British elegance, I create spaces that are stylish, soulful, and made to be lived in.

name: Interiors By Ingrid Ltd
description: Ingrid Sirova is a BIID Registered Interior Designer specialising in high-end residential interiors and interior architecture across Cheshire. Based in Macclesfield, she founded Interiors By Ingrid Ltd to offer a personal design service, drawing on 20 years of experience to create homes shaped by their architecture and the people who live in them. Her work encompasses complete home renovations, bespoke interiors and selected individual room transformations. From spatial planning and architectural detailing to kitchens, bathrooms, lighting, cabinetry and furniture, each element is considered as part of a cohesive whole. Every project is personally designed by Ingrid. She takes time to understand her clients’ priorities, tastes and daily routines, translating these into interiors that balance elegance with comfort and practicality. The design responds to the individual property, with careful attention to proportion, natural light, materials and craftsmanship. A background in fashion design, followed by interior design studies at Liverpool John Moores University, informs her understanding of textiles, colour and detail. She works closely with architects, skilled craftspeople and specialist suppliers to develop bespoke pieces and bring each scheme to life. Ingrid guides clients through the design process, from initial concepts and spatial planning to final installation and finishing touches. Her portfolio spans period properties, country cottages and contemporary family homes, re

name: Interior Design CH
description: Since 2011, transforming homes & changing life-style. For us, small details can make a real impact when designing a space, but only a true professional knows how to bring these details together to create a seamless design. Here is where Interior Design CH comes in. Cynthia has steadily grown as a renowned Interior Designer in the United Kingdom, Australia, Portugal and Brazil, an expert in creating interiors that impress. With high expertise in intelligent solutions for homes, kitchens and nautical. She offers a different range of services, such as Interior Design services with refurbishment or the project with a consultation. Also, our team works with a high-end quality 3D image render for retail companies. Bespoke design is integral to the CH approach. Every facet of the project can be custom-made to ensure that the client's needs will be realised, with unwavering creativity and the finest quality assured. Would you be ready for a transformation? Contact us today to discuss your plans, we'll love to hear them.

name: Oakeve Limited
description: Located in Buckinghamshire, this award winning Interior Architectural design practice was founded in 2004 by Iona Newton and has built up a formidable reputation for creating sumptuous, inspirational schemes with a commitment to delivering exceptional design services. Having been acknowledged by the industry as operating at the forefront of luxury property design and development for over a decade, Iona and her team of experienced designers, offer a unique 'turnkey' service that is personal, convenient and accountable, managing every aspect of your project, from conceptual design through to completion.

name: Irenie Studio Ltd
description: A highly creative studio working on the widest possible variety of visionary projects with residential clients, other designers and established brands. The studio naturally has a bespoke approach to every project, relishing the fact that each object, building, space and person is utterly unique. Based in London we collaborate with an extensive network of creative minds, artisans and crafts people to build and make beautiful works. We have over twenty years of experience in architecture and design, colour and styling and curating. Irenie is originally from Dublin and graduated from the Architectural Association in 2001.

name: DOTS & POINTS
description: DOTS & POINTS is an interior architecture and design studio working on full-scope renovations and turnkey design projects from family houses to modern city apartments. As Wassily Kandinsky once said "Everything starts with a dot". We manage the projects from start to finish: from the first to the very last dot. We strongly believe that by managing the whole process we remove the stress out of the clients’ minds making the journey to their dream home much easier. DOTS & POINTS covers everything needed to support the clients from initial concepts and technical design to sourcing, installation, and final styling. Identifying our style as a blend of classic and contemporary, we develop elegant and refined timeless interiors. We love mixing vintage and modern, working with colours and light, balancing patterns and textures. We are all different as are our homes. That is why our interiors are eclectic and unique but always echo the client’s personality so that they can feel it is truly their home. We always start with an idea and a thoughtful spatial design as there is no beauty without function and comfort. We believe that good design is about understanding. Clients’ aspirations and day-to-day needs together with our professional expertise transform their properties into individually tailored homes. name: Burbeck Interiors
description: Burbeck is an interiors, client focussed design studio. It specialises in creating innovative luxury interior design schemes, market leading home-staging and bespoke turn-key furniture solutions across the UK and Europe. Founded in 2013 by brothers Jack and Alex Willcocks, the company benefits from their extensive experience in property development and interior architecture. Their deep understanding of planning, budgeting, management and timeless design, combined with a holistic approach, has established the team as a leader in creating spaces that seamlessly blend functionality and style to the highest standard. Our multi-skilled team can assist with a wide array of interior services from Home Staging & Show Homes, Curated Furniture Packs to full bespoke FF&E Interior Design and Interior Architecture Schemes, all fully managed and designed in house by our SBID and BIID accredited award-winning team. As of Summer 2024 the company has also launched its e-commerce interiors store – Burbeck At Home.

name: Ampersand
description: With over 30 years international experience Jackie brings inspiration, creativity and practicality to every project. Each design is individually tailored to reflect the personality and lifestyle of the client. Jackie has built a team of expert designers establishing Ampersand as a leading design studio specialising in interior design, interior architecture and bespoke furniture creating luxurious, liveable and individual interiors for both private residential and commercial projects across the UK and abroad.

name: Design Haus Architecture
description: James is an award-winning architect who has completed a large number of projects internationally and across the UK.
