Ranging from private homes, home extensions and new builds to commercial buildings; James prides himself on his ability to accurately translate his clients vision into reality whilst suggesting innovative new ideas from the world of architecture to produce uniquely tailored designs. Drawing on his knowledge from his years working for prestigious architecture firms; James uses his expertise and knowledge to deliver exciting residential designs to private clients using the latest technology. His use of virtual reality within the design process is ground breaking. James is one of just a handful of individuals who is both a qualified and chartered interior designer and architect. “I believe a successful project is defined by how unique and personal a design can be to a client. I love communicating with clients about their ideas and dreams of a space - It's why I started Design Haus and its why I love working as a designer.” James has won many prestigious awards, including best 'Residential Project' for the East Midlands in the regional RICS Awards 2022, 'Best Residential & Small Commercial Designer' at the LABC Buidling Excellence Awards for the East Midlands, and has also been nominated for ‘Young Architect of the Year’ at the Building Design Architect of the Year Awards 2022. One of James' recent projects was featured in Grand Designs magazine - see a video of the

name: 23 Architecture and Interiors
description: For Jan Norman, RIBA BIID, architecture and interiors are encompassing and interwoven disciplines, shaped as much by intuition as by precision. Jan has been integral to the growth of 23 Architecture and Interiors since joining the practice in 1998. She is now a Director, leading the interiors side of the practice. Having lived in Glasgow, Florence and Berlin before settling in London, Jan’s varied experiences have shaped a layered design language that brings together tradition and contemporary expression. With nearly three decades of experience creating and delivering one-off homes for discerning clients, she brings a breadth of knowledge and a holistic approach to every project. Architecture and interiors are conceived as one, resulting in spaces that are individual, cohesive, refined and designed to endure. The practice is known for creating spatial, sculptural and light-filled projects. Its collaborative and sensitive approach ensures that each client’s individuality is thoughtfully reflected throughout the design. Jan specialises in creating elegant, timeless interiors that seamlessly integrate with architecture. Working closely with her team, she delivers a holistic design service, ensuring that every element of a project, from spatial planning and architectural detailing to the selection of furniture, lighting, fabrics and finishes, contributes to a cohesive and refined aesthetic. Her thoughtful approach and meticulous attention to detail have helped shape some of the p

name: Jane Churchill Interiors
description: Having started her career working with Colefax and Fowler nearly thirty years ago, Jane opened her first shop selling her own range of fabrics and wallpapers. This company was sold to Colefax and Fowler in 1989, but she continues to run her own interior design business in Pimlico Road. She has a large portfolio consisting of residential properties and executive offices throughout the UK, as well as projects in Ireland, France, Spain, New York, Florida, the Caribbean and Russia. Jane combines her wealth of knowledge, experience and contacts to achieve the best results for her clients. Working closely with a small dedicated team (she employs six staff), they provide an efficient and personal service, together with continuity which results in clients repeatedly seeking their expertise. Jane is well known for her 'English Country' style ; partly due to the influence of her great-aunt Nancy Lancaster; however, she has the ability to combine traditional with modern to create comfortable interiors to reflect the 21st century home.

name: Studio Louca
description: At Studio Louca, our vision is to design distinctively luxurious interiors that transcend time, bringing together sophistication, opulence and tradition. Led by Janine Loucaides, Studio Louca curates expressive spaces that embody the unique character and lifestyle of their residents, infusing every detail with depth and passion. We believe in the daring elegance that emerges as a harmonious equilibrium between classical craftsmanship and curiosity-driven contemporary designs. Our philosophy is to preserve traditional artisanship, valuing the rich heritage of skilled craft as an essential aspect of our work, while also striving to create new legacies through our progressive outlook. With an unwavering dedication to quality and discretion, we design spaces that inspire, nurture and reflect the legacies of our clients.

name: EDGE. Design & Fit Out Ltd
description: Creative Director – EDGE. Design & Fit-Out As Creative Director at EDGE. Design & Fit-Out, I lead the creative vision across all our projects — ensuring every space we deliver is both functional and visually compelling. With a background in interior architecture and over a decade of experience in the fit-out industry, I’m passionate about creating environments that not only look great but truly work for the people who use them. My experience spans a wide range of sectors, including workplace, hospitality, and education, with a strong focus on sustainable design, materiality, and long-term usability. I work closely with clients to fully understand their vision and needs, and I collaborate with our project managers and on-site teams to ensure that every design is delivered with precision and intent. Alongside my commercial work, I spent six years as a university lecturer at both the University of Huddersfield and the University of Salford. During that time, I mentored and guided emerging design talent — something I’m still deeply passionate about. Supporting the next generation of designers continues to inform my approach and keeps me connected to new ideas and perspectives within the industry. For me, great design is always about more than just aesthetics — it's about creating spaces that inspire, perform, and stand the test of time.

name: Limited Editions Interior Design Consultants
description: Jennifer Truman has over 30 years experience in the world of bespoke interiors and has been a BIID member since 1993. Offering a unique and personal interior design experience for the individual client. My team and I have worked on London town houses, Lutyens & Voysey manor houses, Wells cottages, Georgian & Victorian listed buildings, eleventh century hall houses, new builds and yachts in the UK and abroad. We are a special turnkey project team that will take care of your project from its earliest inception, thus removing the stress and confusion often associated with refurbishment projects. My studio at Limited Editions in West Sussex is conveniently located for all your needs, however, we can also meet to discuss your project at your home or office or online. We have a dedicated, professional and flexible team to suit your needs. We design without limitations either contemporary, classical, themed, funky or an eclectic mix. In conclusion, whether you are daunted by a blank canvas, have too many conflicting ideas or have a problem area, Jennifer & team are here to help.

name: Hill House Interiors Ltd
description: Helen Bygraves and Jenny Weiss, co-founders of the multi-award winning international design consultancy Hill House Interiors, have established a flourishing award winning design practice, which is one of the most recognised in the UK today. Impeccable attention to detail and their love for luxurious and innovative materials, combined with their own collection of couture furniture, has become the signature at Hill House Interiors. Helen and Jenny are supported by a highly skilled team of designers and craftsman, who share their passion for perfection, glamour and timeless elegance. Recent awards include wins at The Design and Architecture Awards, The International Property Awards and The British Homes Awards. Consistently over the last decade Hill House Interiors have been featured in the Andrew Martin International Designer of the Year Award and have also been the winners and finalists in the Design et Al awards, The International Property Awards and The SBID International Design Awards.

name: Jess Lavers Design
description: Located on Radnor Walk, a stone's throw from the Kings Road, you will find us in our light, airy studio. Established in 2011, we offer a high level of experience and professionalism to our valued clients. We specialise in both high-end private residential and luxury commercial projects. Our passion for detailed concepts and our meticulous attention to detail, allow us to deliver design solutions which are highly bespoke and immaculately planned. We are able to optimise client investment through our close relationships with trusted teams of architects, builders, carpenters and expert suppliers. Jess Lavers Design hand pick the perfect team for each job ensuring we deliver on time and on budget without compromising the quality of the work. Whether you want to be fully involved in your project or would prefer to be handed your set of keys on completion, Jess Lavers Design offers a friendly, personal, trustworthy service.

name: Jessica Brook Design
description: Jessica Brook Design Ltd is headed by award-winning interior designer Jessica Brook. Jessica is recognised by the industry for her creative approach and sophisticated aesthetic sensibility, creating elegant interiors of understated luxury, with attention to detail, emphasis on the use of natural materials, layering of texture and the combination of classic and contemporary styles. Based in West London and working on Residential, Commercial, Hotel and Leisure projects the company's services encompass Architectural Interior Design, Interior Decoration, Furniture and Product Design. Projects can vary from concept schemes through to full scale interior architectural refurbishments and decoration. Developing your project brief they will produce concept mood and sample boards, visuals where required, working drawings and written specifications. Over the years they have built up a strong network of consultants, suppliers and craftspeople who work with them to develop their designs into bespoke products and finishes unique to their interior. Jessica Brook Design increase the value of the investment of your project by working closely with Associate Architects, Surveyors, Contractors and other contacts within the build project, developing the overall design and working to maintain consistency and integrity throughout its execution. The results are beautifully conceived, detailed and executed interiors with atmosphere, a sense of growth and understated luxury.

name: Jo Ahmedzai Interior Design Ltd
description: London-based Interior Design studio Jo Ahmedzai is renowned for its exceptional creative vision and pure, simple designs that place functional use and extraordinary comfort at the core. With a holistic approach, Jo Ahmedzai's simple mission is to design beautiful spaces that invite human interaction and ensure the well-being of those who inhabit them. Each of our projects captures the essence of our studio identity, where designs are passionately crafted using our love of natural materials, fine attention to detail, and refined taste. Functionality forms the starting point for everything we do; durability and comfort are long-lasting results. Across both residential and hospitality sectors, we delve into each project's narrative, add layers of meaning, and meticulously ensure no detail is overlooked. With a questioning approach, we quickly learn to understand the client and discover the foundations of their brief. We respond to this with designs that engage the senses, looking to inspire them in a way they could not have imagined. From the initial design to the final construction and styling, we provide our clients with the perfect balance of technical knowledge and design expertise.

name: Joanna Trading Ltd
description: Joanna Wood established her eponymous interior design practice over 40 years ago. Since then, it has evolved into an internationally acclaimed studio, with a young and vibrant team of designers renowned for its work on both contemporary and historic projects. Based in Belgravia, the firm comprises a team of 15 talented professionals and supports a well-established retail presence on Elizabeth Street. The studio’s client base includes private clients and individuals, institutions, property developers, and investors with extensive experience spanning the restoration and renovation of a wide range of public and private buildings, including notable collaborations with English Heritage, The National Trust, and Historic Houses. Recognized as a leader in her field, Joanna is a Fellow of both the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID) and the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA). Her distinguished career has been honoured with numerous accolades, including the BIID Award of Merit in 2021—the Institute’s highest distinction, as well as a regular entry into H&G top 100, Andrew Martin Review and Design et Al 2024 award winner. Joanna is a founding partner to several design businesses including Lewis & Wood fabrics and wallpapers, and Lawson Wood bespoke upholstery.

name: Harmony Design Ltd
description: Located near Bournemouth on the South Coast, Harmony Design Ltd. creates bespoke interior design solutions for homeowners and hotels. We specialise in interiors that blend luxury, functionality, and well-being, with a focus on inclusive design that enhances every user’s experience. Our collaborative process includes photo-realistic visualisations, so clients can fully explore their space before work begins. Led by Director Joanna, with 18 years of experience in luxury interiors, we deliver everything from full builds to layout design, FFE selection, and bespoke kitchens and bathrooms. Projects are tailored to each client’s lifestyle, preferences, and budget. We can manage every stage from concept to completion or provide design-only services if preferred. Working closely with expert craftsmen, we prioritise clear communication, thoughtful planning, and respect for our client’s vision, creating interiors that exceed expectations and stand the test of time.

name: Joel Azevedo Interiors
description: Joel Azevedo is a boutique West London studio specializing in traditional interior design for period homes . We focus exclusively on creating authentic, beautifully collected interiors for Victorian terraced houses , Georgian townhouses, and Edwardian properties across Chelsea, Kensington, Fulham, and beyond. Founded by Brazilian-born designer Joel Azevedo, our studio brings a unique, internationally informed perspective to London's heritage architecture. We believe that true luxury lies in a playful, sophisticated fusion of contrasts—effortlessly blending deep respect for British architectural history with a vibrant, intuitive appreciation for color, texture, and natural light. Our signature aesthetic does not feel "staged"; instead, it feels richly layered, lived-in, and beautifully curated over time. As a boutique studio, we deliberately select only a limited number of residential projects at any time. This selective approach guarantees that you work directly with our principal, Joel Azevedo, who personally oversees every phase of your home’s transformation. We offer a comprehensive, turnkey service that handles the entire, daunting complexity of a period property renovation: Period-Appropriate Spatial Design: We redefine internal layouts, design detailed lighting plans, and produce precise technical drawings that respect and enhance your home's original proportions. Heritage Feature Restoration: We collaborate with conservation specialists and master craftspeople to caref

name: Studio Materi
description: Studio Materi is a London based interior design studio, creating timeless and elegant spaces which reinterpret the relationship between the architecture, materiality and interiors delving into the essence of a building to make each space feel liveable and personal. Co-founded by Johanna Molineus & Veronika Keegan, architect duo with extensive experience in high-end residential and commercial projects, Studio Materi emerged out of their shared passion for minimalist, paired down aesthetics, harmonising the traditional with the contemporary. Both Johanna and Veronika are certified with Architectural Registration Board and British Institute of Interior Design. Together, they believe in the importance of building's heritage and honouring its history while challenging the rules to push boundaries of architecture and interior to make each room liveable, personal and complete. Each project has its own identity, harnessing the client’s essence and collections. Yet each, too, feels distinctly Materi: timelessly elegant, harmoniously designed, and made to be both experienced and admired.

name: John Amabile Design Ltd
description: John Amabile is best known as one of the UK’s leading designers, with regular appearances on TV and in the press. A qualified interior designer, John completed his initial Design training in Glasgow and began his professional career in London as part of a creative team concentrating on retail and leisure design. He then diversified into Film and Television Production design before adding ‘Home’ interiors to his specialist range and his design portfolio and on screen work. Now, John’s key focus is in using his expertise to create made design solutions for commercial projects, hotels, leisure, show homes and private homes. John’s easy going and professional manner make him the ideal person to take clients through the latest trends and styles for perfect home living. He truly loves design – and to help others create their dream rooms!

name: JB-ID
description: Northwest based hospitality designer with experience in hotels, pubs, bars and restaurants, I have more than a decade of experience working with big brands and independents alike. Overseeing the entire project from visualisation, concept development and planning right through to on site co-ordination; I treat each project as a completely unique experience with a bespoke service. The same branded interior in 2 locations are 2 totally different jobs with each, project, building and scheme having their own challenges to be addressed.

name: Orium Design Limited
description: With a broad variety of clients and previous experience within the design industry, the Orium team approaches all projects with creative flair and strong technical detail. We build strong working relationships with our clients whether landlord or tenant adding measurable value, embracing their future. The company focus has always been to deliver measured value through innovative design solutions, collaboration and personal experiences, resulting in strategies relevant to a changing and diverse global market. Built on our love of design, culture and consumer behaviour we strive to create environments which generate real connections.

name: Absolute Project Management London Ltd
description: Jo is an enterprising Interior Designer, working at Absolute Project Management, leading some of their largest renovation projects and heading the Brighton practice. Jo is passionate about creating homes that are both a pleasure to live in and that make highly effective use of space, by applying both her visual creativity and analytical problem-solving skills – as well as her experience living in compact properties in London & Brighton. Jo brings leadership, business operations knowledge, and client service skill from her previous successful career in digital media. This is invaluable in managing complicated projects and helping clients to navigate the technical detail of their renovations.

name: Q Design House
description: Q Design House is a full-service design & management firm, from overseeing property builds and refurbishments through to the final finishes and furnishings. Based in Richmond and Sunningdale, our award-winning team are experts in interior design, interior architecture & project management to take you through your design journey from beginning to end. Though our design services can be offered to clients as a stand alone offering, we also oversee construction end-to-end using our own in-house design and build team, including architectural drawings and planning permissions as well as guidance throughout the regulatory processes which completes our design management service.

name: James Roberts Interior Architecture + Design
description: James Roberts is known for crafting thoughtful and elegantly resolved spaces – guided not by fleeting trends but by meaning and enduring values. We serve clients and professionals who share our principles, building long-term, trusted relationships. As a project cornerstone, we deliver a complete interior design and realisation service. BIO: A qualified engineer with formal training at both Sandhurst and London’s Royal College of Art, James identifies as a designer without label. After a career spanning product design, sports fashion at NIKE, packaging and furniture design, he found his specialism in interior architecture in 2008 and founded the practice. A perceptive and intuitive thinker, James’s rare blend of technical and creative ability sits at the foundation of his signature work. Today he leads a small, talented team united by his belief-driven, craft-focused approach to creating thoughtful, enduring spaces. His award-winning work is recognised by peers and press, with features in Wallpaper and Elle Decoration , even exhibiting at the Louvre. A passionate advocate for the creative process, James engages in design discussion, guest speaking and is a proud member of the BIID.

name: Txengo Studio
description: Ju-Wei Chen is the founder and creative director of Txengo Studio, a London-based design consultancy specialising in high-end residential, hospitality, and experiential environments. Her work is defined by a refined design language, cultural sensitivity, and a commitment to creating spaces that feel purposeful, elegant, and emotionally resonant. Before founding Txengo Studio, Ju-Wei gained international experience within the luxury travel and hospitality sector. Shaped by over two decades of global exposure including formative immersion in heritage rail and premium transport design her human-centred approach blends craftsmanship, storytelling, and atmosphere. She leads Txengo Studio with a clear vision to create spaces that balance elegance with emotion, modern living with cultural memory, and design with lasting meaning.

name: JM INTERIOR DESIGN
description: JM Interior Design is a well established and respected Interior Design practice based in Richmond, Surrey, focusing on mid and high end residential projects mainly in South West London and Surrey. Jude works very closely with her clients to translate their ideas into living spaces that reflect their requirements and personalities. She creates harmonious designer led spaces, layering pattern, colours and textures together to create beautifully considered and balanced rooms for her clients. The practice offers a full range of interior design skills required for the complete refurbishment of a client's apartment or home, including architectural floorplan design, kitchen and bathroom design, bespoke joinery, window treatments, upholstery, soft furnishings and accessories. With over 18 years of experience, Jude has built up a trusted and well known network of suppliers and contractors, and can provide a turnkey solution to any residential project, no matter how small or how large.

name: Julia Grant Interiors
description: Julia Grant Interiors is a award winning Scottish-based interior architectural design studio specialising in luxury residential and commercial projects for private clients, property developers and corporate clients throughout the UK and abroad. The firm offers a wide range of interior architecture and design services to meet the clients expectations. Founder Julia is a designer with over 20 years experience in both commercial and residential interior design. She has previously worked within various design and architecture practices working on projects across Scotland as well as projects in London, Australia and Dublin prior to setting up Julia Grant Interiors 9 years ago. Julia established Julia Grant Interiors design studio with an objective to create individual well crafted interiors. The company carries out architectural interior, as well as graphics/branding projects and can take on projects from concept through to completion.

name: Julia Twigg (PTY) Ltd
description: Julia Twigg trained at the Inchbald School of Design. She has been Chairman of her own company for over 18 years and specialises in residential and executive office work. She has worked in England, Spain, Hong Kong and all over South Africa. Her style is mainly traditional and modern. She has also designed the interior of two yachts in the Mediterranean. In South Africa she has done the interiors of Game Lodges, Trout Farms and Stud Farms.

name: Juliet Taylor Design Ltd
description: 30 years as a versatile and creative experienced Interior Designer, and team, in all areas from interior architectural design, CAD construction drawings and building project management with an introcate fabric and furnishings knowledge. We design in appropriate style or period appropriate to brief set. Have been interior designer contracted to the Houses of Parliament 1998 to date, with over 20 years and over 200 projects carried out on the Parliamentary Estate ranging from Lords committee rooms (contemporary), historical interiors in the Pugin Bar and Members Dining Room, many Members offices and Westmnster Hall Government Secndary Chamber. We offer the full range of architectural interior design skills and meet budgets and deadlines.Designer of houses, hotels, shops, restaurants, offices, nightclubs, conferences and exhibitions. Working in London, Bath and West Country. Mission statement: Design projects should be an enjoyable process for client and designer.

name: Juliette Byrne Ltd
description: Juliette's Chelsea based architectural interior design consultancy has established a reputation for creating elegant and sophisticated interiors which blend the classic with the contemporary. Juliette graduated from The Chelsea School of Art and then trained at Conran. Juliette has been successfully nominated as one of the Top 100 Leading Designers in the UK by House and Garden from 2006 - 2018. Her residential Chelsea Townhouse project won the Best Single Unit at the International Property Awards in 2017. Juliette's Richmond family home project was also featured on the front of Homes and Gardens in the April 2018 issue. She is a member of the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID) and a RIBA affiliate member. Whether coordinating a building site, managing an office of designers, liaising with leading architects and surveyors or managing clients property portfolios, Juliette's efficiency and attention to detail has been a driving force in her 30 year career as an architectural interior designer. Her philosophy that nothing is too much trouble coupled with an ability to find opportunities within space and existing designs where others might see flaws helps bring clients back time and again. Expect serene interiors, often executed with a muted palette, specially designed bespoke furniture, and a deft blend of old and new.

name: Juju Interior Designs Ltd
description: With over 35 years of experience in the field, I have worked across a wide range of spatial design projects, including retail, commercial facilities, offices, and residential environments. In 2006, I established my own interior design studio, which became an incorporated design office in 2012. Since then, I have been involved in a variety of projects, from private homes to commercial spaces. After working as an interior designer at a major housing manufacturer, I realized that standardized home design often leaves both the suppliers and the homeowners feeling unsatisfied. This insight inspired me to become a freelance interior designer, focusing on creating truly personalized living spaces that reflect each client’s unique needs and aspirations. Drawing on a woman’s perspective and an international network, I propose optimal spatial designs that enrich daily life. I believe that being surrounded by favorite art pieces, decorative objects, flowers, and plants brings joy and inspiration. By incorporating elements that appeal to all five senses-such as sound, scent, light, and breeze-I create spaces that offer comfort, relaxation, and excitement. I specialize in designing custom-made furniture and am passionate about blending traditional Japanese aesthetics with contemporary design. My approach combines refined style, carefully selected materials, and practical functionality to create furniture that complements and enhances the overall space. Above all, I value each client’s ind

name: Ambiance Interior Design
description: Karen McKimmie, director of Ambiance Interior Design, is a graduate of Edinburgh College of Art. She worked with Sylvia Lawson Johnston for 10 years and has run Ambiance since 1999, acquiring the company in 2007. Karen's style is predominately classic contemporary but the experienced design team at Ambiance are comfortable working on both traditional and contemporary projects. Ambiance work on jobs of every size and on every aspect of interior design from initial architectural conception to the last finishing details of a completed project.

name: KISoriano Interior Design
description: KISoriano Interior Design Studio is an international interior design practice operating as a specialized collective across London, Abu Dhabi, Manila, and Shanghai , a deliberate framework established to seamlessly serve clients across the UK, USA, and the Middle East . Recognizing that time is your most finite luxury, our cross-border network orchestrates complex international procurement and project logistics with quiet discretion. We manage the complexities seamlessly in the background, ensuring an effortless experience from inception to handover. Founder and Creative Director, Karen Isabel Soriano-Hristov steers the creative vision of the studio with a clear-sighted focus, directing a design philosophy that has captured the attention of leading industry tastemakers. A Member of the British Institute of Interior Design and a BIID Registered Interior Designer® her methodology was forged within the world’s most prestigious interior design houses, including David Collins Studio, The G.A. Group, and Laura Hammett . This extensive career spanning the United Kingdom, Asia, and the Middle East has instilled a signature rigour across the studio’s entire output, fusing technical precision with a contemporary sensibility. The studio designs through the lens of how you live, balancing intelligent function with a deep respect for local context and architectural heritage. This thoughtful approach has earned swift editorial acclaim, highlighted by features in House & Garden and Designeer

name: Mond Design Interiors
description: At Mond Design Interiors, we believe your home should tell your story—a place that’s welcoming, layered, and full of character. Every project begins with listening: discovering what you love, how you live, and what makes a space feel like home to you. Drawing on a timeless and thoughtful approach, each interior is carefully layered with furniture, textiles, and details that bring warmth, personality, and elegance to every corner. The result is a home that feels effortlessly beautiful, deeply personal, and uniquely yours. If you’re ready to create a home that reflects who you are, I’d be delighted to help bring that vision to life.

name: YAM Studios
description: We are a boutique design-focused design studio specialising in residential interiors. From our studio in Covent Garden we work closely with our clients in a collaborative process to produce beautiful and calm spaces. We have extensive experience creating full design packages for self build and renovation projects, which include kitchen and bathroom design, materials specification, lighting design, space planning, joinery design, as well as the specification of furniture and accessories. Our belief is that the home should be a soothing and balanced place where you can relax and forget the busy world outside. Careful use of natural materials combined with beautiful textures allows us to create warm and inviting interiors which feel calm yet rich. Working closely with our clients, we listen and understand their needs in order to create an environment which is curated to their lifestyle.

name: KBID Ltd
description: An architectural background, considerable experience working with top designers and 18 years running her own business, has given Kate the expertise to execute a wide variety of design commissions. Kate prides herself on her attention to detail and her enthusiasm for each project she works on, however large or small. A variety of commissions, from rural barns, to London penthouses to luxury yachts, illustrate Kate's original, innovative and flexible design style. From the choice of materials, finishes and products to the fusing of the modern desire for technology and leisure within the home, Kate demonstrates how it is possible to combine the need for a timeless, highly functional living or working environment with a sophisticated, and comfortable space.

name: Kate Malone Interiors
description: Kate Malone leads a high-end residential practice based in Kent, working across London and the South East. A former Cap Gemini Ernst & Young management consultant, Kate tends to be called in for complex, non-standard or troubled projects - combining genuine design intelligence with the structure and commercial rigour of a consultant. She works with a small number of large projects at a time, leading each from concept through technical design, procurement and installation, alongside her proprietary Property Strategy Roadmap for clients planning significant property decisions.

name: HUB Architects and Designers Ltd
description: Kate has worked in Design for over 30 years. She has lead the Interiors Department at HUB Architects and Designers for 14 years. Kate’s work is timeless, focussing on the essence of good design. She gains inspiration through listening to her client’s interests, lifestyle and what is important to them, while she unearths a building’s history, its’ context and surroundings. Having been involved with the restoration of many listed buildings, she has a broad knowledge of Conservation in Architecture. Her approach is sustainable and respectful, with a desire to preserve and enhance. Kate’s design is underpinned by her sound technical experience. As Co-Director of an Architecture and Design Practice, she understands the craft of building, in particular for conservation projects and listed historic buildings. She can deliver carefully detailed drawings for construction, fine joinery and lighting. She is able to specify the best interior products informed by regular visits to Tradeshows, Art and Craft Fairs and Galleries. Kate also has a passion for Antiques and historic references, integrating an eclectic mix of old and contemporary furniture, fixtures and fittings. Above all, Kate’s greatest pleasure is to create places where people will love to be.

name: Katharine Pooley
description: Katharine Pooley is an internationally recognised, multi-award-winning Interior Designer, with a studio established for over 22 years. Katharine’s Interior Design and Interior Architecture Studio crafts exceptional, luxury projects for a discerning clientele, where every element is thoughtfully curated with masterful precision for an outstanding service. The Studio’s work spans from private residential, hospitality, and commercial interior design and interior architecture, to collections of furniture, lighting, decorative home accessories, and Objets d’Art from her boutique in Walton Street. Projects are global and range in scale and style, from country estates, historical palaces and traditional castles, to contemporary homes, hotels, luxury spas, modernist beach villas, ski chalets, private jets, and yachts. Overseeing her team of 49 interior designers and interior architects, Katharine’s approach ensures every detail of every project and product is perfectly realised and impeccably ﬁnished, appealing to a client base that seeks a deeply bespoke and detailed service, tailored to unique needs. Katharine is a champion for cherishing, promoting, and nurturing British craftsmanship, as well as utilising local artisanal skills for projects overseas. Philanthropy and sustainability are equally important dimensions of Katharine’s work; she applies to her many charitable pursuits the same drive and determination with which she undertakes her design projects. The in-house sustainabi

name: Katharine Rutherford
description: Understanding the importance of the home environment, and being able to identify client's specific needs to achieve something truly personal is my main aim. I specialise in homes that function well for busy families, mixing modern and traditional elements, to produce a style that won't date, and I particularly enjoy space planning. As well as being an experienced kitchen and bespoke cabinet designer, I offer a complete design service for all areas of the home. I spent 3 decades working for, and then owning, Gramlick Designs Ltd. with my business partner Chanelle Begnett; I am now a one-woman band, collaborating with a wide and trusted circle of craftspeople, industry suppliers, and builders. I work very closely with Steven Booker Kitchens, based in the Cotswolds, and display a large collection of fabric pattern books and accessories in their beautiful showroom.

name: Katie Malik Studio Ltd
description: Katie Malik brings years of diverse interior design experience to the home improvement industry in her Cambridge based studio. After graduating from Cambridge University as a linguist specialist, she began her new training in Interior Design at Chelsea College of Art in London and the National Design Academy. Katie’s work has received a lot of recognition and was awarded by Lux and the UK Property Awards. Additionally, her work has been featured in the Ideal Home Magazine and Houzz editorial articles, as well as her appearance on the d-list in 2019. She became a finalist at the Grand Designs live in 2018. Being experienced in the design field for years has brought Katie to an interest in creating books showcasing her works; ‘Love Your Space’ and ‘Home Interiors: Adult Colouring Book’ are two of them, which cover multiple home interior designs she had previously worked on. Katie and her team’s goal is to transform stressful homes into peaceful, nurturing spaces for growth and success. The KMI team stays extremely organised and very detail-oriented, having exceptional planning and design skills for new, spatial ideas. Katie is skilled in furniture, finishes and fixtures selection, and project management. Katie and her team are problem-solvers, and everyday, they strive to build a safe, sustainable, innovative and healthy environment for their clients. KMI stands by and commits to designing luxury spaces for life.

name: York Design UK LTD
description: York Design Studio offers a fully comprehensive service. Our designers manage the whole project from initial brief to delivery. All aspects of a scheme are considered and supervised. Professional: Boasts several professional construction teams, who have rich experience in the UK. Management: Safe construction practices and modernised construction management. Focus on the reinforcement of the construction team’s collective strength. Low price: Offer being transparent to customers, thus freeing them from effort and worry; guarantee in material quality and no jerry-build. Integration: Provide integrated services such as carpentry, electricity and electrical wiring, water, gas, fuel gas, central heating and boiler services, plumbing, alarm systems and CCTV and others. Service: Eliminate the blind spots for customers relating to design and construction, and communicate with customers in a timely manner during construction, .which ensures a transparent and positive experience.

name: Kelling Designs Ltd
description: As a well-established international interior design company based in London and also in Norfolk, we have over 20 years' experience of working closely with numerous clients on residential and commercial projects. We are known for our vibrant and friendly approach, efficient reliability and impeccable quality, never failing to provide a first-class service whilst always adhering to budget requirements. As a result a large portion of our projects have come through referral or repeat business from delighted clients. Our specialist interior design and property expertise is focused on two distinct markets. For our private clients, we produce highly personalised, inspirational interior design. For estate agents, property developers and private landlords, we prove our deep understanding of their requirements by offering a range of services. All of our work is delivered by one talented team, driven by the same ethos: to create interiors that are vibrant, sophisticated and dynamic. We create carefully curated individual worlds, making a real difference to the way people experience interiors. Our signature is a celebration of colour and texture, animated by revived antiques, art and flashes of the offbeat, to tell very personal stories. We work closely with our clients, listening carefully, guiding confidently, exploring, inspiring - always delivering professional style with an enduring sense of fun.

name: Kelly Hoppen Interiors
description: Kelly Hoppen MBE is an award-winning interior designer whose name is synonymous with an aesthetic of simple elegance that is both relaxing and deeply luxurious. Her ever-evolving style is underpinned by a subtly coordinated fusion of East meets West; clean lines and neutral tones, blended with charming warmth and sumptuous opulence. She is honoured to be the recipient of copious design awards including receiving an MBE in 2009 for services to interior design. In December 2013 she was awarded the Natwest Everywoman Ambassador award for inspiring more young women to excel. She puts her stamp on the homes, yachts and jets of private clients, as well as select commercial projects the world over, including hotels, restaurants, offices and aircrafts. With 38 years experience at the forefront of the industry, publishers and businesses continually seek Kelly' s unparalleled expertise, allowing her to indulge her entrepreneurial instincts. As she is passionate about making her design ethos accessible to the masses, Kelly launched her eighth book Design Masterclass, in November 2013. Kelly is an investor on BBC Two' s hit entrepreneur show, The Dragon' s Den and fronted the Channel 5 Design Series, Superior Interiors, in 2011.

name: Kudos ID Ltd
description: I began my career with an apprenticeship at an esteemed architectural practice as a junior interior designer, which marked the start of a 28-year journey in the design industry. Throughout my career, I have had the privilege of contributing to a diverse array of projects, spanning various sectors and scales. In 2020, I established my own design studio, which has since become renowned for its expertise in luxury residential properties, as well as distinctive boutique and innovative commercial projects. Leveraging my extensive experience in construction and design, my company confidently handles large-scale projects with precision and excellence. My passion lies in challenging conventional design norms and transforming spaces in ways that inspire and captivate.

name: Kensington Design & Developments Ltd
description: Kensington Design are a small team of Interior Designers that have been helping clients both locally and internationally since 1984. ​With our wealth of experience and our long standing relationships with the finest craftsmen, Kensington Design has the tools to perfectly execute any project, no matter its size. We are proud to host one of the most extensive library of fabrics, wallpapers and trimmings in London. ​With meticulous care and attention, we work with you to bring your vision to life. Whether you wish to refurbish, redesign or simply refresh, we look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our shop and studio based in the heart of Kensington.

name: Care Home Interiors Ltd
description: Since 2001 Kerry Southern-Reason has operated an interiors business from her base in Medstead, Hampshire. Now an extended working family of likeminded individuals, who over the past 15 years have turned their skill, knowledge, and craftsmanship into the very essence of what is The Care Home Interiors Company. The Care Home Interiors Company is a multi-award-winning, family-run business offering exceptional design, in-house manufacturing, and full installation producing soft furnishings, upholstery, and cabinetry. Over the years, Kerry Southern-Reason has become a pioneer in dementia interior design. This expertise has led to her securing a Pinders Healthcare Design Award in 2016, 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2024 in the dementia design and best interior design categories. A transformative interiors company, forever moving forward, the company seeks new directions with one focus, to create safe but exciting care home interiors. Remarkably each design remains true to the company’s commitment that you will never see an interior scheme repeated. Each as unique as the one before and all produced to varying budgets. The company’s symbol is a Butterfly, a mantra for change, transition, adaptation, and growth. This symbol is testament to the company’s commitment to be at the forefront of care home interior design.

name: Kia Designs
description: Our interior design service helps people to live better through interior architecture that solves problems, anticipates their needs and creates a home that works for them. Our service is tailored to individual expectations. We take the fear and overwhelm, that most clients feel when researching for their project, and inspire them with confidence that their project will be taken through from initial inspiration to a completely finished home. Our interior design and project coordination service leaves our clients relaxed and excited about their finished home by keeping them up to date without being responsible for the day to day running of the project. Helping to solve problems has always been a core of our service, whether it be how to rearrange a floor plan to include a third bathroom or coordinating with contractors over the delivery schedule - our design service will provide you not only with the best possible design for you but also knowledge that the project will be executed according to plan no matter how busy your schedule becomes or where you are in the world.

name: Expedite Interiors Ltd
description: With over 10 years experience as an interior design consultancy, working on projects across the UK in every sector Expedite Interiors works in partnership with our clients to deliver premium commercial and luxury residential interiors. Our priority is always focused on our clients and delivering a project that meets the needs and requirements of the project and people who will use the space. We do this by providing a detailed concept design with photo-realistic CGIs, samples and space plans to allow our clients to be able to see the space for what it will eventually be. This means no unexpected surprises when we hand over the completed project! Once the concept design is signed-off, we spring into action to produce a scheme and technical design drawing package and specification to price up the project. This is vital to deliver the concept. It may also mean that we have to revisit aspects of the design to incorporate cost or environmental constraints. We pride ourselves on delivering the design integrity at any budget and using innovative and out-of-the-box thinking to work around any obstacles. Expedite Interiors offers a complete turn-key approach, meaning we will price, procure and install your furniture including window dressings, artwork and even decorative accessories. Our goal is to make this process as stress-free for our clients as possible.

name: Atelier FAVORI
description: We have extensive experience in interior design work for private homes, restaurants, galleries, boutiques and beauty salons, mainly in the metropolitan Tokyo area. We frequently travel to Europe, Asia and other regions to find attractive ideas, both modern and traditional. By doing so, we believe we are continually building up knowledge to provide authentic designs to our clients. Our credo is that good interior design is not only about the beauty of appearance but exceptional functionality and comfort. We aspire to make high value-added proposals that are tailored to the lifestyle of each client, featuring easy-to-use storage, health-friendly lighting, original products including furniture, and European products not widely available in Japan.

name: Swank Interiors Ltd
description: Swank Interiors was founded by Lanassir Gunton in 2009 offering a bespoke Interior Design service predominantly serving Norfolk & Suffolk.Every project is different and Lanassir is passionate about creating individual Interiors that reflect the needs and desires of the end user through a balanced approach that combines practicality and creatively. Lanassir has extensive experience working on Residential and Commercial projects with a diverse portfolio of homes, a 56 bedroom independent hotel & spa and a factory & offices for a business producing parts for formula one cars. Lanassir is recognised for her adaptable style and confident use of colour. Lanassir has won UK Property Awards for Apartment & Kitchen design.

name: Bowman Riley Architects
description: Laura is a creative and innovative interior designer working on high-end residential, commercial and hospitality projects at Bowman Riley. She has a passion for concept design and soft furnishings with extensive experience in high-end residential design, as well as a passion for concept creation for commercial offices, bars and restaurants. She loves to add finer detailing to schemes to ensure that they reflect the owners’ personality or that of their brand. Bowman Riley provides a full interior design service from initial concept creation through to final styling and accessories of interiors, surpassing our client’s aspirations. The team is at the forefront of design; creating inspiring, efficient and innovative interior spaces that enhance the users' experience. We work on a wide range of projects from commercial design, bars and restaurants, hotel and leisure to bespoke private homes. We provide a full interior design service from initial concept creation through to final styling and accessories of interiors, surpassing our clients' aspirations. Working closely with our in house architects and building consultants, we can offer a full in-house design service from all our UK offices. Office locations: Skipton - Wellington, Otley Street, Skipton, North Yorkshire, BD23 1EL Leeds - Toronto Square, Toronto Street, West Yorkshire, LS1 2HJ London - The Button Factory, 35-39 Old Street, London, EC1V 9HX

name: Art de Vivre Studio
description: Laura founded Art de Vivre Studio to address the needs of discerning and quality-conscious home owners who seek assistance with their primary residences, holiday homes or pieds-à-terre, as well as property developers for their turnkey projects or other real estate investments in the South of France. Having lived and worked in both London and France has allowed her to build up excellent relationships within the industry and gain a thorough understanding and knowledge of both regions. Today Laura is based in Beaulieu-sur-Mer, a picturesque seaside village on the French Riviera. Cultivating the idea that beauty is not limited to a certain place but is rather a universal concept, Laura constantly looks for inspiration around the world and has developed a taste for spaces that unveil their beauty with subtlety and radiate serenity and equilibrium, where function is harmonised with aesthetics. Each project is translated into a ‘distinct’ vision, carried out with close attention to detail for a seamless, bespoke result. «Our interiors are comfortable yet elegant, with a subtle coastal scent, where past meets with present and old becomes new through the use of texture, organic materials and sophisticated colour palettes. Committed to every aspect of the design process from early conception to completion, we have a unique vision for each project we undertake. Thus, the location and the personality of each client play an important role in the design process.» The Studio offers a full r

name: The I + A Studio LLP
description: The I + A Studio is an independent architecture and interior design practice specialising in substantial whole-house refurbishments, extensions and complete interior transformations. Founded by Laura and Lucy in 2019, the studio combines big-practice expertise with the personal, collaborative approach of a small studio. After working on large architectural and design projects, they established The I + A Studio to build deeper relationships with clients and remain closely involved from the initial brief through to the finished home. We look at the home as a whole, considering architecture, interiors, flow, function and atmosphere together from the outset. This allows us to rethink how a property works, rather than treating rooms or design decisions in isolation. Every project begins with understanding the people who live there. We explore what is working, what creates frustration, how the household uses the space and how the home may need to adapt through different stages of life. From there, we develop a clear design strategy tailored to the client, the building and the way they want to live. Our services can extend from briefing and concept design through planning, technical design, complete interior design, procurement, construction support and on-site management. Throughout the process, we provide the creative ideas, technical knowledge and clear professional guidance needed to turn an initial aspiration into a coherent and achievable design. We do not impose a single aest

name: Laura Passey Interiors Ltd
description: Laura Passey is based in the Lake District, where she focuses on residential interior design and prides herself on her professional yet approachable style of working. She is known for her calming, homely interiors. Understanding her clients’ needs and tastes is paramount. Laura offers the complete project package: design, procurement, and project coordination. She works with a team of trusted craftspeople. Laura brings a wealth of experience, knowledge, and skill to every project, ensuring a smooth process and successful completion.

name: Born Designers
description: Laura Stewart has worked in the industry for 25 years. Her studio Born Designers, which she co-founded with husband Philip, focuses on transforming interiors from ordinary to extraordinary. Their studio specialises in both high-end residential work and bespoke commercial projects and they also offer valuable consulting services for other practices. After her BA(hons) in Interior Architecture and Design, Laura designed bars and restaurants, luxury hotel rooms and spas across Europe and the Americas before establishing Born Designers. Laura brings this experience of high-end hospitality design to the residential market, helping clients realise the potential in their homes, and enhance the customer experience for businesses. Over a number of years, Laura has held visiting lecturer posts at The Royal College of Art (MA Interior Design) and at Kingston & Middlesex Universities (BA Interior Design).

name: Studio L, London
description: Laura Marino founded Studio L London in 2016, bringing more than two decades of experience in creative direction, residential development and interior design to private homes. The studio creates layered, colour-confident interiors with a strong sense of identity, shaped by the architecture, the people who live there and a clear design narrative. Studio L’s work has appeared in The Telegraph , The Times , Vogue , Wallpaper* , Homes & Gardens and SheerLuxe . Most recently, the studio was selected for inclusion in Phillip Jeffries: Walls: Inspiring Design One Wall at a Time , published by Rizzoli to mark Phillip Jeffries’ 50th anniversary. The studio’s Grade II-listed Notting Hill pied-à-terre was a turnkey renovation and restoration, led from initial concept through project management and completion. It won Best Small Space at the Homes & Gardens Design Awards 2025. Studio L is also included in House & Garden’s curated directory, The List . Before founding Studio L, Laura co-founded Alchemi Group, a boutique residential development management company, and served as its Creative Director. She helped shape the creative direction of projects including 55 Victoria Street, winner of a RIBA London Award, and Westminster Fire Station, winner of Best Small Development at The Standard New Homes Awards 2022 and shortlisted in the Housing and Conservation categories at the NLA Awards 2022. This development background continues to inform Studio L’s work. The studio considers how every deci

name: Dargie Lewis Designs Ltd
description: Lavinia Dargie established Dargie Lewis Designs Limited in 1978 and in that time her elegant and distinctive style has acquired an international reputation. Whether residential or commercial, modern or traditional, her deceptively simple and timeless interiors reflect a highly creative and individual flair for detail and colour. During this time Lavinia has built up a reliable team of architects, builders and craftsmen - many of whom have been with her throughout. Whether in London, the country or abroad her schemes are eminently 'liveable' and always reflect the personalities of her clients, this client/designer chemistry is essential. As well as being aesthetically pleasing, it is vital that the finished design should complement the client's lifestyle and cater for that flexibility. The need for a sense of continuity is also important: familiar objects, personal collections, favourite furniture - all contribute to the eventual harmony. Undoubtedly influenced by her childhood in the Far East, Lavinia's decorating hallmarks are strong, uncluttered lines and unusually imaginative colours, sparingly used so that they never overpower. Her keen eye for proportion and scale, combining both traditional and modern interiors achieves a classic contemporary feel, reflecting 21st century living. The majority of work comes through personal recommendation: repeat business is, unsurprisingly, very high.

name: CAISLEY
description: Leading Interior Architecture and Interior Design practice, bridging the mix of traditional with a fresh take on Heritage. A place to nurture, to welcome and to host. A place to create, to connect and to laugh. At Caisley we place the importance of home at the centre of our design process. We create timeless, understated, layered interiors that are relaxed, liveable and comfortable. “Lauren’s use of colour and texture imbue love and passion into her interiors, creating the perfect blend of English traditionalism with her modern sense of style” - British Vogue. Caisley’s portfolio includes Grade I listed stately homes, traditional Georgian rectories, classic villa's in France to stunning beach houses in Guernsey. We embody an approachable, highly professional and detail orientated approach to residential projects. Working seamlessly with key stakeholders in our category – (£1.5m - £5m). Projects across the UK and Europe. Studio based in the idyllic watermill at Redbournbury outside St Albans, Hertfordshire, UK. Contact Lauren directly: /

name: STUDIO SHANATI
description: Studio Shanati, directed by the talented creative leader Lea Shanati, is an interior design studio that works with both residential and commercial spaces and provides consultancy services on various interior design-related subjects. Lea Shanati is an intuitive creator with a profound appreciation for beauty. Her journey in interior design began 23 years ago with the delivery of her first project. Coming from a family engaged in the real estate business, Lea profoundly understands both the business and creative aspects of interior design. She firmly believes that the spaces we create are our unique forms of communication with the world. A committed lifelong learner, Lea holds an MBA from IMISP Business School and an MSc in Communications from the London School of Economics. Furthering her education and honing her skills, she has also undertaken an Interior Design Course at the Inchbald School of Design. Her blend of education, experience, and passion sets Studio Shanati apart as a premier destination for interior design solutions.

name: Leila Corbett Interior Designer
description: The business was established by Leila Corbett in 1976. The company Leila Corbett Ltd provides complete design and purchasing service for residential and commercial projects in the UK, Europe and USA. Leila Corbett is a truly multi-disciplined interior designer with more than 25 years of experience, has carried out a wide range of turnkey projects and developed the interior design for new and period houses, hotels, restaurants, commercial offices, banks, conservatories and many other projects, both large and small. Carpets can be designed for projects along with cabinet furniture, upholstery and wall-coverings. Curtains are designed to suit the interiors and are made and installed to the highest standards. Custom-made upholstery is also available through her suppliers. Specialist painting includes trompe l' oeil, lacquer, panelling and other effects. Each project is individually designed by Leila Corbett, FBBDA, who enjoys working both in traditional and contemporary design. Commissions have led her to places as diverse as Boca Raton, Coconut Grove, Geneva, Florida, Teheran, Long Island, Miami Beach, New York, Palm Beach, Riyadh, Sarasota, Scotland, the South of France & Normandy. In all cases, Leila maintains full control of all details of the decoration and installation to ensure that the client' s concept has been fully achieved.

name: Lesley Taylor Design
description: Lesley is a designer with over 25 years experience. She has worked on a wide range of domestic and commercial projects across the UK and Europe and takes pleasure in working closely with a client to create an interior that brings out the full potential of a property and full fills the clients wishes for thier home or work place. Lesley and her team welcome the challenge of a project with a tight budget, often finding this brings out some of the most creative solutions. Previous commissions include domestic projects; hotels; restaurants and exclusive rental properties. Lesley is also author of 10 of interior design based books and contributes to a number of national magazines and newspapers.

name: Lindi Reynolds & Co
description: With a formal training in Fine Art and Architecture, my practice as an Architectural Interior Designer has become my life's passion. I believe that the art of great Interior Design is to weave the functional and aesthetic aspects of a home together expertly, so that the final vision is transportive on first inception and supportive through the living of it. Having set Lindi Reynolds & Co up 20 years ago, we are well established, with a broad base of brilliant supply partners, to help deliver our projects. Together we are passionate about creating living spaces into places that our clients can feel great in. Order, visual exchange and a sense of time and place are some of the ingredients we focus on to create truly memorable spaces. Order engenders a sense of calm and purpose; it starts to provide the platform for inspired action. Visual exchange begins with the interplay and ‘talk’ of the various design elements. Finally, it is through the clever mix of texture, colour, pattern and placement that each element of the design mix starts to play its part in the great orchestra of Interior Design. We start all our projects, recognising that the design should flow from our individual clients' personality and life vision. To do this we build an insightful picture of our clients through a bespoke, front-end work-shopping process that we have evolved. Doing this before we begin to design, means we get it right quicker. Our vision must chime with our clients’ style sensibilities in suc

name: Rendall & Wright
description: Rendall & Wright offer a comprehensive, bespoke interior design, project management and soft furnishing service. Launched by Lindsey Rendall and Helen Wright in 2006, this Suffolk based interior design practice has attracted a wide clientele base across the UK. Rendall & Wright have completed residential projects both new builds and period restorations along with commercial projects, including hotel, spa and restaurant design. Each project brings together a passion for functional design and attention to detail, coupled with seamless project management ensuring all clients feel confident about their project and leaves them free to enjoy the process of building, design and development. Rendall & Wright's design studio in Layham, Suffolk offers their clients a calm, peaceful environment to discuss their projects, contemplate decisions and source soft furnishings. Rendall & Wright have won numerous regional and international design awards. Their work has been featured in 25 Beautiful Homes, Ideal Home Magazine, Interior Design Yearbook, Interior Design Today, Beautiful Kitchens, Real Homes, Design et al, The Style Bible, Suffolk Magazine and Essential Magazine. Lindsey has contributed on numerous occasions to the 'ask the designer' section for Interior Design Today magazine and given talks at many events including The Homes and Gardens Show.

name: Muchmore Design
description: Linsey first discovered her love for creativity when studying art and design at secondary school. Inheriting her mother’s passion for interiors and property development she went on to study interior architecture and design at university. After gaining 7 years experience working with award winning design studios in London and wanting to realise her life long dream of establishing a creative and successful interior design studio she made the leap of faith and formed her own company. Wanting to create a business with a family central ethos and to honour her strong family foundations she decided to call the company after her mother’s maiden name, Muchmore. Muchmore Design is now a family owned interior architecture and design studio based in Brixton, South London. Specialists in the private and commercial property sector, we offer interior design services to private clients, developers and architects throughout the UK. Our full turnkey solution allows us to consult, manage and deliver at every stage of a project, from concept through to completion we guide clients every step of the way! This is made possible due to our carefully selected team who together provide a unique set of multi-disciplined skills under one roof. Over 30 years combined industry experience and expertise across design, furnishing, project management, procurement and installation means Linsey and the team are well placed to undertake the following projects. Private Home Renovations New Build Homes & Apartments

name: Mitchell Rose (Design) Ltd.
description: Hello and welcome to some highlights from our Portfolio ! We are a small team with experience of working predominantly on Residential projects and have also worked on commercial projects - from workspaces to shopping centres. We offer an inspiring and supportive one to one service, collaborating closely with our clients, to create a wonderful home environment. From a concept to completion 'Bespoke Build' or a complete 'Renovation' of an exsiting house, or principle rooms, we are here to design the best spaces for you and with you. We only undertake a handful of projects every year to allow us to provided a truly dedicated service. We have built our business on personal recommendations and have established a reputation for elegant, unique and calm spaces that express the vision, personality and practical needs of our clients. We pride ourselves on our calm, creative and collaborative one to one approach. Our ethos is to create nurturing and beautiful spaces that are a joy to be in and use - Form and Function of equal measure. Lisa Mitchell - Design Director

name: STUDIO SONA
description: STUDIO SONA is a boutique interior architecture studio, focusing on the luxury residential and commercial market, across London and abroad. The company's projects have ranged from renovating period properties, rebuilding modern townhouses and developing commercial spaces in and around central London, to villas in the South of France. Led by Lisa Sharistani, an accredited member of the British Institute of Interior Design, the team brings years of experience and expertise, unparalleled knowledge, and creativity to every project. With an extensive network of trusted suppliers, we offer a comprehensive design service that supports clients throughout their entire journey. The company's expertise spans various styles and project types, allowing us to create tailored solutions that meet each client's unique needs. From initial concept to final execution, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional results and enhancing the functionality, beauty and uniqueness of every space we design. The central tenet of Studio SONA’s design philosophy is the focus on curating personalised, deeply meaningful experiences that align perfectly with each clients personality and aspiration.

name: Keates Interiors Ltd
description: Lisa has over two decades of experience working on high end projects, from European royal residences to contemporary eco new builds. With an extensive grounding in classical architecture and interiors, Lisa's expertise as director gives her the perfect basis to create interiors of timeless elegance. Her fine balance of intuitive design and meticulous planning ensures her clients' expectations are always exceeded.

name: Liza Evans Interior Design
description: Acknowledged as a top 20 Interior Designer by The Telegraph, I work with clients in San Francisco, London, and Internationally. Our surroundings have a lasting effect on our senses and our sense of wellbeing. My design approach focuses on a stimulating experience through an exploration of Feng Shui, colors, forms, materials, and reconnecting people with nature. I emphasize the serenity and beauty to create homes which are sophisticated, luxurious and understated. If you demand the finest workmanship, finishes, materials and a bespoke interior design experience, we work closely with architects and contractors from concept through to completion to ensure our projects run professionally, smoothly on time and on budget. Whether you are looking to remodel a whole house or decorate a room get in touch and let’s start your journey to a mindful, restorative home together. Head over to my website for more information - www.lizaevans.com AWARDS Our work has been shortlisted in 2016, 2015 & 2012 for International Design & Architecture Awards for a show apartment project in San Francisco for developer client Crescent Heights, a Home Cinema project for a residential client in Hampstead, and The Oxford & Cambridge Club in Pall Mall, London. GIVING We are committed to undertaking one pro bono commercial or residential interior design project a year to benefit a charity or non profit organization. Please send us details in order for us to consider your project.

name: Stellar & Co
description: We are a dedicated design studio based in Hampton, Surrey. We offer a full design service for residential and small commercial clients both in the UK and across Europe. We welcome work on period properties as well as new builds. We get involved in all aspects of the project from concept and spatial planning, through to the finer architectural finishes, and selection of fabrics, furnishings and decoration. Our work responds to the needs of the client whilst creating a beautiful aesthetic. We have built up an impressive book of trades and crafts people, as well as suppliers, ensuring the highest level of quality and design.

name: Park Grove Design Ltd.
description: Lori Pinkerton-Rolet and her team at Park Grove Design base their work on a simple philosophy: good design should be timeless and unique. Our clients are partners with us in the design process and are assured of continued support during and after project completion. An interior design professional since 1992, Lori's work has taken her from North America to Europe, and most recently Africa. Park Grove Design achieves high levels of client satisfaction through the innovative and creative use of new materials, attention to detail, and outstanding project coordination. The portfolio of work is primarily boutique hotel projects and work with property developers, but ranges from15th Century manor houses and state-of-the-art new builds to offices and residential care homes. The company's work has been featured in Hospitality Interiors; idFX; The Evening Standard; House & Garden; Homes & Gardens; Ideal Home; Rooms & Living, and many other magazine titles and books. Lori is a Past President of the British Institute of Interior Design. She is also an ADR Group Accredited Mediator. To view Lori's hotel portfollio please visit the Park Grove website .

name: LGW Designs Ltd
description: Louisa Greville Williams has been working as an interior designer for more than 30 years and is perhaps best known as the GW in Vanrenen GW Designs, a House and Garden Top 100 firm. Louisa relaunched LGW Designs to continue her work in helping domestic and international clients express their lifestyle and personality in their homes. The broad network of suppliers and contractors Louisa has worked with over many years, allows her to create wonderful interiors and deliver projects of all types and sizes. These can range from the simplest decorative task to the most complex building project. Using strong and unexpected colours, Louisa loves mixing old and new to create warmth, comfort and surprise. A fascination with shapes and spaces, and a love of architectural and design detail drive everything Louisa does. Traditional, but with an overlay of eclecticism and constantly excited about all areas of her work, Louisa is determined to bring happiness and contentment to her clients. Nothing is left to chance, with the LGW team working hard to eliminate stress from their clients’ lives. Years of managing projects of all types allows Louisa to know exactly which levers to pull and when; design is obviously key, but delivery is paramount. Personal, individual, and intimate; Louisa offers her clients detailed design advice and a commitment to deliver smooth and efficient service that creates real value.

name: Gomm Studio Ltd
description: Gomm Studio is a luxury, family-run interior design studio based in Wimbledon Village, London. We design bespoke interiors for residential and commercial properties in the UK and abroad.

name: LB furniture Ltd (Trading as Studio LBI)
description: Studio LBI provides Interior Design services for large scale properties. Louise and her team work with architects to bring their vision to life and with skilled contractors make it a reality. Light filled rooms, colourful textiles, natural elements, earthy textures, and brushed metals are the pallet that define and can always distinguish a Studio LBI home. We believe in getting to really know our clients in order to give them the best quality service. We aim to create elegant spaces with a classical influence and a contemporary edge. We always strive to offer something different and unique. Designs that are not dictated by current trends on the high street. However large or small your project, Studio LBI is passionate about providing you with the best service to bring your home to life.

name: Louis Zhang Studio Limited
description: Led by its Creative Director, Louis Zhang, with offices in London and Chengdu, Louis Zhang Studio is an interior design collective that comprises a diverse group of passionate, dynamic and talented individuals. The Studio draws on their combined expertise and vast knowledge to create designs steeped in art, fashion, history, photography and culture. Louis Zhang graduated from the globally renowned Central Saint Martins with a BA Hons in Textiles and the prestigious Inchbald School of Design with a MA in Architectural Interior Design. With a superior knowledge of textiles as well as the creative and technical aspects of architectural interior design, Louis has an unparalleled understanding and the utmost respect of how colour, material and texture can transform and breathe life into a space. These are key to the Studio’s design philosophy, and can enhance a space to the client’s every requirement. Attention to detail for the clients’ preferences creates beautiful, special, unique spaces, that are loved and offer maximum utility and functionality, whether that be for commercial, hospitality, residential, private developers or high net-worth clients.

name: Lost and Found Interiors
description: "Lost and Found" sums us up: it’s what we do. We discover spaces that are lost, details that are missing and delight in mixing the old with the new. We’re at our happiest when we‘re breathing fresh life into a forgotten, under-utilised room, reviving a tired-old treasure, and creating interiors that are ‘just so’. Great design is about a million little things coming together to turn a home into something very special and wonderful. Our Studio believes in designing beautiful environments, which add long term value to your property. Our approach is intrinsically sustainable; looking to retain, refresh and restore what’s there, whilst ensuring that our designs compliment and reflect a Client's personality and lifestyle.

name: LPE Designs Ltd
description: At LPE Designs we believe great design is about collaboration with you. We don’t follow a “one-size-fits-all” approach and we aren’t about trends — instead, we focus on truly understanding you, your needs, and how you want your space to feel. Every space we design is a reflection of who you are, what you need, and how you live. We know that your home isn’t just a place to look at — it’s where life happens. Whether you have children, pets, or a love for entertaining, practicality is at the core of everything we do. From thoughtful storage solutions for school bags and muddy shoes to creating cozy nooks for family downtime, we design spaces that work for you — not just around you. Our process is rooted in listening. We take the time to understand your lifestyle, your daily routines, and what makes you feel at home.
