Then, we create environments that reflect your personality and offer the functionality you need, without compromising on style. At LPE Designs , we don’t just design interiors. We design homes that fit your life. If you’d like to learn more about our design process or discuss your next project, please do get in touch. We’d love to hear from you! Background Lily, the founder of LPE Designs, brings a wealth of experience to every project. With a background in the Luxury Industry and five years spent in the Private Collections & Furniture Department at Christie’s, Lily has a unique eye for quality and design. After training at KLC School of Interior Design, she went on

name: Lucinda Martin Interior Design
description: Lucinda Martin Interior Design is a design studio specialising in residential interiors for private clients. Based in Shropshire, their diverse portfolio encompasses country houses, London homes and many other projects across the country. Lucinda manages all commissions personally, offering a one-on-one service to ensure her clients are guided through the process seamlessly. Their style is classic, elegant, fun but also diverse. They pride themselves on the ability to tailor designs to their client’s taste whether they favour a paired back neutral scheme, or a more colourful textured palette.

name: Lucy Winterwood Interior Design
description: Lucy gained a First-Class Honours Degree in Interior Architecture and Design. Shortly after graduating, she discovered that her true passion lay in Interior Design, with a particular interest in sensitively restoring heritage and period properties. With more than a decade of experience in the High-End Interior Design market, including demanding and ambitious projects across the UK, Europe, and Asia, Lucy went on to establish her own studio: Lucy Winterwood Interior Design. Lucy specialises in subtle, timeless luxury, creating homes that feel warm, inviting and beautifully considered. Each project is tailored to the personality and lifestyle of the client, crafting designs that reflect their character and memories rather than imposing a fixed ‘house style’. Resulting in spaces that are deeply personal. Projects range from single-room redecoration to full turnkey home renovations. Covering every stage of the process: from space planning and concept development to sourcing materials and furnishings, over-seeing contractors, installation, and adding the finishing touches. The studio is based in St Albans, Hertfordshire, serving clients across Hertfordshire, North London, and the surrounding areas.

name: Lungfish Architects
description: Lungfish Architects is a design-led, award winning architecture and interior design practice. Our design philosophy focuses on the synergy between not only architecture and interiors, but also spaces and wellbeing. Starting with a concept, we shape and develop an idea with you – right from a diagram, to defining the details. To deliver creative and inspiring interiors, we work to understand both the client’s and the end user’s needs.

name: Lynne Hunt London Ltd.
description: Lynne Hunt London creates a kind of luxury that is contemporary, fresh and full of unexpected twists. Our design is audacious, not ostentatious, drawing inspiration from local environments and cultures to create interiors that range from the chic and urban to the organic and whimsical. At our Chelsea studio, a small team of designers works with Lynne on projects for hotels, residential, resorts, neew developments, restaurants and bars, both in the UK and much further afield. Our experience encompasses new-build and refurbishment interiors for some of the world’s leading destinations and hoteliers, discerning residential clients, from London to the South Pacific via the Mediterranean and the Middle East. Lynne Hunt trained in interior design at Brooks College, Long Beach, California. After graduating, she returned to the UK and worked on her first hotel projects at Ezra Attia & Associates in London, including the Library Bar at the Lanesborough and the Windsor Lounge of the Athenaeum Hotel. At Gregory Aeberhard, Lynne designed and project managed refurbishments for leading hotels in the UAE, Jordan, Bahrain, Oslo and on the Côte d’Azur. In 1993, she formed Hunt Hamilton Zuch, focusing on luxury interiors. The company’s first assignment was to redesign a set of cloakrooms. Fortunately, the Hyatt Carlton Tower in London invited HHZ back several times to refit more glamorous areas of the hotel.In 1995 Lynne was chosen to create a set of deluxe guest rooms at Claridge’s – the firs

name: Studio Sorana Ltd
description: Studio Sorana Ltd (formally Amongst Things) launched in 2018 and we are going from strength to strength. Day-to-day we work hard to design and deliver spaces that encompass our clients practical and aesthetic needs. Our collaborative approach encourages communication and an exchange of ideas. We bring a strong eye for design, along with strategic budget management, connections with trades and suppliers all harnessed by years of experience. Lead Designer & Director Maddy began her career in design in 2007, however, long before this her creative nature was apparent; painting and drawing from as early as she can remember. As a kid, to the frustration of her parents, she (and her two sisters) would devise home renovations and help decorate their family home. This led Maddy to study art & design at university and eventually building design, achieving a BA Hons in Architecture in 2010 from the University of Kent. Over the last 12 years Maddy has worked across many interior design sectors and with brands and clients such as Burberry, Calvin Klein, Affinity Sutton (now Clarion Housing), YOTEL, Nationwide, Marriott, Sheraton and Taylor Wimpey Central London. She now brings years of industry experience and her expertise’s to Amongst Things (project completed at HLM Architects). We asked Maddy…What are your key Passions ? An Art Director and Creative Interior Designer, Nerissa designs contemporary and transitional spaces with highly imaginative ideas and the ultimate development of personal style for each of her clients. The design direction of each project is progressed collaboratively, through hand sketching, technical drawing, spacial planning, lighting design, colour theory and mood board. Each client receives a design presentation, mood boards and furniture book. Sourcing furniture fixtures and fittings is a key part of the work, and procuring for the highest level of finish within the agreed budget. "My team are a trusted set of contractors and suppliers that are not only great to work with but adhere to the highset standards of finish" “The most inspiring part to my work is helping my clients develop their own sense of style, as well as proposing and presenting them with styling that has the 'wow' yet creates a sense of home.”

name: Nick Snow Design Studio
description: Nick Snow Design is an Interior Studio located in Hampshire and accredited by the British Institute of Interior Design Known for our Signature style and high quality service, our Interior Design Studio offers a comprehensive service specialising in Residential and Commercial design projects. Founded by award winning designer Nick Snow, the studio brings a wealth of experience of contemporary style and liveable design to fit our clients' lifestyles. Our Hampshire based studio offers a range services including a fully equipped Interior Design Studio, Bespoke Interior Tailoring, 3D CAD Rendering, Full Project Management along with Home Styling and Staging. Our professional insight and connections mean we are able to offer you smart and unique solutions to create the perfect outcome no matter how unusual the space may be. We design every space to the highest standards. As an established and admired creative force within the Interior Design profession, NSD Studio has developed its own unique Statement Style that is evident throughout our work. We specialise in incorporating sophisticated design with eclectic elements, and excel in bringing spaces to life for our Private Clients.

name: NS Interiors
description: NICHOLAS SUNDERLAND INTERIORS Nicholas Sunderland Interior Design was established in 2001 and quickly became recognised as one of the industry’s leading Design Consultancies. As a registered Interior Designer with the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID), and a Professional member of the Society of British and International Design, (SBID) his credentials are of the highest standard. Nicholas is also a CPD assessor for the BIID confirming only the best suppliers are recommended to the industry. Nicholas is also an external adviser for the validation of the Portsmouth University MA Interior Design Course in partnership with Cambridge Education Group (CEG). His experience and training in the Far East of Classical Feng Shui enhances his design status and creates an East-West style subtle in its approach. The client list is extensive in UK and international markets, from young couples to world leaders of industry, politicians and heads of state. Award-winning style, bespoke interiors, full renovations, interior fit-outs and furnishings are managed with ease. Equally, projects with more modest budgets are dealt with to the same standard but tailored to your individual brief and target funding. Nicholas handles all projects personally and clients have direct access during working hours. Each interior design is tailored to the individual requirements, style and budget of the client from a full interior to a single room, and the project always receives the same attention to det

name: Violet & George
description: Violet & George was founded in 2009 by Nicky Mudie, following a decade of experience in the interior design industry and a lifelong passion for textiles, craftsmanship, and considered, luxury design. With a deep-rooted understanding of soft furnishings and decorative arts, Nicky established the studio to offer beautifully tailored interiors with soul and personality. Nicky studied Textile Design at art college before completing a degree in the History of Art & Design at Leeds University. She apprenticed under Daniel Hopwood at his West London studio, then spent seven years as Head Designer at Godrich Interiors, where she played a key role in building and shaping the studio. What sets Violet & George apart is the attention we pay to what truly matters to our clients. We offer a flexible interior design and decoration service that adapts to individual needs — from full interior schemes to made-to-measure curtains and upholstery, paint and fabric consultations, intelligent lighting solutions, and signature decorative details. Working from our West London studio and soft furnishings workshop in Hampshire, our designers and skilled craftsmen collaborate with a trusted network of specialists to deliver exceptional quality and a highly personalised, joyful client experience.

name: Nicola Burt Interior Design
description: A friendly, approachable and professional interior design studio, we create super-stylish yet comfortable interiors. Beauty, function, and style are at the heart of what we do, and we have extensive design experience to help you transform your ideas into reality. We are a small but passionate team working mainly in residential and small commercial projects. Working together to create bespoke interiors tailored to you, we will help you to create a space that is functional yet beautiful, and uniquely yours. We love collaborating with clients to help them create beautiful spaces in which to live, work and play. Our belief is that good design is for everyone, and where we live and work should be happy and positive places. We want clients to get the best possible results for the time and money they invest in their project, and to enjoy the experience of transforming where they live or work.

name: Mandeville Home Ltd
description: At Mandeville Home we offer a full turnkey residential interior design service across Hertfordshire, including St Albans, Harpenden, Hitchin and the surrounding areas. Our interior design studio works closely with homeowners to create beautiful, thoughtfully designed interiors that feel personal, practical and timeless. From the first conversation to the final finishing touches, we manage the entire design process for you. Our services include interior design consultation, space planning, design development, sourcing furniture and finishes, procurement, project coordination and styling. Whether you are renovating a family home, extending a period property or furnishing a new build, we guide you every step of the way, making the experience enjoyable and stress-free. Based in Hertfordshire, we pride ourselves on delivering bespoke interior design solutions that reflect how you live and what matters most to you. Our turnkey approach means every detail is carefully considered and beautifully brought together, so you can relax and enjoy a home that truly feels like yours.

name: Nicola O'Mara Interior Design
description: Nicola O’Mara is one of the leading home renovation experts in Cornwall. She is an award winning interior designer with more than 18 years experience remodeling the homes, ski chalets, new builds and holiday houses of successful professionals in and around the Polzeath, Rock, Cornwall, the South West but also internationally. Nicola is highly knowledgeable in interiors and is involved in every aspect of remodeling; from drawing plans to managing contractors, to over seeing the design and construction detailling. She is a specialist in new build, renovation work and project managing the design and installation process. She is known for her attention to detail and her outstanding client service. Clients use phases such as, extremely reliable, knowledgeable, professional, provides great solutions and highly recommended to describe her. She is fully envolved in all of her projects including clients and contractors meetings, furniture and material specification and coordination. “ I strive to make the process less stressful for our clients”, “ I love that I can help clients make important design decisions early in the build process, which can avoid costly mistakes later on’. Nicola started her business back in 1998 and as worked on a large variety of projects, from coastal homes, penthouse apartments, townhouses, period cottages, through to bespoke ski properties and large wooden lodges. Nicola has built up a large network of talented artisans, contractors, joinery & cabinet maker

name: Nikki Rees Interior Design
description: With over two decades of industry experience, Nikki creates interiors that are as emotionally resonant as they are beautifully functional. Her work spans both residential and commercial spaces, united by a belief that every environment, whether a family home or a place of business, has the potential to enrich wellbeing and express identity. Nikki has a gift for translating her clients’ values, stories, and aspirations into spaces that feel authentic, timeless, and deeply human. She understands both the emotional and financial investment behind each project and approaches every design with great care, integrity, and attention to detail. Nikki began her design journey with a BA in Interior Design from Kingston University in 2000, followed by experience in fashion, retail, and exhibition design. This multidisciplinary foundation shaped her ability to blend space, aesthetics, and function into cohesive, beautifully considered interiors. Her style is calm, layered, and thoughtful, often combining muted tones and natural textures to create spaces that feel effortless, grounded, and quietly elevated. Known for her collaborative and detail-focused approach, Nikki has built a reputation for trust, excellence, and designs that stand the test of time. Since founding her studio in 2013, her practice has grown organically through word-of-mouth, reflecting the lasting relationships and delight she cultivates with every client. Above all, Nikki’s mission is simple: to design spaces that tel

name: Nina Lancaster Interior Design
description: Nina Lancaster Interior Design is based in Hertfordshire and works with clients throughout East Anglia and The Cotswolds. Nina is KLC School of Design trained and established the design practice in 2020. We create relaxed interiors with an emphasis on elegant and timeless design. Whilst leaning towards a neutral palette, we love to combine a pop of colour alongside natural hues and textures to create a balanced and layered look. When considering a design scheme, we spend time getting to know our clients to fully understand how they live and what they enjoy. “Working closely with clients helps me to understand their needs which then enables me to create a balanced and harmonious design to ensure their home flows beautifully. Your home should look and feel good. It's your haven, so it needs to feel calm and welcoming as soon as your walk in the door." says our founder, Nina. We can work closely with your project team or can provide you with everything you need to implement your design scheme.

name: No Ordinary House
description: Nichola McKerrow Todd is the Founder and Creative Director of No Ordinary House , a London-based interior design studio specialising in thoughtfully guided residential renovations with a strong focus on wellbeing. With a background in architecture and marketing, Nichola is known for combining design expertise with clear, grounded communication — supporting clients both practically and emotionally throughout complex projects. Her work is characterised by a calm, layered aesthetic, biophilic influences, and the considered use of natural materials to create homes that feel restorative, balanced, and deeply personal. Having experienced major renovations personally as well as professionally, she understands the uncertainty and decision fatigue homeowners often face, and brings structure, reassurance, and clarity to each stage of the process. Her work has received industry recognition, including being a runner-up at the ufurnish Awards and shortlisted for the British Home Awards and the SBID Awards. She is the creator of Living Through a Renovation , a guide designed to help homeowners feel steadier and better prepared as they navigate ambitious home transformations. Nichola’s work centres on the belief that great design is not just about how a space looks, but how it supports wellbeing and everyday life.

name: Nomad Private Client Ltd
description: Our Private Client service combines award winning interior design with the rigour of real world project delivery. Drawing on years of experience crafting our own projects, we offer a level of project management few design studios can match. Every home is overseen by our dedicated in-house team. From early design detailing to full site coordination and final dressing. The result is a beautifully executed, highly personalised home, and a process that feels seamless from start to finish.

name: CasaNora
description: Having studied Fashion Design in AIU (American University in London) I started my career in fashion designing evening wear and wedding dresses. In 2007 I decided to work in property development and Interiors which led me to KLC ( school of design) which then started my career in Interiors. I have specialised in kitchen design which also allows me to create a stylish yet comfortable open plan spaces. In 2014 I opened my showroom in Putney SW15. My passion is space planning and to create a stylish, unique, luxurious yet practical home designed especially for you to enjoy. I love experimenting with textures and colours to create continuous harmony throughout , you will feel gradual transition of colour from one room to the next with special attention to the mood and balance in that space. Whether your home is modern or traditional my priority is to offer you a full design service for all your needs. I will take care of everything for you to the finest detail; from the largest piece of furniture to the smallest dining accessories. All you need to do is enjoy the experience of creating your own timeless and beautiful home.

name: BABID
description: Born in Japan, she graduated from Meiji University with degrees in geography and museum studies. Her career began with CA, where she explored 40 cities across 30 countries. She then transitioned to a hotel consultancy role in Tokyo for 10 years, where she was involved in the opening project of the prestigious Hotel Seiyo Ginza. In 1995, she moved to the UK. After receiving specialized training in architecture and interior design at The Interior Design School and the UCL Bartlett, she founded her own business in London. From 2000 to 2017, her projects encompassed various sectors, including residential spaces (ranging from 100 m² to 1,400 m²), hotels, restaurants, show flats, and furniture design, both in Japan and the UK. In 2012, she launched a professional e-learning college for Japanese professionals. For her contributions to BIID, her work in education, and her outstanding design achievements, she received the BIID Merit Award in 2016, becoming the 8th recipient out of 1,200 members. In 2017, she returned to Japan, where her first major accomplishment was establishing the BIID Japan Chapter in 2018, marking the first branch located outside the UK. Following the success of the inaugural BIID overseas event at the British Embassy in Tokyo in 2009, she has organized numerous promotional events and recruited around 40 top Japanese designers as BIID members. The organisation is now recognized as one of the most prestigious professional associations for interior design in Japan.

name: Novaco Design Ltd
description: Novaco Design is a full-service interior architecture and design firm dedicated to creating spaces that are not only beautiful but functional and reflective of our client's unique personalities and lifestyles. We work closely with our clients to understand their needs and bring their vision to life. We believe that good design should enhance the quality of life and our goal is to create spaces that inspire and delight. From conceptual design to project management, we handle every aspect of the design process to ensure that our clients receive the highest level of service and the best possible outcome. At Novaco Design, we are passionate about creating innovative and timeless design solutions that meet the unique needs and preferences of our clients. We have extensive experience in a wide range of projects, from residential to commercial, hospitality to retail. So, whether you're looking to redesign a single room or an entire home, Novaco Design has the expertise and experience to bring your vision to life. Let us help you create the space of your dreams.

name: House of Nur Ltd
description: Nur Alnajafi Interior designer provides a full interior, furnishing design services & consultation services. Creating tailored projects that are timeless, liveable & authentic, each project meet clients vision & no two projects are the same. working with each client very closely, building strong ongoing relationship to provide personal & adaptable services. ensuring to provide project that are practical & beautiful. with UK & International portfolio, recent & ongoing project include houses in Jordan, Iraq, Saudi Arabia & Turkey, coffee shops & restaurants in UK & Jordan, Hospitality projects in UK in addition to offices in Saudi Arabia & UK. Ambitious with strong organizational and multitasking skills, as well as an aptitude for technology. Ready to apply knowledge and skills to any challenge. Detailoriented professional with excellent communication, interpersonal, and creative thinking skills.

name: Octavia Dickinson
description: Octavia is known for her joyful, decorative style and instinctive use of colour, pattern and texture. After studying History of Art at the Courtauld Institute, she trained with some of the country’s leading decorators before founding her studio in 2018. She is currently recognised by House and Garden as one of the Top 100 Interior Designers in the UK and by Country and Town House as one of the Top 50 Best Interior Designers . Her projects span town and country, from a London pieds-à-terre to Grade 1 stately homes, Octavia works across residential and commercial interiors, bringing the same thoughtful eye and relaxed, personal approach to every brief. Growing up Octavia was surrounded by art and antiques which shaped her love of beautiful, well-made things. Today, she combines that sensibility with a fresh, light touch to create homes that feel warm, individual and quietly expressive. In 2022, she launched her debut collection of fabrics and wallpapers, drawing on her archive of vintage textiles, ceramics and favourite objects. Each design reflects her enduring belief: that the most beautiful homes are those that feel lived in and loved.

name: Ola Jachymiak Studio LTD
description: Having graduated from a technical interior design university in Gliwice, Poland, Ola decided to move to Paris, where she worked for a prominent design studio for 7 years.In 2013 she started her own Design Studio powered by her desire to work with clients in a more direct and personal manner. She wanted to move away from being just another designer in a big interior design studio and create a place where she could treat each project as a haute couture work. Ola prides herself on being immersed and present at all stages of the studio’s project. Starting from completely changing the layouts of the aerial space throughout the choice of a wallpaper, furniture and even tableware. Now living in London, Ola is successfully continuing her work and commitment to bring excellency and custom made approach to all her clients.

name: Space Shack
description: Discarding meaningless decoration, Founder & Creative Director Omar Bhatti puts more emphasis on the relationship between people, culture, activities and environment and knows clever spatial configuration like no one else. Establishing a sense of spaciousness, optimising comfort and convenience and enhancing daylight penetration Omar has transformed projects and united spaces across London and beyond. After studying architecture at London Met, Omar started his career in a small architecture firm but quickly shifted his career path to interiors. Forging his own path in 2016, Omar and his team have completed dozens of full renovations and interior design projects in London, adapting complex and frustrating spaces for purposeful use. Today, Space Shack juggles luxury projects that run the gamut from minimalist contemporary to idiosyncratic flash, always staying true to the client’s individual style and personality, whilst the essence of Space Shack is woven in throughout the design journey.

name: Architects Hub
description: Omeima Osman is an architect and interior designer with over 20 years experience. She holds a Master's degree in architectural design management from the Instituto de Empresa in Spain. Having lived in Qatar for over 25 years, Omeima has worked as architect in both the private sector as consultant and the public sector as client representative. Her most recent position was senior researcher at Qatar Foundation. Before that she held the positions of architect - design project manager at the Qatar Olympic Committee and lead architect in Doha Asian Games Organizing Committee. You can see here LinkedIn profile on this link: https://www.linkedin.com/in/omeimaosman/

name: Ham Interiors Ltd
description: Our approachable and experienced in house team offer a range of services from interior design, build and project management, to helping our clients source one-off pieces to make their properties unique. We place our clients needs at the heart of the design process, working closely to given briefs, budgetary and style requirements. We work in the Countryside, in Towns & Cities covering a wide catchment area with projects in progress all over the South East and further afield.

name: Paola Leon Design
description: Paola Leon Design is an award winning studio of designers based in Central London. We work at all scales from high end commercial projects, to luxury private homes and furnishing. The studio has a background in taking a holistic design approach to deliver large projects for high profile clients domestically and internationally. We create bespoke interiors that are both functional and beautiful with a strong sense of place and purpose. Meeting the client needs at every step of the process. The interiors we deliver are elegant, functional and thoughtful, designs that convey a sense of place, whether the style is classical, contemporary or eclectic. If required we can design and create bespoke furniture and joinery, working alongside artisans throughout the design process to ensure they achieve the quality of craftsmanship that each project deserves. Where appropriate, we love to reflect and incorporate the design, history and character of the building itself. It is important to let the personal journey the building has lived be reflected and shine through, revitalising itself for a new chapter. This experience and expertise allows PLD to deliver high quality design across a range of disciplines, including: Interior Design - Architecture - Fit Out - Furniture and Joinery Design - Spatial Organisation - FF&E Procurement - Home Dressing and Art Direction.

name: Yiangou Architects Ltd
description: Interior Design Philosophy I am particularly interested in the architectural and contextual value of a particular space. Ideas are often generated from an architectural feature or a particular characteristic or feeling of a space along side meeting the clients brief. The key feature may not necessarily be within the room it could be a view or vista. Another main objective, equally important, relates to the more practical requirements of organising layouts appropriate for use and life style. It is always important to balance the values of practicality with the aesthetics. Along side this I believe a space needs to feel personal to the client, they have to feel ownership of their space, to adopt it and inhabit it. The process we go through will be an evolution of discussions and ideas. A home is deeply personal. At Yiangou Interiors we specialise in all aspects of Interior design. We feel we are particularly strong at space planning, allowing you to maximise the potential of your space. We will generally create and agree layouts and then provide working drawings, including lighting and electrical layouts. In most projects we will research, agree and specify all the finishes, the bathroom layouts and sanitary ware specifications. We design and procure bespoke items of joinery, including kitchens, dressing rooms, wine cellars etc. We then can oversee the installation of these items on site. Alongside this we provide interior schemes, proposing colours, fabrics, window treatments,

name: Paul Fishpool Design Ltd
description: I am an award winning Interior Designer whose work is recognised for its simplicity, elegance and comfort. Over a career spanning more than 15 years, I have had the good fortune to hone my skills at some of London’s most renowned design Studios such as Candy & Candy and Taylor Howes Designs. My last role prior to founding my own Studio, was to establish & lead the Interior Design department at Rigby & Rigby, for which we received 3 Awards in the first 2 years. With a degree in Architecture from Kingston University & a Diploma in Interior Design from KLC School of Design, I am well placed to balance the differing elements of an interiors scheme, from the initial spatial review to the final decorative flourishes. I approach each project from a completely fresh perspective, but I always look to create timeless Interiors which are as usable as they are elegant and which emphasise my fundamental belief that the biggest luxury in life is comfort.

name: Paula Morrison Interiors Ltd
description: Paula Morrison Interiors is a boutique design studio based in Surrey, serving clients across the county and South West London. We specialise in creating sophisticated, bespoke residential spaces that harmonise timeless elegance with modern functionality. From the leafy enclaves of the Surrey Hills to the refined townhouses of Richmond and Wimbledon, our studio provides a comprehensive, detail-oriented service tailored to each client’s unique aspirations. We take pride in our commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and curated aesthetics, ensuring every project - whether a full-scale renovation or a single-room transformation - results in a home that is as beautiful as it is timeless.

name: Paulette Stephens Interior Design
description: Paulette Stephens Interior Design creates residential and commercial environments which combine personality, style and functionality. Working with architectural partners and contractors across a variety of residential and commercial interiors, Paulette draws on art, design and fashion to create engaging contemporary spaces.Established in 2012, the studio continues to grow, working on projects in London, Nationally and Internationally.

name: Hill House Interiors Ltd
description: Peter has been registered as an architect since 2003 and also became a BIID registered Interior Desigjer in November 2017. He has a wide range of experience working for various high-profile architectural and interior design companies in Glasgow, London, Weybridge, Winchester and Windsor. Peter joined Hill House Interiors in January 2022.

name: Peter Staunton Design Studio
description: Peter Staunton Design is an Interior Architecture, Design and Decoration studio dedicated to shaping modern living for our discerning clients. Blending intelligent spatial design with a fearless use of colour and the finest raw materials, we guide clients confidently beyond their comfort zone, creating spaces that are built to last and inspire for years. Peter holds the conviction that effective design has the power to uplift the human spirit, enriching daily experiences and well-being in the environments we dwell in. Our meticulous editing process for each project aims to maximise the core elements, minimising waste and showcasing space and design at its finest. Our goal is to craft truly iconic interiors that transcend time and fleeting trends, inspire its owners, and leave a lasting legacy for future generations. “Craftsmanship, materiality and fine detailing are the principle's we embrace”. Heavily influenced by music, fashion & art, juxtaposed with a passion for classic & contemporary architecture, Peter aims to bridge the gap between these creative arts & integrate them to create a look he likes to phrase as ‘Raw Luxury, Refined Design’. Services include:- Design & Concept. Interior Space Planning. 3D & CGI Rendering. Project Management. Furniture Design & Production. Cabinetry Design & Production. Lighting Design. Full SMart Home Technology. Bespoke Soft Furnishings. Full Decoration Servics. Installation & Staging For any enquiries, please email info@peterstaunton.co.u

name: Studio 44 Design
description: Headed by Philippa Buckley, Studio 44 has as its central focus the creation of unique interiors; with offices in both Dublin and London. Philippa specialises in high end residential interior architectural and design for with over twenty years of experience working with private clients. Renowned for expert design advice, creativity and a highly collaborative approach, the studio transforms houses into beautifully considered homes. Backed by a trusted team, Studio 44 Design delivers thoughtfully executed projects on time and within budget. Studio 44 Design is a creative design company dedicated to shaping distinctive, character-driven spaces. With a strong design-led approach, the studio carefully considers every element of a project, from bespoke furniture pieces to thoughtfully curated lighting design. Each space is crafted to feel unique and immersive, balancing imagination with functionality. Through layered lighting, refined materials, and carefully selected furnishings, Studio 44 Design creates environments rich in ambience—spaces that not only look beautiful but also evoke mood, atmosphere, and a lasting sense of place.For more information please check out our website www.studio44.ie

name: Devas Designs
description: Philippa Devas, is an experienced interior designer whose distinctive style blends traditional with modern, old with new. She is a member of the British Institute of Interior Design (BIID). Philippa began working for Percy Bass, then became an assistant to Chester Jones at Colefax & Fowler, before working at Chester's own company where she honed her natural talent and eye for space, proportion, light and texture. Devas Designs was established in 1998 and Philippa has since worked on many diverse projects from large country houses to modern London flats, carving out a successful niche for the company. Philippa was placed in the House & Garden Directory of the 100 Leading Interior Designers 2006, 2009, 2012 and 2015. She was also nominated for an Amara Interior Blog Award in 2016 for her busy blog about interiors, art and design. Philippa creates interiors combining practicality with a chic, muted style and works closely with clients using existing architectural elements as a starting point. Philippa also sources furniture, paintings and works of art for clients either as a one-off or as part of a design project.

name: Thorp Design Limited
description: Thorp Design is a distinguished London-based architecture and interior design studio, proudly celebrating over 40 years of excellence. Founded by Philippa Thorp, the practice brings together a highly skilled team of interior designers and architects who have earned a reputation for delivering timeless, bespoke projects across the UK and internationally. Renowned for its personal and collaborative approach, Thorp Design works on a broad range of commissions—from elegant city apartments and country estates to yachts, private planes, and even horse boxes. Whether transforming existing structures or designing from the ground up, the studio’s work is defined by an uncompromising attention to detail and a commitment to authenticity. Every project is unique, tailored to reflect the client’s individual style and lifestyle needs. Philippa Thorp’s curatorial expertise, particularly in sourcing and placing fine art and antiques, adds another layer of distinction to the studio’s work. Many clients return to Thorp for repeat projects in their additional residences, a testament to the trust, creativity, and meticulous service that define the studio’s offering. In addition to private commissions, Thorp is well known for landmark commercial projects including the acclaimed KX Gym in South Kensington and Wentworth Golf Club. Across all work, the studio’s hallmark is clear: every space is crafted with timeless elegance, intelligent design, and a personal touch that makes it feel both refined a

name: Pia Design Ltd
description: A love of nature is at the heart of our designs and our philosophy is that the best form of sustainability is a carefully considered scheme and the use of quality materials - natural materials have a timeless quality about them that surpasses trends whilst also standing the test of time: some materials even grow more beautiful with age. Everything we do has the future of our home planet at its heart, and we actively champion more sustainable ways to remodel. We reuse, repurpose and refurbish before replacing. We believe longevity is the best form of sustainability and by taking inspiration from nature we’re able to create spaces that improve with age. Spaces that grow with you and your family. Interiors with a green soul.

name: Brahm Interiors
description: Pierre Brahm established Brahm Interiors eleven years ago with a vision to create a design team offering experience in a wealth of disciplines, combined with creative flair. With over 30 years experience in both the residential and commercial sectors, the Brahm design team has worked on projects ranging from luxury private homes to large-scale investment portfolios. Offering a range of services from property dressing, planning and design, to full refurbishment, Brahm Interiors is equipped to fulfill your every requirement. Working with design conscious home-owners, developers and property agents, our accolades include winning the Design & Decoration Award for Best Show Home, being short-listed for a British Interior Designer Award, and Quintessentially Interior Designer of the Year 2010.

name: Pippa Paton Design Limited
description: Focussed on the Cotswolds, Pippa Paton is a highly respected and visionary interior designer specialising in high-end residential projects. Known for transforming manor houses, estates, and barns, Pippa’s approach is consistent: an unwavering focus on the bones of the structure that reflect the unique character of the region and blending these seamlessly with contemporary materials to create timeless, luxurious homes. Using her instinctive ability to visualise what a space can be and how to optimise its potential for the lives we lead today, over the past two decades Pippa and her team have successfully reconfigured many historic (and more recently constructed) homes for life in the 21st-century, navigating projects through planning, construction and fit-out, exposing and enhancing historic features along the way and introducing colours, textures, furniture and art to create interiors of calm simplicity. Pippa is internationally recognised having won multiple awards and featured in leading interiors publications worldwide. She has been included in Country Life's Top 100 every year since its inception in 2017 and in Andrew Martin's Top 100 Designers in the World several times, as well as publishing two books, 'Twenty First Century Cotswolds' Volumes I & II.

name: Free Birds Interior Design Studio Ltd
description: Free Birds Interior Design Studio was created from an ambition that started years ago. I have always loved beautiful spaces and worked for many years marketing the luxury boutique hotel industry where I always found myself more drawn to the Interiors than the marketing. After a career break raising my girls, I was privileged to find a position in a well-established design studio and after five years learning the intricacies of the trade, I decided to start my own studio. The passion for beautiful interiors has never been stronger. People today have come to appreciate the intense pleasure of living or working in a space that they love and have helped create. I would love nothing more than working closely with clients on projects and turn their dream home into a reality. I work from my home office in South London and cover projects in Central and South London.

name: RACHEL LAXER
description: Rachel was born and raised in New York and has travelled the world extensively, including living in Tokyo and Europe for a number of years ; providing an international perspective for the interiors she creates. She currently divides her time between a New York home, and London - where she lives with her husband and two young daughters. Prior to launching her career in London at Kelly Hoppen Interiors, she was a successful Emerging Markets trader and portfolio manager in the Hedge Fund industry for several large global funds. She has an undergraduate degree in Political Science and History from Washington University in St. Louis, as well as a Master' s in Business Administration in Finance from New York University.

name: London Atelier Ltd
description: Ralf Eikelberg PGDip (ENG) Interior Architecture, reg. BIID Interior Designer, PGDip Architecture UCL London, reg. Architekt in AK-Berlin Ralf Eikelberg studied and practised as an Interior Architect in Germany before graduating from the Bartlett with a Post Graduate Diploma in Architecture. He was a senior member of established design lead Architect's practices before becoming a co-director of London Atelier in 2010. Ralf specialised in designing within the existing and new build sectors, remodelling and working on listed buildings at various scales. London Atelier's meticulous eye for detail, construction and innovation combined with the appropriate materiality and custom solutions is a trade mark of their designs. The client brief is paramount. Every project is unique and deserves the best possible design solution to enable and unlock its full potential. Before his time in London, he was involved in architectural practices and a lighting design firm based in Berlin. Further, he has worked with the Italian Architect Paolo Portoghesi in Rome. He designed the Art, Design & Media Library (ADM) at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore and the house for the Commander of Singapore Airforce, Singapore. His hospitality work has included concept development projects for the Oberoi Hotel Group, India, the Giorgio Armani Residences in Egypt and restaurant & bar designs for the owners of the Aman Resorts. He studied Interior Design at Kingston University, London where he was awarded a Commendation for Design. He later qualified in Architecture Year III to gain the Royal Institute of British Architects Part 1 exemption. He has also been awarded 1st place prize by the Singapore Institute of Architects in Open Competition. He is presently living & working in Singapore for the Architecture + Design firm Populous

name: Studio Sidika Limited
description: Creative Director & Founder Sidika Owen d’Hauteville set up Studio Sidika in 2015 after a decade long career in investment banking in the luxury goods sector. Studio Sidika has an in-house team of interior architects and designers to deliver a fully integrated design and project coordination service. We love working with clients who understand the value of owning a home that is design-led. Our work covers both residential and commercial projects in London. We speak English, French, Italian, German and Turkish.

name: Design ID
description: Services . Since our incorporation in 2005, our creative design studio has specialised in interior design, architectural refurbishment, and landscaping, delivering award-winning projects celebrated in industry publications. ​ With a diverse portfolio, we have transformed restaurants, cocktail bars, pubs, golf courses, and hospitality venues, as well as retail spaces and workspaces, into extraordinary environments that inspire and delight. ​ We believe every project begins with a story—a unique narrative tied to the site, its history, and the aspirations of our clients. Our role is to uncover this story and translate it into a design that feels authentic, purposeful, and timeless. Whether reimagining a single room or transforming an entire estate, our team takes a tailored approach, ensuring the result not only meets but exceeds expectations. ​ As a studio, we combine creativity with meticulous attention to detail. From selecting sustainable materials to designing bespoke furnishings, every decision is guided by our commitment to delivering designs that are both beautiful and functional. We are equally passionate about collaborating with a trusted network of partners, including architects, planners, and specialist contractors, to ensure seamless integration of all aspects of the project. Sustainability and wellness are at the heart of what we do. We strive to create spaces that connect people to their surroundings, inspire a sense of calm and joy, and minimise environmental im

name: Studio Ashby
description: Led by its Creative Director, Sophie Ashby, Studio Ashby creates spaces with a unique identity. Ashby’s aim is to bring authenticity to each project, not only in the selection of furniture, lighting and art but in its use of a natural palette of materials and textures. Unswayed by the passing dictates of fashion, Ashby draws on her love of antiques, colour, contemporary ‘world art’, modernist furniture, photography and her latest discoveries to deliver an eclectic richness to each interior. Studio Ashby’s relationships with artisans and craftsmen, extensive resources and continual foraging play an integral role in developing each project. Humour and a love of objects with an explicit narrative result in a carefully balanced body of work that create cohesive spaces with a sense of honesty. Sophie broadened her design vocabulary through a BA in History of Art (Hons) at Leeds University, going on to study Interior Design at Parsons, The New School in Manhattan, New York. Her strong architectural and design sensibility developed over the following years with sound. mentorship and a personal curiosity for “beautiful things”.

name: Alice Blue Interiors
description: Alice Blue Interiors specialises in sophisticated and luxurious interiors across the UK, based from our London studio. Our personable approach ensures every project is considered, beautifully realised and detailed to exacting standards. Individually tailored to our client's every need our ethos is driven to create elegant, comfortable and enduring interiors with practicality at its heart. Our studio is led by Sophie Fuller who has gained over 15 years of experience in luxury residential interior design. Her previous projects have encompassed everything from Grade I listed homes to new build properties and developments. Sophie has gained a wealth and breadth of project experience working for discerning clients from across the globe. Her personable approach is collaborative and tailors every client’s needs to suit their property, style and aspirations. Sophie’s passion is to create unique, intelligent and functional design solutions with personality and longevity at the forefront of her design aesthetic.

name: Studio Gorse
description: Sophie Chapman founded Studio Gorse in 2021, emerging in the wake of the pandemic. Founded by Sophie Chapman in 2021, Studio Gorse takes its name and inspiration from the Cornish coastline and flora—its rugged beauty and strong sense of place deeply influence the studio’s layered, nuanced interiors. With over a decade of industry experience in the South West and a First-Class BA (Hons) in Interior Design from Falmouth University, Sophie leads a dynamic studio focused on both residential and commercial projects. She has a particular affinity for Grade-listed and heritage buildings, approaching them with care, creativity and respect - blending historical character with a contemporary sensitivity. Studio Gorse is driven by authenticity, sustainability, and collaboration - drawing on a trusted network of local contractors, makers and artisans across the South West. Each project is approached with care, aiming to enhance everyday life and well-being through timeless, meaningful design. At the heart of Studio Gorse is a belief that well-designed spaces have the power to enhance everyday life and well-being. Sophie leads each project with a personal, hands-on approach—listening closely, collaborating openly, and building honest, enduring relationships with her clients and project partners. Every project is designed to stand the test of time—both in its beauty and in its integrity.

name: Just Sophie Interiors Ltd
description: I’m Sophie O’Sullivan, founder of Just Sophie Interiors, where I create thoughtful, concept-driven interiors shaped around how people truly live. Based in Oxfordshire and the Cotswolds, my work spans residential, commercial and boutique hospitality projects. My approach is grounded in both creativity and function, with a strong focus on flow, materiality and wellbeing. Having worked internationally, I bring a broad perspective to each project, but always keep the process personal, working closely with clients to design spaces that feel intuitive, timeless and uniquely theirs.

name: Tollgard Studio
description: Brought up in Stockholm, Staffan's personal style is born out of Asian and Scandinavian functionalism. He uses the Swedish expression of the 'red thread' to explain the design narrative that underpins every project. The thread is the guiding principle of creative endeavour, the core essence that he strives to find in each project. An architectural detail, a family heirloom, or a collection of art; each project has its own creative DNA that tells the client's story using the language of design. House and Garden's Leading 100 Designers says "Staffan' s flair for fusing modern furniture and art into chic, tailored interiors has made him a favourite with design-conscious families. Beautiful bespoke joinery is a given". Tollgard Studio offers an award-winning architectural interior design service for an international clientele. We work collaboratively and creatively to create bold, contemporary interiors that our clients can enjoy. Our design studio and showroom is located in Grosvenor Waterside, just by the Pimlico Road design area.

name: Sdias London
description: Sdias London is a team of experienced and talented designers with a wealth of complimentary industry networks. Our services include interior design, interior architecture, hospitality interior design, property development, home dressing/styling and FF&E packages. Our expertise and professional approach are tailored to each client to deliver high-quality services worldwide. Ensuring our projects are designed and managed from concept through to completion. Our projects extend from Europe to the USA, the Americas, Africa, and the Caribbean. We are based in Chelsea, London, UK and Montego Bay, Jamaica, West Indies.

name: atelier payne co. ltd
description: Winning his first job over 40 years ago with one of the world's leading hotel designers Frank Solano and then moving on to work with interior design giant John Stefanidis, Steven Payne has gone on to build his own thriving interior design practice. He has collaborated with Osborn Interiors in Oxfordshire, Rose Uniacke in London and Pascal Goujon in Nice. The best testimony is what others have to say , recently written about Payne and his staff in Spectacular Homes of London: 'designers like to work with their clients rather than or them, examining and discussing every facet of their lives until they can draw out their exact requirements. As a result no two projects look the same, but there is a confidence and sense of order that runs through all of the company' s work...' 'The practicality and level of comfort in his residential work have an echo in luxury hotels, combined with the truly bespoke personal detailing that is appropriate for a private home.' Above all, it is a personal endeavour for Payne; regardless of scope, brief, budget or location, each home, each project, each time he's given the opportunity to transform space. Steven specialises in: Residential interior architecture and design, decoration or simply; partial / full property design and redesign; Hotel, Bar and Restaurant interiors; Commercial Development concepts; Furniture Design and Feasibility Studies. Upon contact a complimentary appointment will be set up for you and Steven Payne to meet. Ideally, the m

name: Nashmita Rajiah Ltd
description: Nashmita Rajiah is a London-based interior architect and designer with over 20 years of experience, and the founder of her eponymous studio. Her work focuses on bespoke residential interiors, combining architectural clarity with a refined understanding of materiality, proportion, and how spaces are experienced in everyday life. Working internationally, she delivers projects ranging from private homes and penthouses to large-scale residences, each defined by a considered and cohesive approach. Nashmita began her career in London in 2006 at Candy & Candy, contributing to landmark ultra-prime developments including One Hyde Park, as well as private residences across London, Monaco, and Gibraltar. This early experience established a strong foundation in high-end residential design, with a particular emphasis on spatial hierarchy, craftsmanship, and precision. She later held senior roles within developer-led practices, including Head of Interior Architecture at Nstudio, part of Northacre PLC, where she led interior architecture across complex residential and mixed-use schemes. Before founding her studio in 2023, Nashmita worked independently with developers, architects, and private clients across the UK, Europe, and internationally. Her work today reflects this breadth of experience, underpinned by a disciplined and architectural approach to design.

name: Sue Dann Interiors
description: After obtaining a First Class Honours Degree in Fashion and Textiles Sue worked in the fashion industry for 20 years; in London, Paris and Italy as well as undertaking various projects in USA and the Far East. Sue' s passion for colour and texture, combined with her skills in spatial awareness and her love of architecture, were easily transported into the Interior Design Industry when she set up Sue Dann Interiors in 1998 after completing an Interior Design course at the KLC School of Interior Design in London. Originally established in South Bucks. Sue Dann Interiors has carried out a wealth of prestigious domestic renovation projects on period properties around Buckinghamshire, Berkshire, Surrey, Hampshire, London and the French Alps as well as many projects in Bath and Somerset. Sue has also carried out many Hotel and Restaurant projects around the country. After 3 years in Cornwall we have now relocated to South Somerset where we are in a much better location to better serve our clients in Surrey and Bath but can also still serve Cornwall, Devon and Dorset. We are now located in South Petherton , a beautiful Ham Stone Village in South Somerset. Contact email and mobile remain the same and we are happy to visit you and view your projects.

name: Fisher ID
description: My experience in interior design spans some thirty years, working mainly on residential projects in London and the Home Counties. Over the years, I have been involved in all aspects of design from architectural planning and detailing, through decoration and specialist finishes, and finally sourcing art and accessories to complete the project. In terms of style, I have implemented both traditional and modern design. My real strengths lie at the contemporary end of the spectrum although not the exclusion of all things traditional. I feel that the most successful projects are where the perfect balance between old and new has been achieved. Each new project affords opportunities to hone my skills in all aspects of design and I thrive on the challenges that my work provides. I spend a lot of time keeping abreast of technological advances in design as well as reading and attending exhibitions to keep up to date with the latest products available: all in order to provide my clients with the most current choices available. I have a passion for good design of all styles, and I truly believe that a well designed environment can improve the quality of life for those living and working within it. I consider it my duty as a designer to strive to provide the best possible solutions in terms of aesthetics, atmosphere and functionality within my client' s budget and time scale.

name: Sun Lee Jones
description: I am an ambitious senior designer with over 16 years experience of working on projects for top UK international retail brands and property development interiors in Weybridge Surrey. The last 8 years my work has involved bespoke luxury high end residential design development projects. Projects involve design and build to simple renovation work. I am capable of running projects from conception through to completion. My skills range from design presentation and project management, including supervision of contractors and budget control, to procurement. I am proficient in a variety of design programs, including Vectorworks. Educated to degree level with passes in 3-D Interior Design and Architecture. https://www.sunleejonesinteriors.com

name: Pfeiffer Design
description: Pfeiffer Design are a comprehensive interior architecture and design studio with a wealth of experience designing and bringing to fruition high-end bespoke homes. Within our team of 8 we specialise in every aspect of interior design, meaning we are confident we can design and implement your project, managing the process every step of the way. From technical drawings and selecting architectural finishes through to furniture specification and installation, we offer a one-stop-shop for all aspects of interior design. All our designs are unqiue to you, finding the balance between aesthetics, functionality and practicality with a holistic oversight. Our client-centred approach takes consideration for you, your lifestyle, family, pets and guests, meaning we really get to know who you are and how you want to live. In twenty years of trading we have developed a strong and reliable supply chain, employing the services of many unique, high-quality and trusted suppliers and tradespeople. We pride ourselves on our ability to really listen to our clients and this forms the basis of our design ethos. We do not impose design choices on our clients, and in our experience, this ensures we deliver exactly what our clients want at every turn. We select products based on their undeniable quality, sourced from a variety of suppliers, selected specifically with your project in mind. In short, Pfeiffer Design offer an unparalled design, specification and procurement service. Coupled with carefully-

name: Suzy Dallas Limited
description: BRINGING PRESTIGE INTERIORS TO LIFE WITH LIGHT Lighting transforms a space and can affect our mood and whole sense of well being. We are professional lighting designers and work with architects and developers, interior designers and private clients, to help them achieve the wow factor and maximise the value of their investment. And for the projects for which a lighting designer has not been hired.... we have also developed a series of lighting tutorials which can be accessed here LINK

name: SLJ Interiors
description: With over 30 years’ experience in the industry, Sylvia Lawson Johnston’s fabulous projects have led her to be included in House and Garden’s Top 100 Interior Designers for many years. What makes Sylvia stand out is her natural ability to create completely bespoke environments combining a mixture of antique, vintage and modern pieces with colour, pattern and texture. Sylvia enjoys creating houses that stand the test of time and reflect the character of their owners. She creates a timeless sense of elegance rather than being led by passing fashions. Sylvia builds relationships with her clients who frequently come back to her when they move house, which is the best vote of confidence. Email Sylvia@sljinteriors.co.uk to discuss any projects and to make an appointment.

name: Symbiotic Living
description: Drawing strength from her own personal journey of loss, award-winning interior designer Sharlene Young has a deep understanding of the profound effect that a person’s built environment can have on their health and well-being. Harnessing her passion for human-centered design, Sharlene launched Symbiotic Living in Chicago in 2016 with a mission to elevate homes beyond mere living spaces, creating environments where individuals can truly thrive. Now, with a global perspective honed from Sharlene’s life in Chicago and London and a personal pull toward Rome, Symbiotic Living continues to craft sustainable, life-enhancing spaces for clients in the U.K. and U.S.

name: Tabitha Isobel
description: Tabitha Isobel was founded in early 2023 by Tabitha Organ. The studio is based in London and has projects across the UK. Tabitha has a decade of experience in the industry. She achieved a Bachelor Honours Degree in Interior Design from Falmouth University. Prior to founding Tabitha Isobel she has worked for the prestigious, Conran + Partners and the innovative, Sella Concept. Tabitha Isobel is a dynamic interior design studio dedicated to creating captivating environments that seamlessly blend history with contemporary flair, delivering distinctive and timeless design experiences. We listen, we have integrity and we are honest. We are not driven by trends, but by authenticity. We love what is old and we thoughtfully introduce what is new. We aim to inspire clients, bring their vision to life and exceed expectations. At the core of the studio ethos is the knowledge that a well designed space always has a positive impact on life and well-being. With sustainability at the forefront of our minds, we are creative in how we reuse, recycle and re-purpose elements within Interior Design and are considered in our material and furniture choices. We are passionate about designing spaces that will stand the test of time in their durability and their aesthetic. Ultimately, we love what we do!

name: Taida Salaber Interiors Ltd
description: Taida Salaber is an interior designer with 20 years of professional experience, working in the industry since 2006. A graduate of the Academy of Fine Arts in Gdańsk, where she studied Interior Architecture, Taida has built her career in Scotland, including working within award-winning showrooms before establishing her independent design practice. Her experience spans residential interiors, period properties, renovations and bespoke high-end projects. Having worked in Scotland for many years, Taida has developed extensive knowledge of the local interiors industry and established relationships with suppliers, manufacturers and specialist trades. Taida approaches each project individually, with no prescribed house style. Her work is guided by the architecture and character of the property, alongside the lifestyle, needs and personality of her clients. Combining creativity with a strong understanding of functionality and technical detail, she creates considered, distinctive interiors designed to feel personal and to stand the test of time.

name: Tanya Bentley Ltd
description: Tanya Bentley is an Interior Architecture studio specialising in major residential refurbishments. Ours is a hard-to-come-by, top-to-bottom, end-to-end service. A considered approach that reveals your property’s full potential and brings joy to your home. From bold moves that unlock hidden light and space; to innovative structural remodelling that becomes the key to a seamless flow; and beautiful sight-lines that spark everyday moments of delight. From joyful colour and texture, through to the subtle thoughtful details that make all the difference, we create elegant spaces that combine form and function for delightful modern living. http://tanyabentley.co.uk/

name: Seven & Co
description: Behind every extraordinary space is a designer who understands that luxury isn't just about expensive materials - it's about creating environments that tell your story and enhance your life. M y journey from award-winning studios to creating bespoke interiors across the UK and worldwide has taught me that the most beautiful spaces are born from genuine collaboration and meticulous attention to detail. ​ My multicultural background brings a unique perspective to every project. Whether I'm restoring a heritage property with sympathetic reverence for its history, designing a contemporary family home that balances luxury with liveability, or creating commercial spaces that captivate clients, I draw inspiration from diverse cultural influences to create designs that are both timeless and distinctly personal.

name: TK Projects Ltd
description: Tia Kirwan is offering more than a decade of experience in building and refurbishing residential properties in the U.K. and USA. Throughout her career, she has been focusing on elevating and bettering her clients’ surroundings, life style and well-being.

name: Gosling Ltd
description: Tim Gosling established Gosling, following an accomplished 18-year tenure as a Director at Linley. Tim, driven by a passion for design encompassing architecture, interiors, furniture and the arts, possesses a unique talent for seamlessly blending these disciplines. Originating his career in theatre design, Tim infuses a dash of drama into his creations, complemented by meticulous attention to detail, resulting in perfect performances. Assembling a team carefully chosen to not only mirror his style, but also express their distinct and original design expertise, Tim has curated a portfolio featuring private and commercial commissions, such as the Goring Hotel and BP Headquarters. The Gosling team’s collaboration with global interior designers, yacht designers and architects contirubte to a diverse portfolio of international projects. Gosling's bespoke interior and furniture design services have earned an international reputation for excellence. Drawing inspiration from classical architecture with a contemporary twist, the design process begins closely with clients to ensure their needs and preferences are reflected in each meticulously crafted interior. Every furniture item and element of an interior adheres to rigorous standards, employing the finest materials and traditional cabinet-making techniques.

name: Timothy A Ryan Associates
description: Founded in 1986 and based In Brecon, South Wales, and London we believe exceptional design is about balancing creativity, quality, and practicality. Our approach combines ingenuity with a clear understanding of budget, craftsmanship, and the realities of delivering successful projects. With years of experience in luxury residential design, we create thoughtful and beautifully considered spaces that reflect the individuality of each client. From initial concepts through to completion, every detail is approached with care, ensuring the highest standards of quality while remaining conscious of costs and value. We understand that great design should not only inspire but perform practically and financially. That is why we focus on delivering creative, achievable solutions tailored to each project — combining traditional craftsmanship, professional expertise, and clear project guidance throughout the process. At Timothy A Ryan Associates, our goal is simple: to transform ideas into refined, well-crafted spaces that are both distinctive and deliverable.

name: DECOR TOKYO Co., Ltd
description: Decor Tokyo is an interior design office that performs renovation, renovation, interior coordination, etc. The concept of beautiful space is the result of being functional which is our focus when renovating. We will take care of the sound, light and thermal environment, not to mention the housework line, the ease of life, the storage plan. We also accept small renovations and requests for interior coordination that are not accompanied by construction work.

name: Westcot House
description: Tor Dighero, owner and founder of Westcot House, has always worked closely with a team of very experienced and talented makers and it’s these relationships that are key to producing excellent work time and again. Working for many years in publishing as a magazine editor, Tor loves the teamwork that goes into creating something beautiful, unique and worthwhile. At Westcot House the ethos is very personal. Tor and the team get to know you, the client, and work within the style of the home and your own personal take on interiors. We are used to working in period properties where there are sometimes challenges but where we will always be sympathetic to the architecture and history of the house. Projects have been completed in London, the home counties and abroad. Tor and the team love talking to clients about their projects and are happy to discuss anything from a whole house to a single room, or even just a headboard or cushion. We work with commitment and dedication. We are also delighted to be introducing our very own online store. Here we have curated a mix of cushions, furniture, home fragrances and accessories which you can buy directly from us by heading to our shop. Based in the old town of Beaconsfield, we have a showroom with an extensive fabric library open to clients by appointment.

name: Txengo Studio
description: We are a dynamic, multi-disciplinary design studio based in London, specializing in creating stunning, contemporary interiors for the Hospitality, Residential, and Luxury Travel sectors. Our mission is to capture the essence of our clients' brand identity and lifestyle, ensuring every space is a true reflection of their unique vision and individuality. With a global perspective and an international clientele, we draw inspiration from diverse cultural influences to bring creativity and vibrancy to every project. Our extensive experience across a wide range of business challenges allows us to seamlessly blend functionality with luxury, transforming spaces where people live, work, and thrive. We are designers, visionaries, listeners, makers, and doers. We bring your dreams to life.

name: Vanessa Buirski Interiors
description: Vanessa Buirski lives in London and started her Interior Design Practice in 2002. Since then she has been working with residential clients based in London, the Home Counties and Europe providing both a comprehensive Interior Design service as well as hourly consultation if required. From period restorations to contemporary projects, realising the potential and character of very diverse homes and client wishes. Vanessa's reputation has been built on her personal and collaborative approach, her talent for colour, lighting expertise and space planning. A more extensive portfolio of her work can also be seen on Houzz https://www.houzz.co.uk

name: Katherine Varnava Interiors
description: Katherine Varnava is the Founder and Creative Director of Katherine Varnava Interiors , a London-based luxury interior design studio specialising in elegant, bespoke residences across prime addresses including Hampstead, Mayfair, Chelsea, and Central London. With a portfolio spanning distinguished private homes and landmark refurbishments, Katherine is recognised for delivering timeless interiors that combine architectural depth with understated sophistication. With over a decade of experience in the high-end interiors sector, Katherine leads every project with creative integrity and a meticulous eye for detail. Her practice offers a fully comprehensive interior architecture and FF&E service. From spatial planning, lighting design and bespoke joinery, through to curated finishes, soft furnishings and on-site styling. Each project is carefully tailored to reflect the client’s lifestyle, aspirations, and the unique character of the property. Katherine is particularly known for her ability to transform complex residential projects into seamless design journeys, often acting as Lead Designer across all RIBA stages. Working alongside some of London’s leading contractors, architects and artisans, she ensures every element is executed to the highest level. The studio offers in-house joinery design and bespoke furniture production, ensuring total control over quality, detailing and finish.
