name: The Vawdrey House Ltd
description: The Vawdrey House is a multi-award winning interior design and architecture studio which offers a dynamic combination of soulful design, strategic thinking and creative flair. Working across high-end commercial and residential projects, we specialise in bringing both architecture and interior design together to create beautiful spaces, unique to the individual families and organisations that use them. With our select team of creative experts, our interwoven approach seamlessly blends interior design, architecture and the landscape. This enables us to envision how spaces will be used and how they will look and feel both inside and out. We consider all aspects of the project from the outset, developing them on with ruthless attention to detail and professional project management to deliver well thought out, cohesive projects that defy mainstream solutions and exceed expectations.

name: Victor Gradinaru Interiors
description: Victor Gradinaru Interiors, is a London-based boutique interior design studio with projects across the UK and abroad. Founded to provide class-leading designs, we believe every space should tell a story—yours! That’s why our designs focus on timeless elegance and sustainable, bespoke creations that reflect each client’s unique vision. Led by Founder and Creative Director Victor Gradinaru, we push the boundaries of creativity and redefine the art of living. Every project undertaken by the VG Interiors is personal, blending functionality with beauty. We listen closely to our clients, translating their needs and aspirations into thoughtful design concepts that elevate everyday living. Our work spans the globe, from the modern skylines of Singapore and San Francisco to the timeless charm of London and Sydney. Recent projects include two developments in South Kensington and private residences in London, the Cotswolds, and beyond. Current commissions include a family home and a harbourfront residence in Sydney. Whether you’re looking to refresh a single room or transform your entire home, we’re here to bring your vision to life. Explore more of what we do at www.victorgradinaru.com or reach out directly, we’d love to hear from you!

name: Victoria Caldwell Design
description: Victoria Caldwell Design manages residential projects with private individuals, architects and developers. We work along side our clients, advising but not forcing a particular style. We approach the design process as a collaboration of ideas, styling and designing spaces for the way families or individuals want to live. The studio works closely with clients to create unique interiors that reflect their vision. We form the initial Design concept of the project, mood and fabric boards, to compiling and issuing technical drawing packages. We oversee the design throughout the build and final installation to ensure a successful outcome. We hand source finishes, fabrics, furniture and lighting for our clients, producing beautiful Interior Design schemes that encompass their world.

name: McGuinness Architects
description: With a personal focus on bespoke and the emotive quality of materials, Victoria works closely with clients to define a functional and aesthetic brief that is answered with sensitive, considered design specific to the client and their unique story. As principal interior designer for McGuinness Architects she works both independently and alongside the architectural team on residential and select commercial projects for the studio. With a degree in Interior Design from Parsons, The New School for Design in New York, Victoria was awarded the graduating prize in Design Excellence. She credits her training there for her rigorous approach to space-planning (she was taught by architects) and her commitment to drawing as an essential part of the design process, revealing both opportunity and potential pitfall. Her first degree in Fashion Communication at Central St Martin’s (and subsequent career as a fashion writer) has helped shape a creative thinking process and the ability to read and interpret mood. Returning to London in 2017, Victoria has worked for a number of eminent London design studios (HBA, Hubert Zandberg, Peter Mikic, Hazel Collins) with projects for private clients in London, New York, Miami and Colorado.

name: Violet And George
description: Violet & George was founded in 2009 by Nicky Mudie, following a decade of experience in the interior design industry and a lifelong passion for textiles, craftsmanship, and considered, luxury design. With a deep-rooted understanding of soft furnishings and decorative arts, Nicky established the studio to offer beautifully tailored interiors with soul and personality. Nicky studied Textile Design at art college before completing a degree in the History of Art & Design at Leeds University. She apprenticed under Daniel Hopwood at his West London studio, then spent seven years as Head Designer at Godrich Interiors, where she played a key role in building and shaping the studio. What sets Violet & George apart is the attention we pay to what truly matters to our clients. We offer a flexible interior design and decoration service that adapts to individual needs — from full interior schemes to made-to-measure curtains and upholstery, paint and fabric consultations, intelligent solutions, and signature decorative details. Working from our West London studio and soft furnishings workshop in Hampshire, our designers and skilled craftsmen collaborate with a trusted network of specialists to deliver exceptional quality and a highly personalised, joyful client experience.

name: WaMa Designs
description: WaMa Designs was established in May 2009 and is headed by Design Director Wan Zainal Abidin - whose previous experience includes running two companies under his capacity as the creative head. He has 20 over years of experience in the design field and has been the main design consultant for major corporate clients in Brunei, including DST Communications, TelBru, Bank Islam Brunei Darussalam (BIBD), Insurans Islam TAIB, MAERSK, Jerudong Park Medical Centre (JPMC) and Pantai Jerudong Specialist Centre. WaMa Designs is known to be the only design company specializing in Commerical Interiors and Branding in Brunei Darussalam. With professionally qualified key personnel in related fields, we have a strong and practical approach to improving and creating Corporate Identity and developing New Branded Environments.

name: White by Mehar
description: Welcome to Your Home of Luxury Design At our studio, we believe that true luxury is personal. Based in the UK and operating globally, we specialize in creating interiors that are not just beautiful but are a reflection of your unique style and way of life. Whether you're looking for interior design, home styling, bespoke furniture, turnkey project management, or complete FF&E solutions, we're your one-stop solution. Our approach to design is all about understated elegance—spaces that feel luxurious yet welcoming, sophisticated yet comfortable. We take the time to understand your aesthetics and lifestyle, ensuring every detail of your project is tailored to you. We also offer exclusive design packages, with special discounts available for BIID fellow members. Let’s create something extraordinary together! you can find us on the following https://whitebymehar.co.uk/ https://www.instagram.com/wbm_uk/

name: Drumkilbo Designs
description: I started decorating over 24 years ago, during which time my style has evolved with the times. Living mostly in Scotland. I have decorated castles, country houses and shooting lodges ; often in the very far north of Scotland. I specialise mostly in traditional country house style with often an unexpected modern twist. I try to use wonderful textured and ageless fabrics, which help to lose the 'newly decorated' feel. I often use wonderful silks for curtains with unusual trimmings and fringes so they look as if they have hung there for generations. I prefer to work with my clients to achieve a home which suits them. I believe in getting to know my client, so together we can achieve a home which they will enjoy living in and which suits their family' s needs and their lifestyle. Although I mostly work in Scotland, I work also in England, Wales and abroad, where I greatly enjoy the different challenges of finding the right craftsmen in the right place at the right cost. I find that even after decorating for a number of years, I am still learning the whole time, which I feel keeps my style and mind open to all sorts of new ideas which can be combined to their best advantage.

name: Yoko Kloeden Design
description: Yoko Kloeden Design is a London-based architecture and interior design studio, founded by Yoko Kloeden in 2016. Located in West London, the studio specialises in crafting mood-enhancing sanctuaries, seamlessly blending Japanese aesthetics with natural, serene elements. Each project aims to create spaces that feel both harmonious and deeply restorative, reflecting Yoko’s commitment to calm, balanced interiors. With an early career in business and finance, Yoko Kloeden travelled extensively throughout Asia, North America, and Europe. Her journey exposed her to many contrasting environments, from impersonal airport lounges to uninspired hotel rooms, inspiring her to create interiors rooted in peace and purpose. Having grown up in Kyoto, Japan, Yoko has long appreciated the quiet power of nature, frequently finding solace in temple gardens and embracing the tranquillity they provide. Central to Yoko Kloeden Design’s philosophy is the Japanese principle of Yugen — a deep sense of presence and peace found in the subtle beauty of life. These principles are Hikari (Light), Nagame (View), Ma (Space), Shizen (Nature), and Taru o Shiru (Less is More), each one focused on cultivating harmony and simplicity. name: acanthus
description: Acanthus is a Tokyo-based interior design office where Yukiko Sato provides planning and designing for residential, show flat, and shop interior design and renovation. Yukiko's career started as a colour analyst at OZ Colour Studio, where she provided clients with colour consultation services. She then worked on many interior design projects at a lighting company, Yamagiwa Corp., and additionally at a renovation company. Along with her interior designing, she provided decorative flower arrangements for Yamagiwa's showroom displays. She then established her own company. Yukiko excels at sophisticated and contemporary Zen Style designs. She offers interior designs with a natural appeal that represents iyashi, a sense of comfort, which has been traditionally valued in Japan. The finishing touches she provides come from her specialized knowledge of Imari porcelain and other antiques, and also from her flower arrangement techniques.

name: Zaniz Studio
description: ZANIZ Studio is an established design practice founded in New York City, recognised internationally for its innovative and considered approach to interior design. The studio brings over 30 years of experience across high-end residential and commercial projects worldwide. The practice is known for a rigorous approach to design, craftsmanship, and detailing, with a portfolio spanning private residences, commercial spaces, bespoke yachts, resorts, and furniture design. Each project reflects a commitment to originality of thought and a refined understanding of how design shapes human experience. ZANIZ Studio blends beauty, technology, and craftsmanship to create environments that are emotionally engaging, enduring, and responsive to their context. The studio’s work consistently pushes the boundaries of contemporary design while remaining grounded in quality and purpose. Alongside the studio’s client work, Zaniz is engaged in ongoing research into how interiors and the built environment can support long-term human wellbeing. This includes the development of Longevity House™ , a long-term design research project exploring the relationship between space, technology, and quality of life. The studio remains committed to creating meaningful environments that respond to contemporary challenges and contribute positively to society. For enquiries, please contact Contact@zaniz.com .

description: Often refered to as the "Translator" on projects, Zara Christie has been restoring and refurbishing properties since 1990. Zara believes homes are a reflection of the clients personality and lifestyle, not just a canvas for the latest trends or fashions. Zara and her team pride themselves on attention to detail in creating functional, elegant and stylishly comfortable homes, and the full-service interior design agency can provide clients with interior and outdoor living design solutions.

name: Huxley Home Design Group

She founded her own practice Huxley Home in 2015 following training at London's Inchbald School of Design and six years in house at the renowned Staffan Tollgard Design Group. Zara's signature style channels the relaxed, eclectic charm of English Interior design, updated for 21st century living.
